# React 接入 (/docs/getting-started/react)





## 在 React 中使用 [#在-react-中使用]

在页面中引入 `GraphView` 组件。

```tsx
import GraphView from './GraphView';

export default function App() {
  return <GraphView />;
}
```

<span id="准备两组数据" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="react响应数据依赖变化" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

### 定义 GraphView [#定义-graphview]

将下面的代码保存为 `GraphView.tsx`。组件挂载后创建图，切换数据时调用 `setData()`，卸载时销毁实例。

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Graph, type GraphData } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const basicData: GraphData = {
  nodes: [{ id: 'Alice' }, { id: 'Bob' }, { id: 'Carol' }],
  edges: [
    { source: 'Alice', target: 'Bob' },
    { source: 'Alice', target: 'Carol' },
  ],
};

const expandedData: GraphData = {
  nodes: [...basicData.nodes, { id: 'David' }],
  edges: [...basicData.edges, { source: 'Bob', target: 'David' }],
};

const fitView = { padding: 32, maxZoom: 1 };

export default function GraphView() {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const graphRef = useRef<Graph | null>(null);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!containerRef.current) return;

    const graph = new Graph({
      container: containerRef.current,
      data: basicData,
      layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 120 },
      node: { style: { size: 24, label: (node) => node.id, labelPlacement: 'bottom' } },
      edge: { style: { endArrow: true } },
      autoFit: fitView,
      behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node', 'hover-highlight'],
    });

    graph.render().then(() => {
      if (graph.destroyed) return;
      graphRef.current = graph;
      setReady(true);
    }).catch((error) => {
      if (!graph.destroyed) {
        graph.destroy();
        console.error(error);
      }
    });

    return () => {
      graphRef.current = null;
      graph.destroy();
    };
  }, []);

  async function changeData(data: GraphData) {
    const graph = graphRef.current;
    if (!graph) return;
    try {
      await graph.setData(data, { fitView });
    } catch (error) {
      if (!graph.destroyed) console.error(error);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <select
        aria-label="关系图数据"
        defaultValue="basic"
        disabled={!ready}
        onChange={(event) => void changeData(event.target.value === 'expanded' ? expandedData : basicData)}
      >
        <option value="basic">基础关系</option>
        <option value="expanded">扩展关系</option>
      </select>
      <div ref={containerRef} style={{ width: '100%', height: 360 }} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

## 运行效果 [#数据变化时更新图]

选择「扩展关系」会添加 David 节点和 Bob → David 连线。切回「基础关系」即可恢复。

<QuickStartExample locale="zh" variant="framework-data" />

<span id="在-vue-中使用" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="vue用-watch-同步数据" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />


# Vue 接入 (/docs/getting-started/vue)





## 在 Vue 中使用 [#在-vue-中使用]

在页面中引入 `GraphView` 组件。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import GraphView from './GraphView.vue';
</script>

<template>
  <GraphView />
</template>
```

<span id="准备两组数据" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="vue用-watch-同步数据" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

### 定义 GraphView [#定义-graphview]

将下面的代码保存为 `GraphView.vue`。组件挂载后创建图，切换数据时调用 `setData()`，卸载时销毁实例。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref } from 'vue';
import { Graph, type GraphData } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const basicData: GraphData = {
  nodes: [{ id: 'Alice' }, { id: 'Bob' }, { id: 'Carol' }],
  edges: [
    { source: 'Alice', target: 'Bob' },
    { source: 'Alice', target: 'Carol' },
  ],
};

const expandedData: GraphData = {
  nodes: [...basicData.nodes, { id: 'David' }],
  edges: [...basicData.edges, { source: 'Bob', target: 'David' }],
};

const fitView = { padding: 32, maxZoom: 1 };
const containerRef = ref<HTMLDivElement | null>(null);
const ready = ref(false);
let graph: Graph | undefined;

onMounted(async () => {
  if (!containerRef.value) return;

  const instance = new Graph({
    container: containerRef.value,
    data: basicData,
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 120 },
    node: { style: { size: 24, label: (node) => node.id, labelPlacement: 'bottom' } },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true } },
    autoFit: fitView,
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node', 'hover-highlight'],
  });
  graph = instance;

  try {
    await instance.render();
    if (!instance.destroyed) ready.value = true;
  } catch (error) {
    if (!instance.destroyed) {
      instance.destroy();
      console.error(error);
    }
  }
});

onBeforeUnmount(() => graph?.destroy());

async function changeData(event: Event) {
  const instance = graph;
  if (!ready.value || !instance || instance.destroyed) return;

  const { value } = event.target as HTMLSelectElement;
  const data = value === 'expanded' ? expandedData : basicData;
  try {
    await instance.setData(data, { fitView });
  } catch (error) {
    if (!instance.destroyed) console.error(error);
  }
}
</script>

<template>
  <div>
    <select aria-label="关系图数据" :disabled="!ready" @change="changeData">
      <option value="basic">基础关系</option>
      <option value="expanded">扩展关系</option>
    </select>
    <div ref="containerRef" style="width: 100%; height: 360px" />
  </div>
</template>
```

## 运行效果 [#数据变化时更新图]

选择「扩展关系」会添加 David 节点和 Bob → David 连线。切回「基础关系」即可恢复。

<QuickStartExample locale="zh" variant="framework-data" />


# 图总览 (/docs/graph/overview)





## 什么是 Graph [#什么是-graph]

图由表示对象的节点和表示关系的边组成。G6Lite 的 `Graph` 实例把这些数据绘制到容器中，并提供查询元素、调整视口和监听交互的方法。

一个图实例通常经历以下步骤。

1. **创建。** 用 `new Graph(options)` 绑定容器并初始化渲染资源。
2. **渲染。** 调用并等待 `graph.render()`，完成首次布局和绘制。
3. **更新。** 复用同一个实例，用 `setData()` 更新图数据，用 `updateOptions()` 更新支持的配置。
4. **销毁。** 页面离开或组件卸载时调用 `graph.destroy()`，释放画布和监听器等资源。

<span id="使用图实例" />

## 使用 G6Lite Graph [#使用-g6lite-graph]

按[快速上手](/docs/getting-started/quick-start)安装 `@antv/g6-lite`。先在页面上准备一个已挂载、宽高非零的容器，再创建实例并渲染。

```html
<div id="container" style="width: 100%; height: 320px"></div>
```

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const graph = new Graph({
  container: '#container',
  data: {
    nodes: [
      { id: 'browser', x: 0, y: 0 },
      { id: 'api', x: 120, y: 0 },
    ],
    edges: [{ source: 'browser', target: 'api' }],
  },
});

await graph.render();
```

首次渲染完成后，就可以定位节点或更新数据。调用时序和资源清理见 [Graph 生命周期 API](/docs/api/graph#graph-lifecycle)。

<span id="容器与配置" />

## 图配置项 [#图配置项]

`GraphOptions` 是传给构造函数的配置对象。完整类型和字段细节见 [GraphOptions API](/docs/api/options#graphoptions)。

| 配置项          | 类型                                    | 默认值       | 用途                           |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------- | --------- | ---------------------------- |
| `container`  | `string \| HTMLElement`               | 必填        | 指定挂载容器。字符串使用 CSS 选择器。        |
| `data`       | `GraphData`                           | 必填        | 提供节点、边和可选的 Combo 分组。         |
| `autoFit`    | `boolean \| number \| FitViewOptions` | `false`   | 控制容器尺寸变化时是否重新适配视图。首次渲染会自动适配。 |
| `node`       | `NodeConfig`                          | 圆形节点      | 配置节点形状、样式和状态。                |
| `edge`       | `EdgeConfig`                          | 直线边       | 配置线型、箭头和状态。                  |
| `combo`      | `ComboConfig`                         | 内置样式      | 配置分组外观、标签和折叠形态。              |
| `label`      | `LabelOptions`                        | 内置策略      | 控制标签的缩放和可见性。                 |
| `layout`     | `LayoutConfig`                        | 使用数据坐标    | 指定布局算法及参数，由布局计算节点位置。         |
| `behaviors`  | `BehaviorOption[]`                    | 缩放、拖动画布   | 配置缩放、拖拽、选择等交互。               |
| `theme`      | `ThemeOption`                         | `'light'` | 设置画布和元素的默认样式。                |
| `transforms` | `TransformOption[]`                   | 无         | 按顺序处理布局前的输入数据。               |
| `plugins`    | `PluginOption[]`                      | 无         | 挂载已注册的插件。                    |

画布初始宽高由容器决定。适配方式和运行时尺寸调整见[视口与坐标](/docs/guides/viewport)。

## 图属性 [#图属性]

| 属性                                                             | 类型        | 说明                                      |
| -------------------------------------------------------------- | --------- | --------------------------------------- |
| [`graph.destroyed`](/docs/api/graph#graph-lifecycle-destroyed) | `boolean` | 只读。开始销毁后变为 `true`，可在异步数据返回后用它判断实例是否仍可用。 |

需要等待首次渲染时，使用 `await graph.render()`。

## 参考示例 [#参考示例]

### 完整的创建和配置示例 [#完整的创建和配置示例]

示例用 Dagre 将调用关系从左到右排列，将 Cache 和 Database 放进同一个 Combo。可以点击节点查看选中样式，也可以拖动或缩放画布。



```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'web', name: 'Browser' },
        { id: 'api', name: 'API' },
        { id: 'cache', name: 'Cache', comboId: 'storage' },
        { id: 'db', name: 'Database', comboId: 'storage' },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'web', target: 'api', data: { protocol: 'HTTPS' } },
        { source: 'api', target: 'cache', data: { protocol: 'GET' } },
        { source: 'api', target: 'db', data: { protocol: 'SQL' } },
      ],
      combos: [{ id: 'storage' }],
    },
    // #region element-options
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        width: 96,
        height: 38,
        borderRadius: 8,
        fill: '#eef2ff',
        stroke: '#6366f1',
        strokeWidth: 1,
        label: (node) => node.name ?? node.id,
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#1e293b',
      },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#4338ca', strokeWidth: 3 } },
    },
    edge: {
      style: {
        stroke: '#64748b',
        endArrow: true,
        label: (_source, _target, edge) => String(edge.data?.protocol ?? ''),
        labelColor: '#334155',
        labelBackground: '#fff',
        labelBackgroundPadding: 4,
      },
    },
    combo: {
      style: {
        label: 'Storage',
        labelPlacement: 'top',
        labelColor: '#065f46',
        padding: 20,
        borderRadius: 12,
        fill: 'rgba(16,185,129,0.08)',
        stroke: '#6ee7b7',
      },
    },
    // #endregion element-options
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', ranksep: 84, nodesep: 16, nodeSize: 96 },
    label: { hideOnLowZoom: false, scaleWithZoom: false },
    behaviors: ['click-select', 'drag-canvas', 'zoom-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: 36, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```




# 最简关系图 (/docs/examples/basic)





使用最少配置渲染一个可缩放、可拖拽的关系图。

## 如何体验

滚轮缩放，拖拽画布查看不同区域。

## 数据说明

5 个节点和 5 条边组成的最小闭环数据。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: 最简示例 — 少量节点边 + 环形布局
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: '0' },
        { id: '1' },
        { id: '2' },
        { id: '3' },
        { id: '4' },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: '0', target: '1' },
        { source: '0', target: '2' },
        { source: '1', target: '3' },
        { source: '2', target: '4' },
        { source: '3', target: '4' },
      ],
    },
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 150 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```

# 呼吸节点 (/docs/examples/breathing-node)





用内置 breathing-node 的呼吸效果对比选中、高亮和普通状态。

## 如何体验

切换选中和高亮，观察节点动画。

## 数据说明

3 个内置 breathing-node 节点、2 条边，对比初始 selected、highlight 和普通状态。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Breathing node demo.
 * Demonstrates the built-in breathing-node extension on selected/highlight states.
 */

import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'selected', x: 180, y: 180, data: { label: 'Selected' }, states: ['selected'] },
        { id: 'highlight', x: 360, y: 180, data: { label: 'Highlight' }, states: ['highlight'] },
        { id: 'normal', x: 540, y: 180, data: { label: 'Normal' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'edge-selected-highlight', source: 'selected', target: 'highlight' },
        { id: 'edge-highlight-normal', source: 'highlight', target: 'normal' },
      ],
    },
    // #region breathing-options
    node: {
      type: 'breathing-node',
      style: {
        size: 36,
        fill: '#1677ff',
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
      },
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { fill: '#1677ff', stroke: '#003eb3', strokeWidth: 3, haloWidth: 16 },
        highlight: { fill: '#2E8B57', stroke: '#1F6B43', strokeWidth: 3, haloWidth: 12 },
      },
    },
    // #endregion breathing-options
    edge: {
      style: {
        stroke: '#d1d5db',
        lineWidth: 2,
        endArrow: true,
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node', 'click-select'],
  });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container, '切换选中和高亮，观察节点呼吸动画。');
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };

  const toggleState = (state: 'selected' | 'highlight') => {
    const active = graph.getItemStates(state).includes(state);
    graph.setItemState(state, state, !active);
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    ui.addAction('切换选中', () => toggleState('selected'));
    ui.addAction('切换高亮', () => toggleState('highlight'));
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [自定义节点](/docs/guides/custom-node)
- [绘制契约](/docs/api/extensions#extension-drawing)

# Combo 分组容器 (/docs/examples/combo)





展示嵌套分组、折叠展开、运行时归组和数据导出。

## 如何体验

点击分组背景可折叠或展开单个分组。用画布上的按钮批量操作，在「更多」中调整节点归属、创建分组或导出数据。

## 数据说明

10 个业务节点、9 条边和 4 个嵌套分组。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Combo (Group Container) Demo
 * Demonstrates: nested application groups, fixed positioning, collapse/expand,
 * membership changes, runtime combo creation, and data export.
 */

import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const NODE_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  client: '#7D9FD3',
  service: '#70A991',
  data: '#C89C5D',
  observability: '#9299A8',
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const containerEl =
    typeof container === 'string'
      ? (document.querySelector(container) as HTMLElement)
      : container;
  containerEl.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: containerEl,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        {
          id: 'web',
          name: 'Web 端',
          x: 100,
          y: 150,
          comboId: 'client-apps',
          data: { layer: 'client' },
        },
        {
          id: 'mobile',
          name: '移动端',
          x: 100,
          y: 255,
          comboId: 'client-apps',
          data: { layer: 'client' },
        },
        {
          id: 'console',
          name: '运营控制台',
          x: 100,
          y: 360,
          comboId: 'client-apps',
          data: { layer: 'client' },
        },
        {
          id: 'gateway',
          name: 'API 网关',
          x: 335,
          y: 255,
          comboId: 'service-layer',
          data: { layer: 'service' },
        },
        {
          id: 'auth',
          name: '认证服务',
          x: 500,
          y: 150,
          comboId: 'service-layer',
          data: { layer: 'service' },
        },
        {
          id: 'order',
          name: '订单服务',
          x: 500,
          y: 255,
          comboId: 'service-layer',
          data: { layer: 'service' },
        },
        {
          id: 'worker',
          name: '异步任务',
          x: 500,
          y: 360,
          comboId: 'service-layer',
          data: { layer: 'service' },
        },
        {
          id: 'cache',
          name: 'Redis 缓存',
          x: 720,
          y: 150,
          comboId: 'data-layer',
          data: { layer: 'data' },
        },
        {
          id: 'mysql',
          name: 'MySQL',
          x: 720,
          y: 255,
          comboId: 'data-layer',
          data: { layer: 'data' },
        },
        {
          id: 'mq',
          name: '消息队列',
          x: 720,
          y: 360,
          comboId: 'data-layer',
          data: { layer: 'data' },
        },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'web', target: 'gateway' },
        { source: 'mobile', target: 'gateway' },
        { source: 'console', target: 'gateway' },
        { source: 'gateway', target: 'auth' },
        { source: 'gateway', target: 'order' },
        { source: 'gateway', target: 'worker' },
        { source: 'auth', target: 'cache' },
        { source: 'order', target: 'mysql' },
        { source: 'worker', target: 'mq' },
      ],
      combos: [
        {
          id: 'client-apps',
          data: { name: '客户端' },
          style: {
            fill: 'rgba(104, 145, 205, 0.08)',
            stroke: 'rgba(104, 145, 205, 0.42)',
            padding: 38,
          },
        },
        {
          id: 'business-platform',
          data: { name: '业务平台' },
          style: {
            fill: 'rgba(112, 132, 160, 0.045)',
            stroke: 'rgba(112, 132, 160, 0.28)',
            padding: 24,
            labelFontSize: 13,
          },
        },
        {
          id: 'service-layer',
          parentId: 'business-platform',
          data: { name: '服务层' },
          style: {
            fill: 'rgba(91, 158, 130, 0.08)',
            stroke: 'rgba(91, 158, 130, 0.4)',
            padding: 38,
          },
        },
        {
          id: 'data-layer',
          parentId: 'business-platform',
          data: { name: '数据层' },
          style: {
            fill: 'rgba(205, 155, 82, 0.09)',
            stroke: 'rgba(205, 155, 82, 0.42)',
            padding: 38,
          },
        },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        size: 18,
        fill: (node) => NODE_COLORS[String(node.data?.layer)] ?? '#9CA3AF',
        stroke: '#FFFFFF',
        strokeWidth: 2,
        label: (node) =>
          node.name ?? (node.data?.label as string | undefined) ?? node.id,
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelOffsetY: 4,
        labelFontSize: 11,
        labelColor: '#475569',
      },
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { stroke: '#3B82F6', strokeWidth: 3 },
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'cubic',
      style: {
        stroke: 'rgba(115, 137, 166, 0.58)',
        lineWidth: 1.2,
        endArrow: false,
      },
    },
    combo: {
      style: {
        borderRadius: 12,
        label: (combo) =>
          (combo.data as Record<string, string> | undefined)?.name ?? combo.id,
        labelPlacement: 'inside',
        labelFontSize: 12,
        labelColor: '#526071',
        collapsedType: 'rect',
        collapsedSize: [72, 38],
        count: false,
        stateStyles: {
          selected: { stroke: '#3B82F6', strokeWidth: 2 },
          active: { stroke: '#60A5FA', strokeWidth: 2 },
        },
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node', 'click-select'],
  });

  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView(0.82);

  const ui = createDemoPanel(containerEl, '点击分组背景可折叠或展开');
  let consoleInService = false;
  let runtimeCreated = false;

  ui.addAction('全部折叠', () => {
    graph.collapseCombo('client-apps');
    graph.collapseCombo('business-platform');
    if (runtimeCreated) graph.collapseCombo('observability');
    ui.setStatus('已折叠顶层分组');
  });

  ui.addAction('全部展开', () => {
    graph.expandCombo('business-platform');
    graph.expandCombo('client-apps');
    graph.expandCombo('service-layer');
    graph.expandCombo('data-layer');
    if (runtimeCreated) graph.expandCombo('observability');
    ui.setStatus('已展开全部分组');
  });

  const toggleGroup = (comboId: string) => {
    graph.toggleCombo(comboId);
    const group = graph.getComboData(comboId);
    ui.setStatus(`${group?.data?.name ?? comboId}${group?.collapsed ? '已折叠' : '已展开'}`);
  };

  graph.on('combo:click', ({ comboId }) => toggleGroup(comboId));
  const more = ui.gui.addFolder('更多').close();
  ui.addAction('切换数据层', () => {
    graph.expandCombo('business-platform');
    toggleGroup('data-layer');
  }, more);

  const consoleButton = ui.addAction('控制台加入服务层', () => {
    graph.expandCombo('business-platform');
    graph.expandCombo('service-layer');
    if (consoleInService) {
      graph.addToCombo('console', 'client-apps');
      consoleButton.name('控制台加入服务层');
      ui.setStatus('运营控制台已回到客户端');
    } else {
      graph.addToCombo('console', 'service-layer');
      consoleButton.name('控制台回到客户端');
      ui.setStatus('运营控制台已加入服务层');
    }
    consoleInService = !consoleInService;
  }, more);

  const runtimeButton = ui.addAction('创建可观测分组', () => {
    if (runtimeCreated) return;
    graph.addNodes([
      {
        id: 'logs',
        x: 570,
        y: 455,
        data: { layer: 'observability', label: '日志采集' },
      },
      {
        id: 'metrics',
        x: 720,
        y: 455,
        data: { layer: 'observability', label: '指标监控' },
      },
    ]);
    graph.createCombo(
      {
        id: 'observability',
        data: { name: '可观测性', source: 'createCombo' },
        style: {
          fill: 'rgba(134, 126, 176, 0.08)',
          stroke: 'rgba(134, 126, 176, 0.42)',
          padding: 32,
          label: '可观测性',
          labelPlacement: 'inside',
          labelColor: '#645F83',
          collapsedType: 'rect',
          collapsedSize: [84, 38],
          count: false,
        },
      },
      ['logs', 'metrics'],
    );
    runtimeCreated = true;
    runtimeButton.name('已创建可观测分组').disable();
    graph.fitView(0.78);
    ui.setStatus('createCombo() 已执行');
  }, more);

  ui.addAction('导出数据', () => {
    const data = graph.getData();
    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], { type: 'application/json' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.href = url;
    link.download = 'g6lite-combo-data.json';
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    ui.setStatus(`${data.nodes.length} 节点 · ${data.combos?.length ?? 0} 分组`);
  }, more);

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```

- [Combo 指南](/docs/guides/combo)
- [Combo 方法](/docs/api/graph#graph-combo)
- [Combo 配置](/docs/api/options#options-combo)

# 右键菜单 (/docs/examples/context-menu)





在节点上打开右键菜单，执行聚焦或高亮。

## 如何体验

在节点上右键，选择聚焦或高亮。

## 数据说明

三个流程节点响应 node:contextmenu。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: open a node context menu from node:contextmenu.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  host.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: host,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'design', data: { label: '设计' }, x: 180, y: 160 },
        { id: 'review', data: { label: '评审' }, x: 380, y: 160 },
        { id: 'build', data: { label: '实现' }, x: 560, y: 160 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'design', target: 'review' },
        { source: 'review', target: 'build' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 88,
        height: 36,
        borderRadius: 8,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true, lineWidth: 1.5 } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 80 });

  const menu = new GUI({ container: host, title: '节点操作', width: 128 }).hide();
  const element = menu.domElement;
  element.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
  Object.assign(element.style, {
    position: 'absolute',
    zIndex: '30',
    maxWidth: '100%',
    maxHeight: '100%',
  });

  let activeId = '';
  const close = () => {
    menu.hide();
  };
  const addAction = (label: string, action: () => void) => {
    menu.add({
      [label]() {
        action();
        close();
      },
    }, label);
  };
  addAction('聚焦', () => graph.focusItem(activeId, 80));
  addAction('高亮', () => {
    for (const node of graph.getNodes()) graph.clearItemStates(node.id);
    graph.setItemState(activeId, 'selected', true);
  });

  graph.on('node:contextmenu', ({ nodeId, nativeEvent }) => {
    nativeEvent.preventDefault();
    activeId = nodeId;
    const bounds = host.getBoundingClientRect();
    menu.open().show();
    const x = Math.max(0, Math.min(nativeEvent.clientX - bounds.left, bounds.width - element.offsetWidth));
    const y = Math.max(0, Math.min(nativeEvent.clientY - bounds.top, bounds.height - element.offsetHeight));
    element.style.left = `${x}px`;
    element.style.top = `${y}px`;
  });
  graph.on('canvas:click', close);

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 80 }),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      menu.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [事件指南](/docs/guides/events)
- [事件参考](/docs/api/graph/events)

# 注册自定义交互 (/docs/examples/custom-behavior)





注册一个 Behavior：点击节点时选中它，点击画布时清除。

## 如何体验

点击节点选中它，点击空白画布清除选中。

## 数据说明

四个流程节点由自定义 pin-node Behavior 选中。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: register a behavior that selects the clicked node.
 */
import {
  Graph,
  register,
  type BehaviorExtension,
  type BehaviorOptions,
  type ExtensionContext,
} from '@antv/g6-lite';

const PIN_BEHAVIOR = 'pin-node' as const;

type PinBehaviorOptions = BehaviorOptions<typeof PIN_BEHAVIOR>;

function createPinBehavior(): BehaviorExtension<PinBehaviorOptions> {
  let context: ExtensionContext | undefined;
  return {
    init(nextContext) {
      context = nextContext;
    },
    getEvents() {
      return {
        'node:click': ({ nodeId }) => {
          if (!context) return;
          const stateMap = Object.fromEntries(
            context.data.getNodeIds().map((id) => [id, id === nodeId ? ['selected'] : []]),
          );
          context.state.setAll(stateMap);
        },
        'canvas:click': () => {
          if (!context) return;
          const stateMap = Object.fromEntries(context.data.getNodeIds().map((id) => [id, []]));
          context.state.setAll(stateMap);
        },
      };
    },
    destroy() {
      context = undefined;
    },
  };
}

register('behavior', PIN_BEHAVIOR, () => createPinBehavior());

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'inbox', data: { label: '收件箱' } },
        { id: 'draft', data: { label: '草稿' } },
        { id: 'sent', data: { label: '已发送' } },
        { id: 'archive', data: { label: '归档' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'inbox', target: 'draft' },
        { source: 'draft', target: 'sent' },
        { source: 'sent', target: 'archive' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 88,
        height: 36,
        borderRadius: 8,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true } },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', nodesep: 24, ranksep: 70, nodeSize: [88, 36] },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', { type: PIN_BEHAVIOR } satisfies PinBehaviorOptions],
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [自定义交互](/docs/guides/custom-behavior)
- [Behavior 参考](/docs/api/options#options-behaviors)

# 自定义标签渲染 (/docs/examples/custom-label-renderer)





节点和边共用一个自定义 Label Renderer。

## 如何体验

查看节点和边上的多行自定义标签。

## 数据说明

节点和边使用同一个多行标签渲染器。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: unified custom node/edge LabelRenderer lifecycle.
 * The multiline behavior lives entirely in this demo, not in G6Lite core.
 */
import { Graph, register, type LabelRenderer } from '@antv/g6-lite';

interface MultilineLayoutData {
  lines: string[];
  lineHeight: number;
  contentWidth: number;
}

// #region renderer
const multilineRenderer: LabelRenderer<MultilineLayoutData> = {
  measure({ ctx, text, style }) {
    ctx.font = `${style.labelFontWeight} ${style.labelFontSize}px ${style.labelFontFamily}`;
    const lines = text.split('\n');
    const lineHeight = style.labelFontSize * 1.2;
    const contentWidth = Math.max(...lines.map((line) => ctx.measureText(line).width));
    const padding = style.labelBackgroundPadding;
    return {
      width: contentWidth + padding * 2,
      height: lines.length * lineHeight + padding * 2,
      data: { lines, lineHeight, contentWidth },
    };
  },
  draw({ ctx, style, layout }) {
    const data = layout.data;
    if (!data) return;
    if (style.labelBackground) {
      ctx.fillStyle = style.labelBackground;
      ctx.fillRect(-layout.width / 2, -layout.height / 2, layout.width, layout.height);
    }
    ctx.font = `${style.labelFontWeight} ${style.labelFontSize}px ${style.labelFontFamily}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = style.labelColor;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    data.lines.forEach((line, index) => {
      const y = (index - (data.lines.length - 1) / 2) * data.lineHeight;
      ctx.fillText(line, 0, y);
    });
  },
};

register('label', 'demo-multiline', multilineRenderer);
// #endregion renderer

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    // Labels are two lines and hang below nodes (labelPlacement: 'bottom');
    // the bottom padding reserves their height so they stay inside the view.
    autoFit: { padding: [24, 48, 64, 48] },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'source', data: { label: 'Source Service\nShanghai' } },
        { id: 'gateway', data: { label: 'API Gateway\nPrimary' } },
        { id: 'target', data: { label: 'Target Store\nHangzhou' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'source', target: 'gateway', data: { label: 'HTTPS\nrequest' } },
        { source: 'gateway', target: 'target', data: { label: 'RPC\nresponse' } },
      ],
    },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', nodeSize: 32, ranksep: 180 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node'],
    // #region node-label
    node: {
      labelRenderer: 'demo-multiline',
      style: {
        size: 32,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)',
        labelBackgroundPadding: 4,
      },
    },
    // #endregion node-label
    // #region edge-label
    edge: {
      type: 'arc',
      labelRenderer: 'demo-multiline',
      style: {
        label: (_source, _target, edge) => String(edge.data?.label ?? ''),
        labelFontSize: 10,
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)',
        labelBackgroundPadding: 3,
        labelAutoRotate: true,
      },
    },
    // #endregion edge-label
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [自定义标签](/docs/guides/custom-label-renderer)
- [绘制契约](/docs/api/extensions#extension-drawing)

# 自定义布局 (/docs/examples/custom-layout)





注册一个把节点排成两行的布局扩展。

## 如何体验

查看由自定义布局算出的两行坐标。

## 数据说明

六个流程节点由 two-row 布局排成两行。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: register a layout extension that places nodes in two rows.
 */
import { Graph, register, type LayoutExtension } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const TWO_ROW_LAYOUT = 'two-row';

const twoRowLayout: LayoutExtension = {
  execute(data) {
    const columns = Math.ceil(data.nodes.length / 2);
    return {
      nodes: data.nodes.map((node, index) => ({
        ...node,
        x: 120 + (index % columns) * 150,
        y: 140 + Math.floor(index / columns) * 150,
      })),
    };
  },
};

register('layout', TWO_ROW_LAYOUT, () => ({ ...twoRowLayout }));

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: ['采集', '清洗', '特征', '训练', '评估', '发布'].map((label) => ({
        id: label,
        data: { label },
      })),
      edges: [
        { source: '采集', target: '清洗' },
        { source: '清洗', target: '特征' },
        { source: '特征', target: '训练' },
        { source: '训练', target: '评估' },
        { source: '评估', target: '发布' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5AD8A6',
        width: 72,
        height: 36,
        borderRadius: 18,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true, stroke: '#8C8C8C' } },
    layout: { type: TWO_ROW_LAYOUT },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```

# 自定义节点与显式边 ID (/docs/examples/custom-node-extension)





注册自定义节点，并使用显式边 ID 与 Combo 状态。

## 如何体验

点击边或 Combo，查看显式 ID 和状态。

## 数据说明

自定义节点、显式边 ID 和 Combo 放在同一张图里。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Custom node extension demo.
 * Demonstrates: function-style node registration, explicit edge IDs, and shared element state methods for Combos.
 */

import { Graph, register, type NodeExtension } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const statusBadgeNode: NodeExtension = {
  base: 'rect',
  style: {
    size: 42,
    width: 96,
    height: 34,
    borderRadius: 8,
    strokeWidth: 2,
    label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
    labelPlacement: 'center' as const,
    labelFontSize: 11,
    labelColor: '#fff',
    iconType: 'text' as const,
    icon: (node) => String(node.data?.icon ?? ''),
    iconFontSize: 13,
    iconColor: '#fff',
    iconOffsetX: -32,
  },

  getStyle(node: { data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
    const role = node.data?.role;
    if (role === 'entry') return { fill: '#2E8B57', stroke: '#1F6B43' };
    if (role === 'compute') return { fill: '#D8911B', stroke: '#A86E12' };
    if (role === 'storage') return { fill: '#4E6E8E', stroke: '#35506B' };
    return { fill: '#64748b', stroke: '#475569' };
  },
};

register('node', 'status-badge-node', statusBadgeNode);

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'gateway', comboId: 'demo-combo', data: { label: 'Gateway', role: 'entry', icon: 'G' }, states: ['selected'] },
        { id: 'worker-a', comboId: 'demo-combo', data: { label: 'Worker A', role: 'compute', icon: 'A' } },
        { id: 'worker-b', comboId: 'demo-combo', data: { label: 'Worker B', role: 'compute', icon: 'B' } },
        { id: 'store', comboId: 'demo-combo', data: { label: 'Store', role: 'storage', icon: 'S' } },
        { id: 'index', comboId: 'demo-combo', data: { label: 'Index', role: 'storage', icon: 'I' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'edge-gateway-worker-a', source: 'gateway', target: 'worker-a' },
        { id: 'edge-gateway-worker-b', source: 'gateway', target: 'worker-b' },
        { id: 'edge-worker-a-store', source: 'worker-a', target: 'store' },
        { id: 'edge-worker-b-index', source: 'worker-b', target: 'index' },
      ],
      combos: [
        { id: 'demo-combo', data: { name: 'Demo Combo' } },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'status-badge-node',
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { stroke: '#003eb3', strokeWidth: 3, haloWidth: 16 },
        active: { stroke: '#1677ff', strokeWidth: 3 },
        highlight: { stroke: '#1677ff', strokeWidth: 3 },
      },
    },
    edge: {
      style: {
        stroke: '#9ca3af',
        lineWidth: 2,
        endArrow: true,
        label: (_s, _t, edge) => edge.id ?? '',
        labelFontSize: 10,
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.86)',
      },
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { stroke: '#1677ff', lineWidth: 3 },
      },
    },
    combo: {
      style: {
        padding: 42,
        borderRadius: 10,
        fill: 'rgba(22, 119, 255, 0.06)',
        stroke: 'rgba(22, 119, 255, 0.28)',
        label: (combo) => String(combo.data?.name ?? combo.id),
        labelFontSize: 13,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', nodesep: 45, ranksep: 90, nodeSize: [96, 34] },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node', 'click-select', 'hover-highlight'],
  });

  await graph.render();
  graph.setItemState('demo-combo', 'selected', true);

  const containerEl =
    typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;

  const ui = createDemoPanel(containerEl, 'demo-combo states: selected');
  ui.addAction('切换 Combo 状态', () => {
    const selected = graph.getItemStates('demo-combo').includes('selected');
    graph.setItemState('demo-combo', 'selected', !selected);
    ui.setStatus(`demo-combo states: ${graph.getItemStates('demo-combo').join(', ') || '(none)'}`);
  });
  ui.addAction('选中显式边 ID', () => {
    graph.setItemState('edge-worker-a-store', 'selected', true);
    ui.setStatus('selected edgeId: edge-worker-a-store');
  });

  graph.on('edge:click', (payload: { edgeId?: string }) => {
    ui.setStatus(`edge:click edgeId=${payload.edgeId}`);
  });
  graph.on('combo:click', (payload: { comboId: string }) => {
    ui.setStatus(`combo:click comboId=${payload.comboId}`);
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [自定义节点](/docs/guides/custom-node)
- [绘制契约](/docs/api/extensions#extension-drawing)

# 节点与边增删改 (/docs/examples/data-mutations)





集中演示节点和边的单个、批量新增、更新和删除。

## 如何体验

先 addNode 再 addEdge；节点数由 3 变为 4，边数由 2 变为 3。removeNode 同时移除关联边，重置恢复初始数据。

## 数据说明

在一份小型业务关系数据上持续执行增量更新。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph, type GraphData } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const INITIAL_DATA: GraphData = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'a', x: 120, y: 160, data: { label: 'A', color: '#5B8FF9' } },
    { id: 'b', x: 300, y: 90, data: { label: 'B', color: '#5AD8A6' } },
    { id: 'c', x: 300, y: 230, data: { label: 'C', color: '#F6BD16' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e-a-b', source: 'a', target: 'b', data: { weight: 1 } },
    { id: 'e-a-c', source: 'a', target: 'c', data: { weight: 2 } },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: INITIAL_DATA,
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        size: 34,
        fill: (node) => String(node.data?.color ?? '#5B8FF9'),
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#94a3b8',
        lineWidth: (_source, _target, edge) => Number(edge.data?.weight ?? 1) + 1,
        endArrow: true,
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 80 });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  let lastEvent = 'ready';
  let sequence = 0;
  const renderStatus = () => {
    const snapshot = graph.getData();
    ui.setStatus(
      `nodes=${graph.getNodeCount()} edges=${graph.getEdgeCount()}\n` +
        `ids=${snapshot.nodes.map((node) => node.id).join(', ')}\n` +
        `last=${lastEvent}`,
    );
  };

  for (const event of ['afteradditem', 'afterupdateitem', 'afterremoveitem'] as const) {
    graph.on(event, (payload: { type: string; id: string; action?: string }) => {
      lastEvent = `${event}: ${payload.type}:${payload.id}${payload.action ? ` (${payload.action})` : ''}`;
      renderStatus();
    });
  }

  ui.addAction('addNode', () => {
    if (!graph.hasNode('d')) graph.addNode({ id: 'd', x: 480, y: 160, data: { label: 'D', color: '#E8684A' } });
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('addEdge', () => {
    if (graph.hasNode('d') && !graph.hasEdge('e-c-d')) {
      graph.addEdge({ id: 'e-c-d', source: 'c', target: 'd', data: { weight: 3 } });
    }
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('updateNodeData', () => {
    sequence++;
    graph.updateNodeData('b', {
      label: `B${sequence}`,
      color: sequence % 2 ? '#9270CA' : '#5AD8A6',
    });
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('updateEdgeData', () => {
    graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: 'e-a-c', data: { weight: (sequence % 4) + 1 } }]);
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('批量新增', () => {
    if (!graph.hasNode('e')) {
      graph.addNodes([
        { id: 'e', x: 480, y: 70, data: { label: 'E', color: '#6DC8EC' } },
        { id: 'f', x: 480, y: 250, data: { label: 'F', color: '#FF9D4D' } },
      ]);
      graph.addEdges([
        { id: 'e-b-e', source: 'b', target: 'e', data: { weight: 1 } },
        { id: 'e-c-f', source: 'c', target: 'f', data: { weight: 1 } },
      ]);
    }
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('removeEdge', () => {
    const edgeId = graph.hasEdge('e-c-d') ? 'e-c-d' : graph.hasEdge('e-a-c') ? 'e-a-c' : '';
    if (edgeId) graph.removeEdge(edgeId);
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('removeNode', () => {
    const nodeId = graph.hasNode('d') ? 'd' : graph.hasNode('f') ? 'f' : '';
    if (nodeId) graph.removeNode(nodeId);
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('重置', async () => {
    await graph.setData(INITIAL_DATA, { fitView: { padding: 80 } });
    lastEvent = 'datachange: reset';
    renderStatus();
  });

  renderStatus();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [写入方法](/docs/api/graph#graph-data-mutations)
- [查询模型](/docs/api/graph#graph-data)
- [数据接入与更新](/docs/guides/data)

# 节点徽章 (/docs/examples/decoration-badges)





在节点边界堆叠计数、状态和文本徽章。

## 如何体验

订单节点有 5 项，初始显示两项与溢出入口；悬停 ··· 展开全部 5 项，移开恢复。刷新后仍只有一套徽章。

## 数据说明

三个节点在边界上堆叠内置徽章。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: stack built-in badges on a node boundary.
 */
import { Graph, type NodeBadgeItem } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    // Padding covers the boundary badges extending past the rightmost node.
    autoFit: { padding: 56 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        {
          id: 'orders',
          data: {
            label: '订单',
            badges: [
              { kind: 'count', value: 12 },
              { kind: 'warning' },
              { kind: 'text', text: '优先' },
              { kind: 'lock' },
              { kind: 'favorite' },
            ] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[],
          },
        },
        {
          id: 'users',
          data: {
            label: '用户',
            badges: [
              { kind: 'favorite' },
              { kind: 'lock' },
            ] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[],
          },
        },
        { id: 'audit', data: { label: '审计', badges: [{ kind: 'count', value: 3 }] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[] } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'users', target: 'orders' },
        { source: 'orders', target: 'audit' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: { size: 56, fill: '#5B8FF9', label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' },
      decorations: [
        {
          renderer: 'builtin-badge',
          placement: 'right',
          attachment: 'boundary',
          anchor: 'start',
          boundaryOverlap: 'half-badge',
          layout: 'stack',
          items: (node) => (node.data?.badges as NodeBadgeItem[] | undefined) ?? [],
          maxVisible: 3,
          overflow: 'hover-expand',
          overflowData: { kind: 'text', text: '···' },
        },
      ],
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true, stroke: '#99ADD1' } },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', nodesep: 40, ranksep: 120, nodeSize: 56 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```

## 操作与预期 [#操作与预期]

1. 初始时，“订单”有 5 项徽章数据，`maxVisible: 3` 使其显示计数、警告和 `···`；其余 3 项收起。“用户”的 2 项和“审计”的 1 项全部显示。
2. 将鼠标移入“订单”右侧的 `···`，应展开全部 5 项；移出展开区域后恢复折叠。
3. 在源码中把 `maxVisible` 改为 `5`，点击“运行”，应直接显示全部徽章；点击“重置”恢复原例。

关键配置在 `node.decorations[]`：`items` 按节点读取业务数据，`anchor` 与 `boundaryOverlap` 控制边界对齐，`overflowData` 提供可悬停的占位项。徽章和节点标签分别配置。

用法见[节点指南](/docs/guides/node)与[装饰扩展](/docs/guides/extensions#decoration-renderer)；完整定义见[节点装饰配置参考](/docs/api/options#config-node-decoration)。


## 继续阅读

- [节点装饰](/docs/guides/custom-decoration)
- [节点参考](/docs/api/options#options-node)

# 默认主题与交互状态 (/docs/examples/default-theme)





并排检查 light、dark 预设主题，以及节点和边的默认状态表现。

## 如何体验

切换节点、边类型或单独查看某个主题，并使用平滑滚轮缩放。

## 数据说明

6 个节点与 6 条边分别承载 default、active、selected、highlight、inactive、disabled 状态。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: default light/dark theme, built-in states, node shapes, and edge shapes.
 */
import {
  Graph,
  type EdgeLabelPlacement,
  type EdgeState,
  type NodeState,
} from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

type NodeType = 'circle' | 'rect';
type EdgeType = 'line' | 'arc' | 'cubic' | 'polyline';
type ThemeName = 'light' | 'dark';

const nodeStates: Array<{ state: NodeState; label: string }> = [
  { state: 'default', label: 'Default' },
  { state: 'active', label: 'Active' },
  { state: 'selected', label: 'Selected' },
  { state: 'highlight', label: 'Highlight' },
  { state: 'inactive', label: 'Inactive' },
  { state: 'disabled', label: 'Disabled' },
];

const edgeStates: EdgeState[] = ['default', 'selected', 'highlight', 'inactive', 'disabled', 'active'];
const edgeLabelPlacements: EdgeLabelPlacement[] = ['end', 'center', 'start'];

const data = {
  nodes: [
    ...nodeStates.map(({ state, label }, index) => ({
      id: `node-${state}`,
      data: { label },
      x: index % 2 === 0 ? 60 : 260,
      y: 48 + Math.floor(index / 2) * 200,
      states: state === 'default' ? undefined : [state],
    })),
    ...edgeStates.flatMap((state, index) => [
      {
        id: `edge-${state}-source`,
        data: { sampleAnchor: true },
        x: 340,
        y: 48 + index * 62,
      },
      {
        id: `edge-${state}-target`,
        data: { sampleAnchor: true },
        x: 520,
        y: 48 + index * 62,
      },
    ]),
  ],
  edges: edgeStates.map((state, index) => ({
    id: `edge-${state}`,
    source: `edge-${state}-source`,
    target: `edge-${state}-target`,
    data: {
      label: state === 'default' ? 'Default edge' : state,
      placement: edgeLabelPlacements[index % edgeLabelPlacements.length],
    },
    states: state === 'default' ? undefined : [state],
  })),
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const root =
    typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  root.replaceChildren();
  root.style.cssText =
    'position:relative;display:flex;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;font-family:system-ui;';

  const grid = document.createElement('div');
  grid.style.cssText =
    'flex:1;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;padding:48px 12px 12px;';
  root.append(grid);

  const graphCards = new Map<ThemeName, { card: HTMLElement; surface: HTMLElement }>();
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    const card = document.createElement('section');
    card.style.cssText =
      'min-width:0;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.08);';
    const cardHeader = document.createElement('div');
    cardHeader.style.cssText =
      'height:38px;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 13px;background:#fff;color:#0f172a;font-size:12px;';
    cardHeader.innerHTML = `<strong>${theme === 'light' ? 'Light preset' : 'Dark preset'}</strong><code style="color:#64748b">theme: '${theme}'</code>`;
    const surface = document.createElement('div');
    surface.style.cssText = 'position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0;';
    card.append(cardHeader, surface);
    grid.appendChild(card);
    graphCards.set(theme, { card, surface });
  }

  let graphs: Graph[] = [];
  let nodeType: NodeType = 'circle';
  let edgeType: EdgeType = 'line';

  const renderGraphs = async () => {
    graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.destroy());
    graphs = [];
    for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
      const surface = graphCards.get(theme)!.surface;
      surface.replaceChildren();
      const graph = new Graph({
        autoFit: true,
        container: surface,
        data,
        node: {
          type: nodeType,
          style: {
            size: 44,
            opacity: (node) => (node.data?.sampleAnchor === true ? 0 : 1),
            label: (node) =>
              node.data?.sampleAnchor === true ? false : String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
            labelPlacement: 'bottom',
            labelColor: theme === 'light' ? '#334155' : '#dbeafe',
          },
        },
        edge: {
          type: edgeType,
          style: {
            curvature: edgeType === 'arc' ? 0.22 : 0,
            curveOffset: edgeType === 'cubic' ? 42 : 0,
            radius: edgeType === 'polyline' ? 10 : 0,
            label: (_source, _target, edge) => String(edge.data?.label ?? edge.id),
            labelPlacement: (_source, _target, edge) =>
              (edge.data?.placement as EdgeLabelPlacement | undefined) ?? 'center',
            labelColor: theme === 'light' ? '#475569' : '#dbeafe',
            labelBackground:
              theme === 'light' ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)' : 'rgba(26,26,26,0.9)',
          },
        },
        label: { scaleWithZoom: false, hideOnLowZoom: false },
        behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
        theme,
      });
      await graph.render();
      graph.fitView({ padding: 24 });
      graphs.push(graph);
    }
  };

  const fitGraphs = () => {
    graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.fitView({ padding: 24 }));
  };

  const updateView = (view: string) => {
    for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
      graphCards.get(theme)!.card.style.display =
        view === 'light + dark' || view === theme ? 'flex' : 'none';
    }
    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = view === 'light + dark' ? '1fr 1fr' : '1fr';
  };

  await renderGraphs();
  updateView('light + dark');
  const ui = createDemoPanel(root);
  ui.addChoice<NodeType>('Node', ['circle', 'rect'], nodeType, (value) => {
    nodeType = value;
    void renderGraphs();
  });
  ui.addChoice<EdgeType>('Edge', ['line', 'arc', 'cubic', 'polyline'], edgeType, (value) => {
    edgeType = value;
    void renderGraphs();
  });
  ui.addChoice('View', ['light + dark', 'light', 'dark'], 'light + dark', updateView);

  return {
    getData: () => ({ views: graphs.map((graph) => graph.getData()) }),
    fitView() {
      fitGraphs();
    },
    destroy() {
      ui.destroy();
      graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.destroy());
      graphs = [];
      root.replaceChildren();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [主题指南](/docs/guides/theme)
- [状态方法](/docs/api/graph#graph-states)

# 调用链 (/docs/examples/dependency-graph)





用从左到右的层级布局展示服务之间的调用关系。

## 如何体验

悬停服务节点，查看上下游高亮。

## 数据说明

服务节点按调用方向从左向右排列。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: a left-to-right service call chain.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const CALLS: Array<[string, string, string]> = [
  ['gateway', '网关', 'auth'],
  ['auth', '鉴权', 'user'],
  ['auth', '鉴权', 'order'],
  ['user', '用户', 'profile'],
  ['order', '订单', 'inventory'],
  ['order', '订单', 'payment'],
  ['inventory', '库存', 'warehouse'],
  ['payment', '支付', 'ledger'],
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const nodes = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const [source, sourceLabel, target] of CALLS) nodes.set(source, sourceLabel);
  nodes.set('profile', '资料');
  nodes.set('warehouse', '仓库');
  nodes.set('ledger', '账本');

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [...nodes].map(([id, label]) => ({ id, data: { label } })),
      edges: CALLS.map(([source, , target]) => ({ source, target })),
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 84,
        height: 34,
        borderRadius: 8,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true, stroke: '#99ADD1', lineWidth: 1.5 } },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', nodesep: 24, ranksep: 64, nodeSize: [84, 34] },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [布局选择](/docs/guides/layout)
- [布局参考](/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# 拖拽边端点 (/docs/examples/drag-edge)





把边的端点拖到另一个节点上，完成重新连线。

## 如何体验

按住边靠近端点的位置，拖到另一个节点上松开。

## 数据说明

两条带端点的边可以拖到其他节点上。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 120, y: 160, data: { label: 'A' } },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 80, data: { label: 'B' } },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 240, data: { label: 'C' } },
        { id: 'd', x: 560, y: 160, data: { label: 'D' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'editable-edge', source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { id: 'reference-edge', source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 38, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' } },
    edge: { style: { lineWidth: 4, hitAreaWidth: 16, endArrow: true } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-edge'],
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  graph.on('edge:dragstart', (payload: { edgeId?: string; dragEnd: string }) => {
    ui.setStatus(`dragstart ${payload.edgeId ?? '-'} (${payload.dragEnd})`);
  });
  // #region reconnect
  graph.on('edge:dragend', ({ edgeId, source, target, reconnected }) => {
    if (reconnected && edgeId) {
      graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: edgeId, source, target }]);
    }
    ui.setStatus(`dragend reconnected=${reconnected}\n${edgeId ?? '-'}: ${source} → ${target}`);
  });
  // #endregion reconnect

  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [交互组合](/docs/guides/behaviors)
- [Behavior 参考](/docs/api/options#options-behaviors)

# 拖拽节点与 Combo (/docs/examples/drag-node)





拖拽单个节点，或拖拽 Combo 背景带动其中的节点。

## 如何体验

拖拽节点改变位置，拖拽 Combo 空白处移动整组。

## 数据说明

一个 Combo 包住两个客户端节点，旁边是独立服务节点。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: drag individual nodes, and drag a combo by its background.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'web', data: { label: 'Web' }, x: 160, y: 150, comboId: 'clients' },
        { id: 'app', data: { label: 'App' }, x: 160, y: 250, comboId: 'clients' },
        { id: 'api', data: { label: 'API' }, x: 380, y: 200 },
        { id: 'db', data: { label: 'DB' }, x: 560, y: 140 },
        { id: 'cache', data: { label: 'Cache' }, x: 560, y: 270 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'web', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'app', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'api', target: 'db' },
        { source: 'api', target: 'cache' },
      ],
      combos: [{ id: 'clients', data: { label: '客户端' } }],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 72,
        height: 32,
        borderRadius: 8,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2' } },
    },
    combo: {
      style: {
        label: (combo) => String(combo.data?.label ?? combo.id),
        labelPlacement: 'top',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true, stroke: '#99ADD1' } },
    // #region drag-options
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
      'drag-node',
    ],
    // #endregion drag-options
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    graph.fitView({ padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 });
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```

# 边与箭头方向 (/docs/examples/edge-arrows)





比较无箭头、单向、双向和粗边箭头。

## 如何体验

直接对照不同边样式和方向表达。

## 数据说明

4 组边分别映射不同方向和宽度。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Arrow directions - none / forward / bidirectional
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function runGraph(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'n1', name: 'No arrow', x: 80, y: 120 },
        { id: 't1', name: '', x: 280, y: 120 },
        { id: 'n2', name: 'Forward', x: 400, y: 120 },
        { id: 't2', name: '', x: 600, y: 120 },
        { id: 'n3', name: 'Bidirectional', x: 80, y: 280 },
        { id: 't3', name: '', x: 280, y: 280 },
        { id: 'n4', name: 'Thick + arrow', x: 400, y: 280 },
        { id: 't4', name: '', x: 600, y: 280 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'n1', target: 't1', data: { dir: 'none' } },
        { source: 'n2', target: 't2', data: { dir: 'forward' } },
        { source: 'n3', target: 't3', data: { dir: 'both' } },
        { source: 'n4', target: 't4', data: { dir: 'forward', lw: 6 } },
      ],
    },
    node: { type: 'circle', style: { fill: '#5B8FF9', size: 24, label: (node) => node.name ?? '' } },
    // #region arrow-options
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#99ADD1',
        lineWidth: (_source, _target, edge) => Number(edge.data?.lw ?? 2),
        endArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.dir !== 'none',
        startArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.dir === 'both',
      },
    },
    // #endregion arrow-options
    theme: 'light',
  });

  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = await runGraph(container);
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```

- [边配置](/docs/guides/edge)
- [边参考](/docs/api/options#options-edge)

# 边颜色 (/docs/examples/edge-colors)





按业务分类给边映射颜色。

## 如何体验

边颜色来自数据里的分类字段。

## 数据说明

边颜色来自数据中的分类序号。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Edge colors - category palette
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const PALETTE = ['#1783FF', '#00C9C9', '#F08F56', '#D580FF', '#7863FF', '#DB9D0D', '#60C42D', '#FF80CA', '#2491B3', '#17C76F'];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const nodes: { id: string; name: string; x: number; y: number }[] = [];
  const edges: { source: string; target: string; data: { idx: number } }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    const x = 60 + i * 100;
    nodes.push({ id: `s${i}`, name: PALETTE[i].slice(1, 4), x, y: 60 });
    nodes.push({ id: `t${i}`, name: '', x, y: 200 });
    edges.push({ source: `s${i}`, target: `t${i}`, data: { idx: i } });
  }

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: { nodes, edges },
    node: { type: 'circle', style: { fill: '#5B8FF9', size: 20 } },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: (_s: any, _t: any, e: any) => PALETTE[e.data?.idx % PALETTE.length],
        lineWidth: 3,
        endArrow: true,
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [边配置](/docs/guides/edge)
- [边参考](/docs/api/options#options-edge)

# 交互热区 (/docs/examples/edge-hit-area)





保持细线外观，同时扩大直线、曲线和自环的拾取范围。

## 如何体验

把指针移近细边，确认热区比视觉线宽更大。

## 数据说明

视觉线宽保持很细，命中宽度单独加大。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const EDGE_TYPES = [
  { type: 'line' as const, title: '直线 + 箭头' },
  { type: 'arc' as const, title: '弧线 / 平行边' },
  { type: 'cubic' as const, title: '三次曲线' },
  { type: 'polyline' as const, title: '折线' },
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const root =
    typeof container === 'string' ? (document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement) : container;
  const graphs: Graph[] = [];
  const board = document.createElement('div');
  board.style.cssText =
    'display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;width:100%;height:calc(100% - 36px);padding:8px;box-sizing:border-box;';
  root.appendChild(board);

  const ui = createDemoPanel(root, '边保持 1.5px 视觉宽度，但中心线两侧约 8px 都可悬停或点击。缩放后屏幕热区保持不变。');

  for (const [index, item] of EDGE_TYPES.entries()) {
    const panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
    panel.style.cssText = 'position:relative;min-height:0;';
    const title = document.createElement('div');
    title.textContent = item.title;
    title.style.cssText =
      'position:absolute;z-index:2;left:12px;top:10px;font:12px/1.5 system-ui;color:#475569;pointer-events:none;';
    const canvasHost = document.createElement('div');
    canvasHost.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;';
    panel.append(title, canvasHost);
    board.appendChild(panel);

    const sourceId = `source-${index}`;
    const targetId = `target-${index}`;
    const graph = new Graph({
      autoFit: true,
      container: canvasHost,
      data: {
        nodes: [
          { id: sourceId, x: 100, y: 120 },
          { id: targetId, x: 340, y: index === 2 || index === 3 ? 150 : 120 },
        ],
        edges: [
          { id: `edge-${index}`, source: sourceId, target: targetId },
          ...(item.type === 'line'
            ? [{ id: `loop-${index}`, source: sourceId, target: sourceId }]
            : []),
        ],
      },
      node: {
        type: 'circle',
        style: { size: 26, fill: '#1677ff', stroke: '#fff', strokeWidth: 2 },
      },
      edge: {
        type: item.type,
        style: {
          stroke: '#64748b',
          lineWidth: 1.5,
          hitAreaWidth: 16,
          endArrow: true,
          curvature: 0.35,
          curveOffset: 80,
          router: 'orth',
        },
        stateStyles: {
          highlight: { stroke: '#1677ff', lineWidth: 2 },
          selected: { stroke: '#873bf4', lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 20 },
        },
      },
      behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'highlight-edge', 'click-select'],
      theme: 'light',
    });
    graph.on('edge:pointerover', ({ edgeId }) => ui.setStatus(`hover: ${edgeId ?? '-'}`));
    graph.on('edge:pointerleave', () => ui.setStatus('move near a thin edge'));
    graph.on('edge:selectchange', ({ edgeId, selected }) =>
      ui.setStatus(`${selected ? 'selected' : 'unselected'}: ${edgeId ?? '-'}`),
    );
    await graph.render();
    graphs.push(graph);
  }

  ui.setStatus('move near a thin edge');
  return {
    getData: () => ({ views: graphs.map((graph) => graph.getData()) }),
    fitView: () => graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.fitView()),
    destroy: () => {
      graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.destroy());
      board.remove();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [边配置](/docs/guides/edge)
- [边参考](/docs/api/options#options-edge)

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {

    autoFit: true,

        { id: 'b', name: '3 nested', x: 400, y: 180 },
        { id: 'c', name: '5 nested', x: 650, y: 180 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'a' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'c' },

# 边状态与权重 (/docs/examples/edge-states)





用权重映射边宽，并查看边的状态样式。

## 如何体验

线宽随权重变化。

## 数据说明

边宽由权重字段决定。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: edge weight x state matrix
 *
 * 7 rows (default/level 1-6) x 6 columns (Default/Active/Selected/Disabled/Highlight/Inactive)
 * Aligned with design spec 2.1 + 2.2
 */
import { Graph, type EdgeState } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const states: EdgeState[] = ['default', 'active', 'selected', 'disabled', 'highlight', 'inactive'];
  const lineWidths = [1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12];

  const startX = 80;
  const gapX = 200;
  const startY = 80;
  const gapY = 80;
  const edgeLen = 120;

  const nodes: { id: string; name: string; x: number; y: number }[] = [];
  const edges: { source: string; target: string; states?: EdgeState[]; data?: Record<string, unknown> }[] = [];

  for (let row = 0; row < lineWidths.length; row++) {
    for (let col = 0; col < states.length; col++) {
      const state = states[col];
      const srcId = `r${row}-c${col}-src`;
      const tgtId = `r${row}-c${col}-tgt`;
      const x = startX + col * gapX;
      const y = startY + row * gapY;

      nodes.push({ id: srcId, name: [row === 0 ? state : '', col === 0 ? `${lineWidths[row]}px` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' / '), x, y });
      nodes.push({ id: tgtId, name: '', x: x + edgeLen, y });

      edges.push({
        source: srcId,
        target: tgtId,
        states: state === 'default' ? undefined : [state],
        data: { weight: row },
      });
    }
  }

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: { nodes, edges },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        size: 24,
        label: (node) => node.name ?? '',
        labelPlacement: 'top',
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#99ADD1',
        endArrow: true,
        lineWidth: (_src, _tgt, e) => {
          const w = (e.data as Record<string, number>)?.weight ?? 0;
          return lineWidths[w];
        },
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [边配置](/docs/guides/edge)
- [边参考](/docs/api/options#options-edge)

# 边类型 (/docs/examples/edge-types)





对比实线、虚线和两种弧线曲率。

## 如何体验

上排对比实线与虚线，下排对比 curvature 0.3 与 0.6；适应画布或刷新后保留这两组对照。

## 数据说明

两个视图各有 4 个节点、2 条边；下排两条边均为 arc，不是 cubic。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Edge types - solid / dashed / arc
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graphs: Graph[] = [];
  const root = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;

  // Line edges: solid + dashed
  const lineDiv = document.createElement('div');
  lineDiv.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  lineDiv.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;';
  root.appendChild(lineDiv);

  const g1 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: lineDiv,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 's1', name: 'Solid', x: 80, y: 80 },
        { id: 't1', name: '', x: 280, y: 80 },
        { id: 's2', name: 'Dashed', x: 400, y: 80 },
        { id: 't2', name: '', x: 600, y: 80 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 's1', target: 't1', data: { dash: false } },
        { source: 's2', target: 't2', data: { dash: true } },
      ],
    },
    node: { type: 'circle', style: { fill: '#5B8FF9', size: 24 } },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#99ADD1',
        lineWidth: 2,
        endArrow: true,
        lineDash: (_s: any, _t: any, e: any) => e.data?.dash ? [6, 4] : [],
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await g1.render();
  graphs.push(g1);

  // Arc edges
  const arcDiv = document.createElement('div');
  arcDiv.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  arcDiv.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;margin-top:16px;';
  root.appendChild(arcDiv);

  const g2 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: arcDiv,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a1', name: 'Arc', x: 80, y: 80 },
        { id: 'a2', name: '', x: 280, y: 80 },
        { id: 'a3', name: 'Arc wide', x: 400, y: 80 },
        { id: 'a4', name: '', x: 600, y: 80 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a1', target: 'a2', data: { c: 0.3 } },
        { source: 'a3', target: 'a4', data: { c: 0.6 } },
      ],
    },
    node: { type: 'circle', style: { fill: '#5B8FF9', size: 24 } },
    edge: {
      type: 'arc',
      style: {
        stroke: '#5B8FF9',
        lineWidth: 2,
        curvature: (_s: any, _t: any, e: any) => e.data?.c ?? 0.3,
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await g2.render();
  graphs.push(g2);

  return {
    getData: () => ({ views: graphs.map((graph) => graph.getData()) }),
    fitView: () => graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.fitView()),
    destroy: () => {
      graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.destroy());
      lineDiv.remove(); arcDiv.remove();
    },
  };
}
```
