- [边配置](/docs/guides/edge)
- [边参考](/docs/api/options#options-edge)

# 事件面板 (/docs/examples/event-log)





点击、拖拽和选择节点时，查看 Graph 发出的公开事件。

## 如何体验

点击或拖拽节点，左下角列出最近的事件。

## 数据说明

四个节点同时启用点击选择和拖拽。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: listen to click, drag, and selection events.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', data: { label: 'A' }, x: 140, y: 180 },
        { id: 'b', data: { label: 'B' }, x: 320, y: 100 },
        { id: 'c', data: { label: 'C' }, x: 320, y: 260 },
        { id: 'd', data: { label: 'D' }, x: 500, y: 180 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'a', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 36,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'click-select', 'drag-node'],
  });
  await graph.render();

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container, '点击或拖拽节点，查看最近的公开事件。');
  const lines: string[] = ['点击或拖拽节点'];
  const push = (line: string) => {
    lines.unshift(line);
    ui.setStatus(lines.slice(0, 4).join('\n'));
  };
  graph.on('node:click', ({ nodeId }) => push(`node:click ${nodeId}`));
  graph.on('node:dragend', ({ nodeId }) => push(`node:dragend ${nodeId}`));
  graph.on('node:selectchange', ({ nodeId, selected }) => push(`node:selectchange ${nodeId} ${selected}`));
  ui.setStatus(lines[0]);

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```

点击节点查看 node:selectchange，拖动节点查看 node:dragend；拖拽后的手势不会再触发一次节点 click。接入步骤见[事件指南](/docs/guides/events)，字段与时机查[事件参考](/docs/api/graph/events)。


## 继续阅读

- [事件指南](/docs/guides/events)
- [事件参考](/docs/api/graph/events)

# 扩展系统综合示例 (/docs/examples/extension-system)





组合验证 decoration、edge、layout、transform、behavior 和 plugin 扩展。

## 如何体验

点击节点切换大小，悬停 ··· 展开被收起的徽章。

## 数据说明

小型关系数据用于集中展示六类公开扩展点。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: public extension APIs working together without internal imports.
 */
import {
  Graph,
  register,
  type BehaviorExtension,
  type BehaviorOptions,
  type DecorationRenderer,
  type ElementState,
  type ExtensionContext,
  type GraphData,
  type GraphNode,
  type LayoutExtension,
  type NodeBadgeItem,
  type PluginExtension,
  type PluginOptions,
  type TransformExtension,
} from '@antv/g6-lite';

const externalNameRenderer: DecorationRenderer<string> = {
  measure({ ctx, data }) {
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
    return { width: ctx.measureText(data).width, height: 14 };
  },
  draw({ ctx, data }) {
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px sans-serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1f1f1f';
    ctx.fillText(data, 0, 0);
  },
};

const horizontalLayout: LayoutExtension = {
  execute(data) {
    return {
      nodes: data.nodes.map((node, index) => ({ ...node, x: 120 + index * 180, y: 180 })),
    };
  },
};

const normalizeData: TransformExtension = {
  beforeRender(data: GraphData) {
    return {
      ...data,
      nodes: data.nodes.map((node) => ({
        ...node,
        data: { score: 0, ...node.data },
      })),
    };
  },
};

const BUSINESS_CLICK_BEHAVIOR = 'business-click' as const;

interface BusinessClickBehaviorOptions extends BehaviorOptions<typeof BUSINESS_CLICK_BEHAVIOR> {
  state?: ElementState;
  compactSize?: number;
  expandedSize?: number;
}

function createBusinessClickBehavior(): BehaviorExtension<BusinessClickBehaviorOptions> {
  let context: ExtensionContext | undefined;
  let state: ElementState = 'selected';
  let compactSize = 32;
  let expandedSize = 68;

  return {
    init(nextContext, options) {
      context = nextContext;
      state = options.state ?? 'selected';
      compactSize = options.compactSize ?? 32;
      expandedSize = options.expandedSize ?? 68;
    },
    getEvents() {
      return {
        'node:click': ({ nodeId }) => {
          if (!context) return;
          context.state.set(nodeId, [state]);
          const node = context.data.getNode(nodeId);
          const currentSize = Number(node?.data?.size ?? 44);
          context.data.updateNode(nodeId, {
            size: currentSize >= expandedSize ? compactSize : expandedSize,
          });
        },
        'canvas:click': () => {
          if (!context) return;
          const stateMap = Object.fromEntries(context.data.getNodeIds().map((id) => [id, []]));
          context.state.setAll(stateMap);
        },
      };
    },
    destroy() {
      context = undefined;
    },
  };
}

const EXTENSION_HINT_PLUGIN = 'extension-hint' as const;

interface ExtensionHintPluginOptions extends PluginOptions<typeof EXTENSION_HINT_PLUGIN> {
  text?: string;
}

function createExtensionHintPlugin(): PluginExtension<ExtensionHintPluginOptions> {
  let hint: HTMLElement | undefined;
  let text = '点击节点切换 32px / 68px · 悬停 ··· 展开徽章';

  return {
    init(_context, options) {
      text = options.text ?? text;
    },
    mount(container) {
      hint = document.createElement('div');
      hint.className = 'g6lite-extension-demo-hint';
      hint.textContent = text;
      Object.assign(hint.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        left: '12px',
        top: '12px',
        zIndex: '20',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 24px)',
        color: '#64748b',
        font: '12px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif',
        pointerEvents: 'none',
      });
      container.appendChild(hint);
    },
    destroy() {
      hint?.remove();
      hint = undefined;
    },
  };
}

register('decoration', 'external-name', externalNameRenderer);
register('edge', 'business-relation', {
  base: 'arc',
  style: { stroke: '#91caff', lineWidth: 2, curvature: 0.18, endArrow: true },
  stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#1677ff', lineWidth: 3 } },
});
register('layout', 'horizontal-business', () => ({ ...horizontalLayout }));
register('transform', 'normalize-business-data', () => ({ ...normalizeData }));
register('behavior', BUSINESS_CLICK_BEHAVIOR, () => createBusinessClickBehavior());
register('plugin', EXTENSION_HINT_PLUGIN, () => createExtensionHintPlugin());

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  // Padding keeps the boundary badges (star, count pill) off the canvas edge.
  const viewPadding = 40;
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: viewPadding },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        {
          id: 'customer',
          data: {
            label: '客户',
            size: 44,
            namePlacement: 'bottom',
            badges: [
              { kind: 'text', text: '待问题排查' },
              { kind: 'count', value: 12 },
              { kind: 'warning' },
              { kind: 'favorite' },
              { kind: 'lock' },
            ] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[],
          },
        },
        {
          id: 'order',
          data: {
            label: '订单',
            size: 44,
            namePlacement: 'right',
            badges: [
              { kind: 'lock' },
              { kind: 'text', text: '待排查' },
            ] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[],
          },
        },
        {
          id: 'product',
          data: {
            label: '商品',
            size: 44,
            namePlacement: 'left',
            badges: [
              { kind: 'favorite' },
              { kind: 'icon', icon: '★' },
            ] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[],
          },
        },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'customer-order', source: 'customer', target: 'order' },
        { id: 'order-product', source: 'order', target: 'product' },
      ],
    },
    transforms: ['normalize-business-data'],
    layout: { type: 'horizontal-business' },
    behaviors: [
      'drag-canvas',
      'zoom-canvas',
      {
        type: BUSINESS_CLICK_BEHAVIOR,
        state: 'selected',
        compactSize: 32,
        expandedSize: 68,
      } satisfies BusinessClickBehaviorOptions,
    ],
    plugins: [
      {
        type: EXTENSION_HINT_PLUGIN,
        text: '点击节点切换 32px / 68px · 悬停 ··· 展开徽章',
      } satisfies ExtensionHintPluginOptions,
    ],
    node: {
      style: {
        size: (node) => Number(node.data?.size ?? 44),
        fill: '#e6f4ff',
        stroke: '#1677ff',
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
      },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#bae0ff', strokeWidth: 3 } },
      decorations: [
        {
          renderer: 'external-name',
          placement: (node: GraphNode) =>
            (node.data?.namePlacement as 'left' | 'right' | 'bottom' | undefined) ?? 'bottom',
          attachment: 'outside',
          data: (node: GraphNode) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        },
        {
          renderer: 'builtin-badge',
          placement: (node) => (node.data?.namePlacement === 'left' ? 'left' : 'right'),
          attachment: 'boundary',
          anchor: 'start',
          boundaryOverlap: 'half-badge',
          crossOffsetRatio: 0,
          layout: 'stack',
          sort: 'width-desc',
          maxVisible: 3,
          overflow: 'hover-expand',
          itemGap: 2,
          overflowData: { kind: 'text', text: '···' },
          items: (node) => (node.data?.badges as NodeBadgeItem[] | undefined) ?? [],
        },
      ],
    },
    edge: { type: 'business-relation' },
  });
  await graph.render();
  // The business-click behavior toggles node sizes between 32 and 68; refit
  // after each toggle so resized nodes and their badges stay inside the view.
  graph.on('node:click', () => {
    graph.fitView({ padding: viewPadding });
  });
  return graph;
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [扩展选择](/docs/guides/extensions)
- [运行契约](/docs/api/extensions#extension-runtime)

# 鱼骨图 (/docs/examples/fishbone)





将问题、分类与原因组织成鱼骨结构，清晰呈现归因层级。

## 如何体验

缩放或拖拽画布阅读各类原因；使用“适应画布”查看完整归因结构。

## 数据说明

盈利未达预期的归因示意：人员、设备、方法等 6 类原因，共 20 个节点与 19 条边。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository provide example label overlays.
/**
 * Demo: 鱼骨图 (Fishbone/Ishikawa Diagram) — 盈利未达预期分析
 */
import { Graph, register, type GraphEdge, type GraphNode } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import fishbone from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/fishbone';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const CATEGORY_COLORS = ['#E8684A', '#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16', '#6F5EF9', '#5D7092'];

const NODE_LEVELS = {
  HEAD: 'head',
  CATEGORY: 'category',
  ITEM: 'item',
};

function createFishboneData() {
  const nodes = [
    { id: 'head', name: '盈利未达预期', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.HEAD } },
    { id: 'cat0', name: '人员', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 0 } },
    { id: 'cat1', name: '设备', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 1 } },
    { id: 'cat2', name: '方法', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 2 } },
    { id: 'cat3', name: '材料', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 3 } },
    { id: 'cat4', name: '环境', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 4 } },
    { id: 'cat5', name: '测量', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 5 } },
    { id: 'cat0-item0', name: '培训不足', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 0 } },
    { id: 'cat0-item1', name: '经验欠缺', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 0 } },
    { id: 'cat0-item2', name: '人员流动', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 0 } },
    { id: 'cat1-item0', name: '设备老化', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 1 } },
    { id: 'cat1-item1', name: '维护不当', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 1 } },
    { id: 'cat2-item0', name: '流程不合理', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 2 } },
    { id: 'cat2-item1', name: '标准缺失', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 2 } },
    { id: 'cat2-item2', name: '执行不到位', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 2 } },
    { id: 'cat3-item0', name: '供应商问题', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 3 } },
    { id: 'cat3-item1', name: '质检不严', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 3 } },
    { id: 'cat4-item0', name: '市场竞争', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 4 } },
    { id: 'cat4-item1', name: '政策变化', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 4 } },
    { id: 'cat5-item0', name: '数据不准', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 5 } },
  ];

  const edges = [
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat0' },
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat1' },
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat2' },
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat3' },
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat4' },
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat5' },
    { source: 'cat0', target: 'cat0-item0' },
    { source: 'cat0', target: 'cat0-item1' },
    { source: 'cat0', target: 'cat0-item2' },
    { source: 'cat1', target: 'cat1-item0' },
    { source: 'cat1', target: 'cat1-item1' },
    { source: 'cat2', target: 'cat2-item0' },
    { source: 'cat2', target: 'cat2-item1' },
    { source: 'cat2', target: 'cat2-item2' },
    { source: 'cat3', target: 'cat3-item0' },
    { source: 'cat3', target: 'cat3-item1' },
    { source: 'cat4', target: 'cat4-item0' },
    { source: 'cat4', target: 'cat4-item1' },
    { source: 'cat5', target: 'cat5-item0' },
  ];

  return { nodes, edges };
}

const data = createFishboneData();

function getNodeSize(node: { name?: string; data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  const name = node.name || '';
  const charWidth = 14;
  const padding = 24;
  const minWidth = 60;
  const calculatedWidth = Math.max(minWidth, name.length * charWidth + padding);

  if (level === NODE_LEVELS.HEAD) {
    return { width: 160, height: 50 };
  } else if (level === NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY) {
    return { width: 100, height: 36 };
  }
  return { width: calculatedWidth, height: 28 };
}

function getNodeStyle(node: { data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  const categoryIndex = node.data?.categoryIndex as number | undefined;
  const categoryColor = categoryIndex !== undefined ? CATEGORY_COLORS[categoryIndex % CATEGORY_COLORS.length] : '#5B8FF9';
  const size = getNodeSize(node);

  if (level === NODE_LEVELS.HEAD) {
    return { fill: '#E8684A', width: size.width, height: size.height, borderRadius: 8, stroke: 'transparent', strokeWidth: 0 };
  } else if (level === NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY) {
    return { fill: categoryColor, width: size.width, height: size.height, borderRadius: 6, stroke: 'transparent', strokeWidth: 0 };
  }
  return { fill: 'transparent', width: size.width, height: size.height, borderRadius: 0, stroke: 'transparent', strokeWidth: 0 };
}

function getNodeLabelColor(node: { data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  return level === NODE_LEVELS.ITEM ? '#333' : '#fff';
}

function getEdgeColor(_source: GraphNode, _target: GraphNode, edge: GraphEdge) {
  const targetNode = data.nodes.find(n => n.id === edge.target);
  const categoryIndex = targetNode?.data?.categoryIndex as number | undefined;
  return categoryIndex !== undefined ? CATEGORY_COLORS[categoryIndex % CATEGORY_COLORS.length] : '#d9d9d9';
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'fishbone', fishbone);
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: wrapper,
    data,
    node: { type: 'rect', style: (n) => getNodeStyle(n) },
    edge: { type: 'polyline', style: { stroke: getEdgeColor, lineWidth: 1.5, router: 'fishbone', endArrow: false, startArrow: false } },
    layout: { type: 'fishbone', direction: 'LR', categoryGap: 180, itemGap: 44, itemHStep: 50, categoryDistance: 200 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 64 });

  const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
  const cleanupLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    nodeLabel: (n) => n.name ?? n.id,
    position: (n) => (n.data?.level as string) === NODE_LEVELS.ITEM ? 'right-edge' : 'inside',
    nodeSize: (n) => {
      const size = getNodeSize(n);
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      return { width: size.width / dpr, height: size.height / dpr };
    },
    fontSize: (n) => {
      const level = n.data?.level as string;
      const size = level === NODE_LEVELS.HEAD ? 16 : level === NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY ? 14 : 12;
      // Camera zoom is measured in physical pixels; the overlay expects CSS pixels.
      return size * graph.getCamera().zoom / Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    },
    color: (n) => getNodeLabelColor(n),
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => { cleanupLabels(); graph.destroy(); },
  };
}
```

- [布局选择](/docs/guides/layout)
- [布局参考](/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# 流程图 (/docs/examples/flowchart)





用层级布局和折线边绘制决策流程。

## 如何体验

缩放和平移决策流程。

## 数据说明

决策节点使用 dagre 和折线边。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository provide example label overlays.
/**
 * Demo: 流程图 — 性能诊断决策树 (dagre TB + 矩形节点 + 边标签)
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, attachEdgeLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  start: '#5B8FF9',
  check: '#F6BD16',
  problem: '#E86452',
  action: '#5AD8A6',
};

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'start', name: 'Check I/O wait (top)', data: { role: 'start' } },
    { id: 'mem', name: 'Check swap/free -m', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'cpu', name: 'Check %CPU (top)', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'ram_prob', name: 'RAM PROBLEM', data: { role: 'problem' } },
    { id: 'io', name: 'I/O', data: { role: 'problem' } },
    { id: 'nw_prob', name: 'NW PROBLEM', data: { role: 'problem' } },
    { id: 'cpu_prob', name: 'CPU PROBLEM', data: { role: 'problem' } },
    { id: 'ram_hog', name: 'What\'s hogging RAM? (top)', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'io_hog', name: 'What\'s hogging I/O? (iotop)', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'ext_dep', name: 'Look for an external dependency', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'cpu_confirm', name: 'Confirm by checking CPU %', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'mem_anomaly', name: 'Check history - anomaly?', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'cpu_procs', name: 'Check list of processes (top)', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'kill_mem', name: 'Kill processes (memory)', data: { role: 'action' } },
    { id: 'infra_ram', name: 'Infrastructure - add RAM', data: { role: 'action' } },
    { id: 'cpu_anomaly', name: 'Check history - anomaly?', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'kill_cpu', name: 'Kill processes (CPU)', data: { role: 'action' } },
    { id: 'infra_cores', name: 'Infrastructure - add cores', data: { role: 'action' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'start', target: 'mem', data: { label: 'true' } },
    { source: 'start', target: 'cpu', data: { label: 'false' } },
    { source: 'mem', target: 'ram_prob', data: { label: 'true' } },
    { source: 'mem', target: 'io', data: { label: 'false' } },
    { source: 'cpu', target: 'nw_prob', data: { label: 'false' } },
    { source: 'cpu', target: 'cpu_prob', data: { label: 'true' } },
    { source: 'ram_prob', target: 'ram_hog' },
    { source: 'io', target: 'io_hog' },
    { source: 'nw_prob', target: 'ext_dep' },
    { source: 'cpu_prob', target: 'cpu_confirm' },
    { source: 'ram_hog', target: 'mem_anomaly' },
    { source: 'cpu_confirm', target: 'cpu_procs' },
    { source: 'mem_anomaly', target: 'kill_mem', data: { label: 'true' } },
    { source: 'mem_anomaly', target: 'infra_ram', data: { label: 'false' } },
    { source: 'cpu_procs', target: 'cpu_anomaly' },
    { source: 'cpu_anomaly', target: 'kill_cpu', data: { label: 'true' } },
    { source: 'cpu_anomaly', target: 'infra_cores', data: { label: 'false' } },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: wrapper,
    data,
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: (n) => COLORS[n.data?.role as string] ?? '#5B8FF9',
        width: 180,
        height: 32,
        borderRadius: 4,
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 1,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'polyline',
      style: {
        stroke: '#aaa',
        lineWidth: 1.5,
        endArrow: true,
        radius: 16,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'TB', nodesep: 40, ranksep: 60, nodeSize: [180, 32] },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();

  const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
  const cleanupNodeLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    nodeLabel: (n) => n.name ?? n.id,
    position: 'inside',
    nodeSize: () => ({ width: 180, height: 32 }),
    fontSize: 10,
  });
  const cleanupEdgeLabels = attachEdgeLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    fontSize: 8,
    color: '#555',
    bgColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)',
    borderRadius: 6,
    borderColor: '#ddd',
    padding: 3,
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy: () => { cleanupNodeLabels(); cleanupEdgeLabels(); graph.destroy(); },
  };
}
```

# 悬停高亮 (/docs/examples/hover)





悬停节点或边时高亮关联元素，并淡化其余元素。

## 如何体验

悬停节点或边，关联元素保持清晰，其余元素变淡。

## 数据说明

星形关系图用于观察悬停后的淡化效果。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Hover 高亮效果（对标 G6 hover-activate 行为）
 *
 * - 悬停节点：高亮该节点及其邻居节点和连接边
 * - 悬停边：高亮该边及其两端节点
 * - 非活跃元素：节点 0.25 透明度、边 0.08 透明度（G6 风格淡化）
 * - 鼠标指针：悬停时变为 pointer
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: '0', name: 'Central' },
        { id: '1', name: 'Node A' },
        { id: '2', name: 'Node B' },
        { id: '3', name: 'Node C' },
        { id: '4', name: 'Node D' },
        { id: '5', name: 'Node E' },
        { id: '6', name: 'Node F' },
        { id: '7', name: 'Node G' },
        { id: '8', name: 'Node H' },
        { id: '9', name: 'Node I' },
        { id: '10', name: 'Node J' },
        { id: '11', name: 'Node K' },
      ],
      edges: [
        // Central hub connections
        { source: '0', target: '1' },
        { source: '0', target: '2' },
        { source: '0', target: '3' },
        { source: '0', target: '4' },
        { source: '0', target: '5' },
        // Cluster A
        { source: '1', target: '6' },
        { source: '1', target: '7' },
        { source: '6', target: '7' },
        // Cluster B
        { source: '2', target: '8' },
        { source: '2', target: '9' },
        { source: '8', target: '9' },
        // Cluster C
        { source: '3', target: '10' },
        { source: '4', target: '10' },
        { source: '4', target: '11' },
        { source: '5', target: '11' },
        // Cross links
        { source: '7', target: '8' },
        { source: '10', target: '11' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: (d) => {
          const colors = ['#E86452', '#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16', '#6DC8EC', '#945FB9'];
          const idx = parseInt(d.id);
          if (idx === 0) return '#E86452'; // Central node: red
          if (idx <= 5) return '#5B8FF9';  // First ring: blue
          return '#5AD8A6';                 // Outer ring: green
        },
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#C0C0C0',
        lineWidth: 2,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'force', maxIteration: 300 },
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      { type: 'hover-highlight', inactiveState: 'inactive' },
    ],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [交互组合](/docs/guides/behaviors)
- [Behavior 参考](/docs/api/options#options-behaviors)

# 缩进树 (/docs/examples/indented-tree)





用缩进布局展示目录结构。

## 如何体验

在样式模式和紧凑模式之间切换。

## 数据说明

目录节点可以用缩进布局展开成树。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: 缩进树 — 项目目录结构
 *
 * 展示两种风格：
 * 1. 有背景节点 + 按深度着色（默认）
 * 2. 子节点无样式 — 只有根节点有背景，子节点文字直接显示在边上（设计稿风格）
 *
 * 通过右上角菜单切换两种模式。
 */
import { Graph, register } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import indented from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/indented';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'root', name: 'my-project' },
    { id: 'src', name: 'src' },
    { id: 'comp', name: 'components' },
    { id: 'pages', name: 'pages' },
    { id: 'utils', name: 'utils' },
    { id: 'app', name: 'App.tsx' },
    { id: 'index', name: 'index.tsx' },
    { id: 'public', name: 'public' },
    { id: 'assets', name: 'assets' },
    { id: 'logo', name: 'logo.svg' },
    { id: 'pkg', name: 'package.json' },
    { id: 'readme', name: 'README.md' },
    { id: 'tsconf', name: 'tsconfig.json' },
    { id: 'home', name: 'Home.tsx' },
    { id: 'about', name: 'About.tsx' },
    { id: 'req', name: 'request.ts' },
    { id: 'fmt', name: 'format.ts' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'root', target: 'src' },
    { source: 'root', target: 'public' },
    { source: 'root', target: 'pkg' },
    { source: 'root', target: 'readme' },
    { source: 'root', target: 'tsconf' },
    { source: 'src', target: 'comp' },
    { source: 'src', target: 'pages' },
    { source: 'src', target: 'utils' },
    { source: 'src', target: 'app' },
    { source: 'src', target: 'index' },
    { source: 'comp', target: 'home' },
    { source: 'comp', target: 'about' },
    { source: 'utils', target: 'req' },
    { source: 'utils', target: 'fmt' },
    { source: 'public', target: 'assets' },
    { source: 'assets', target: 'logo' },
  ],
};

const NODE_W = 120;
const NODE_H = 28;
const FONT_SIZE = 12;
const CHAR_WIDTH = FONT_SIZE * 0.5;
const NODE_PADDING = 2;

/** Measure text width in graph units (approximate) */
function measureTextWidth(text: string): number {
  return text.length * CHAR_WIDTH + NODE_PADDING;
}

const layoutBase = {
  type: 'indented' as const,
  indent: 80,
  rowHeight: 52,
  direction: 'LR' as const,
};

const edgeBase = {
  type: 'polyline' as const,
  style: {
    lineWidth: 2,
    router: 'indented' as const,
    radius: 24,
    endArrow: false,
    startArrow: false,
  },
};

// ── 模式一：所有节点有背景色 ────────────────────────
function configStyled() {
  return {
    node: {
      type: 'rect' as const,
      style: {
        fill: (n: any) => n.data?._nodeColor ?? '#5B8FF9',
        width: NODE_W,
        height: NODE_H,
        borderRadius: 4,
        opacity: 0.9,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      ...edgeBase,
      style: {
        ...edgeBase.style,
        stroke: (src: any) => src.data?._edgeColor ?? '#c0c0c0',
      },
    },
    layout: {
      ...layoutBase,
      nodeColors: ['#4A90D9', '#F08F56', '#00C9C9', '#D580FF', '#7863FF'],
      edgeColors: ['#1783FF', '#F08F56', '#00C9C9', '#D580FF', '#7863FF'],
    },
    labelColor: '#fff' as any,
    labelPosition: 'inside' as const,
  };
}

// ── 模式二：子节点无样式（设计稿风格）──────────────────
// 参考 G6 IndentedNode：节点宽度 = 固定间距 + 文字宽度
// 边到达节点右边缘（覆盖文字长度），文字从左边缘开始，边长度随文字自适应
function configMinimal() {
  return {
    node: {
      type: 'rect' as const,
      style: {
        fill: (n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? '#4A90D9' : '#ffffff',
        width: (n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? NODE_W : measureTextWidth(n.name ?? n.id),
        height: NODE_H,
        borderRadius: (n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? 6 : 0,
        stroke: (n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? '#4A90D9' : '#ffffff',
        strokeWidth: 0,
        opacity: (n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? 1 : 0,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      ...edgeBase,
      style: {
        ...edgeBase.style,
        stroke: (src: any) => src.data?._edgeColor ?? '#c0c0c0',
        indentTarget: 'right' as const,
      },
    },
    layout: {
      ...layoutBase,
      edgeColors: ['#1783FF', '#F08F56', '#00C9C9', '#D580FF', '#7863FF'],
    },
    labelColor: ((n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? '#fff' : '#333') as any,
    labelPosition: ((n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? 'inside' : 'right') as any,
  };
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'indented', indented);
  const wrapper =
    typeof container === 'string'
      ? (document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement)
      : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  let currentGraph: Graph | null = null;
  let cleanupLabels: (() => void) | undefined;
  let generation = 0;
  let disposed = false;
  let currentMode = 'styled';

  async function renderMode(mode: string) {
    const token = ++generation;
    cleanupLabels?.();
    cleanupLabels = undefined;
    if (currentGraph) {
      currentGraph.destroy();
      // Remove old label canvas
      const oldLabel = wrapper.querySelector('.label-canvas');
      if (oldLabel) oldLabel.remove();
    }
    currentMode = mode;

    const cfg = mode === 'styled' ? configStyled() : configMinimal();

    const graph = new Graph({
      autoFit: true,
      container: wrapper,
      data: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data)),
      node: cfg.node as any,
      edge: cfg.edge as any,
      layout: cfg.layout,
      behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
      theme: 'light',
    });

    currentGraph = graph;
    await graph.render();
    if (disposed || token !== generation) { graph.destroy(); return; }

    const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
    const labelColorFn = cfg.labelColor;
    const labelPosition = cfg.labelPosition;
    const isMinimal = currentMode === 'minimal';
    cleanupLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
      nodeLabel: (n) => n.name ?? n.id,
      position: labelPosition,
      nodeSize: (n: any) => {
        if (isMinimal && !n.data?._isRoot) {
          return { width: measureTextWidth(n.name ?? n.id), height: NODE_H };
        }
        return { width: NODE_W, height: NODE_H };
      },
      fontSize: FONT_SIZE,
      color: labelColorFn,
    });

    currentGraph = graph;
  }

  await renderMode('styled');
  const ui = createDemoPanel(wrapper);
  ui.addChoice('样式', { 有背景: 'styled', 无样式: 'minimal' }, 'styled', (value) => {
    if (value !== currentMode) void renderMode(value);
  });

  return {
    getData: () => currentGraph?.getData(),
    fitView: () => currentGraph?.fitView(),
    destroy: () => {
      disposed = true;
      generation++;
      cleanupLabels?.();
      if (currentGraph) currentGraph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```

- [布局参考](/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# 标签渲染策略 (/docs/examples/label-rendering-options)





对比固定字号、低缩放持续绘制和关闭碰撞隐藏。

## 如何体验

初始为全部标签、zoom 0.4。选择默认策略和 zoom 0.2，文字隐藏；同一缩放切回全部标签，文字重新出现。刷新恢复初始设置。

## 数据说明

同一张图在默认策略和全部显示之间切换。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const NODES = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, index) => ({
  id: `service-${index + 1}`,
  x: (index % 6) * 160,
  y: Math.floor(index / 6) * 180,
  data: {
    label: `Service ${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
    fill: ['#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16'][Math.floor(index / 6)],
  },
}));

const EDGES = NODES.slice(1).map((node, index) => ({
  id: `route-${index + 1}`,
  source: NODES[index].id,
  target: node.id,
  data: { label: `route ${index + 1}` },
}));

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const root =
    typeof container === 'string' ? (document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement) : container;
  // Reserve left room for the bottom-left status block. Scale the reservation
  // with the container so narrow hosts (e.g. the docs site preview) are not
  // squeezed against the right edge while wide canvases keep the full gap.
  const leftReserve = Math.round(Math.min(360, Math.max(160, root.clientWidth * 0.28)));
  const viewPadding: [number, number, number, number] = [90, 70, 70, leftReserve];
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: viewPadding, maxZoom: 0.4 },
    container: root,
    data: { nodes: NODES, edges: EDGES },
    label: {
      scaleWithZoom: false,
      hideOnLowZoom: false,
      hideOnCollision: false,
    },
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 30,
        fill: (node) => String(node.data?.fill ?? '#5B8FF9'),
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
        labelColor: '#1e293b',
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)',
        labelBackgroundPadding: 3,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      style: {
        stroke: '#94a3b8',
        endArrow: true,
        label: (_source, _target, edge) => String(edge.data?.label ?? edge.id ?? ''),
        labelFontSize: 10,
        labelColor: '#475569',
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.88)',
        labelBackgroundPadding: 2,
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();

  const ui = createDemoPanel(root);

  let allLabels = true;
  let zoom = 0.4;

  const updateStatus = () => {
    ui.setStatus(
      `${allLabels ? '全部标签：三项策略关闭' : '默认策略：三项策略开启'}\n` +
        `zoom=${zoom.toFixed(1)}\n` +
        `${allLabels ? '固定字号 · 不做低 zoom 隐藏 · 不做碰撞隐藏' : '字号随 zoom · 节点<0.3/边<0.5 隐藏 · 碰撞隐藏'}`,
    );
  };

  const setZoom = (nextZoom: number) => {
    zoom = nextZoom;
    graph.fitView({ padding: viewPadding, minZoom: zoom, maxZoom: zoom });
    updateStatus();
  };

  const setLabelPolicy = (showAll: boolean) => {
    allLabels = showAll;
    graph.updateOptions({
      label: {
        scaleWithZoom: !showAll,
        hideOnLowZoom: !showAll,
        hideOnCollision: !showAll,
      },
    });
    updateStatus();
  };

  ui.addAction('全部标签', () => setLabelPolicy(true));
  ui.addAction('默认策略', () => setLabelPolicy(false));
  ui.addAction('zoom 0.2', () => setZoom(0.2));
  ui.addAction('zoom 0.4', () => setZoom(0.4));
  ui.addAction('zoom 1.0', () => setZoom(1));

  setZoom(zoom);

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => setZoom(zoom),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [标签与图标](/docs/guides/label)
- [标签策略](/docs/api/options#options-label)

# 标签位置与图标 (/docs/examples/labels)





展示节点标签、边标签、图标，并在运行时切换位置。

## 如何体验

在右上角面板将标签位置设为 left，再点击按钮切换节点图标和边标签。刷新可恢复默认配置。

## 数据说明

节点带图标和标签，边带可开关的标签。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: 节点标签 / 边标签 / 节点图标
 */
import { Graph, type GraphEdge, type GraphNode, type LabelPlacement } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const DATA = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'server', data: { name: 'API Server', type: 'server' } },
    { id: 'db', data: { name: 'Database', type: 'database' } },
    { id: 'cache', data: { name: 'Redis Cache', type: 'cache' } },
    { id: 'queue', data: { name: 'Message Queue', type: 'queue' } },
    { id: 'worker', data: { name: 'Worker', type: 'worker' } },
    { id: 'gateway', data: { name: 'API Gateway', type: 'gateway' } },
    { id: 'client', data: { name: 'Client App', type: 'client' } },
    { id: 'monitor', data: { name: 'Monitor', type: 'monitor' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'client', target: 'gateway', data: { label: 'HTTPS' } },
    { source: 'gateway', target: 'server', data: { label: 'gRPC' } },
    { source: 'server', target: 'db', data: { label: 'SQL' } },
    { source: 'server', target: 'cache', data: { label: 'TCP' } },
    { source: 'server', target: 'queue', data: { label: 'AMQP' } },
    { source: 'queue', target: 'worker', data: { label: 'consume' } },
    { source: 'worker', target: 'db', data: { label: 'write' } },
    { source: 'monitor', target: 'server', data: { label: 'metrics' } },
    { source: 'monitor', target: 'gateway', data: { label: 'health' } },
  ],
};

// Text icons use the first letter of each node's business type.
const iconForNode = (node: GraphNode) => String(node.data?.type ?? '').slice(0, 1).toUpperCase();

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const el = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;

  el.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: el,
    data: DATA,
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 180 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node'],
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 20,
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        icon: iconForNode,
        iconType: 'text',
        iconFontSize: 12,
        iconColor: '#fff',
        label: (n) => (n.data?.name as string | undefined) ?? n.id,
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
        labelColor: '#333',
      },
    },
    edge: {
      style: {
        label: (s, t, e) => (e.data?.label as string) ?? '',
        labelFontSize: 10,
        labelColor: '#666',
        labelAutoRotate: true,
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph.render();

  const ui = createDemoPanel(el);
  ui.addChoice<LabelPlacement>('标签', ['bottom', 'center', 'top', 'left', 'right'], 'bottom', (value) => {
    graph.updateOptions({ node: { style: { labelPlacement: value } } });
  });

  let edgeLabelsVisible = true;
  let iconsVisible = true;
  ui.addAction('切换边标签', () => {
    edgeLabelsVisible = !edgeLabelsVisible;
    graph.updateOptions({
      edge: {
        style: {
          label: edgeLabelsVisible
            ? ((_source: GraphNode, _target: GraphNode, edge: GraphEdge) =>
                (edge.data?.label as string | undefined) ?? '')
            : false,
        },
      },
    });
  });
  ui.addAction('切换节点图标', () => {
    iconsVisible = !iconsVisible;
    graph.updateOptions({ node: { style: { icon: iconsVisible ? iconForNode : false } } });
  });
  ui.addChoice('布局', ['circular', 'force'], 'circular', async (value) => {
    graph.setLayout(value === 'circular' ? { type: 'circular', radius: 180 } : { type: 'd3-force' });
    await graph.layout();
    graph.fitView();
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```

## 操作与预期 [#操作与预期]

1. 节点中央的白色字母是 `iconType: 'text'` 图标，来自业务 `type` 的首字母；节点名称默认显示在下方，边上显示协议名称。
2. 在画布右上角“标签”菜单依次选择 `top`、`left`、`right`，节点名称应移到对应方向，中央图标保持原位。`center` 会让文字与图标共享中心位置，可能重叠。
3. 在面板点击“切换节点图标”，字母隐藏而节点名称保留，再点一次即可恢复。“切换边标签”只影响边上的协议名称。

面板通过 `graph.updateOptions()` 分别更新图标、节点标签与边标签样式。用“布局”下拉框可以比较不同布局下的标签效果。

用法见[标签与图标指南](/docs/guides/label)；字段见[节点标签](/docs/guides/node#标签)与[节点图标](/docs/guides/node#图标)，整体缩放与碰撞另见[标签渲染策略示例](/docs/examples/label-rendering-options)。


## 继续阅读

- [标签与图标](/docs/guides/label)
- [节点参考](/docs/api/options#options-node)

# 5000 节点与标签 (/docs/examples/large-labeled)





在 5000 个节点上绘制 Canvas 标签。

## 如何体验

缩小查看全图，放大后再阅读节点标签。

## 数据说明

合成网络包含 5000 个节点、15000 条边；内置 Canvas 标签在低缩放隐藏并避让碰撞，放大后逐步阅读。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: 5000 节点 + 标签 — 性能与标签验证
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

function generateData(nodeCount: number, degree: number) {
  const nodes = Array.from({ length: nodeCount }, (_, i) => ({
    id: String(i),
    name: `N${i}`,
    data: { cluster: i % 3 === 0 ? 'a' : i % 3 === 1 ? 'b' : 'c' },
  }));
  const edges: Array<{ source: string; target: string; data: { label: string } }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) {
    const k = Math.min(degree, nodeCount - 1);
    for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) {
      const t = (i + 1 + j * 13) % nodeCount;
      if (t !== i) {
        edges.push({
          source: String(i),
          target: String(t),
          data: { label: `e${i}-${t}` },
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return { nodes, edges };
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const wrap = typeof container === 'string' ? (document.querySelector(container) as HTMLElement) : container;
  const { nodes, edges } = generateData(5000, 3);

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: wrap,
    data: { nodes, edges },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: (d) => {
          const c = (d.data?.cluster as string) ?? 'a';
          return c === 'a' ? '#5B8FF9' : c === 'b' ? '#61DDAA' : '#F6BD16';
        },
        size: 4,
        label: (node) => node.name ?? node.id,
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
      },
    },
    edge: { type: 'line', style: { lineWidth: 0.5 } },
    label: { scaleWithZoom: false, hideOnLowZoom: true, hideOnCollision: true },
    layout: { type: 'force', linkDistance: 25 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();

  return graph;
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [性能测量](/docs/metrics/performance)
- [性能优化](/docs/metrics/performance#performance-tuning)

# 200 节点 (/docs/examples/large)





用 200 个节点快速查看中等规模图的渲染和交互。

## 如何体验

缩放、拖拽，并悬停节点查看邻居高亮。

## 数据说明

合成网络包含 200 个节点，每个节点约 4 条边。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: 较大规模 — 较多节点边，验证基础性能
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

function generateData(nodeCount: number, edgeFactor: number) {
  const nodes = Array.from({ length: nodeCount }, (_, i) => ({
    id: String(i),
    data: { cluster: i % 3 === 0 ? 'a' : i % 3 === 1 ? 'b' : 'c' },
  }));
  const edges: Array<{ source: string; target: string }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) {
    const k = Math.min(edgeFactor, nodeCount - 1);
    for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) {
      const t = (i + 1 + j) % nodeCount;
      if (t !== i) edges.push({ source: String(i), target: String(t) });
    }
  }
  return { nodes, edges };
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const { nodes, edges } = generateData(200, 4);

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: { nodes, edges },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: (d) => {
          const c = (d.data?.cluster as string) ?? 'a';
          return c === 'a' ? '#5B8FF9' : c === 'b' ? '#61DDAA' : '#F6BD16';
        },
        size: 6,
      },
    },
    edge: { type: 'line', style: { lineWidth: 1 } },
    layout: { type: 'force', linkDistance: 60 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node'],
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```

# 更多布局示例 (/docs/examples/layout-gallery)





比较 radial、concentric、ForceAtlas2、fruchterman、MDS 和 random。

## 如何体验

从工具条选择布局，并观察同一数据的结构变化。

## 数据说明

使用固定的小型网络横向比较 6 种布局。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph, register, type LayoutConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import mds from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/mds';
import radial from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/radial';
import random from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/random';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const NODES = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, index) => ({ id: String(index), data: { label: String(index) } }));
const EDGES = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, index) => ({ id: `e-${index}`, source: String(Math.floor(index / 2)), target: String(index + 1) }));

const LAYOUTS: Array<{ label: string; config: LayoutConfig }> = [
  { label: 'Radial', config: { type: 'radial', unitRadius: 68, linkDistance: 60 } },
  { label: 'Concentric', config: { type: 'concentric', nodeSize: 28, minNodeSpacing: 18 } },
  { label: 'ForceAtlas2', config: { type: 'force-atlas2', maxIteration: 60, barnesHut: true, prune: false } },
  { label: 'Fruchterman', config: { type: 'fruchterman', maxIteration: 80, gravity: 8, speed: 5 } },
  { label: 'MDS', config: { type: 'mds', linkDistance: 70 } },
  { label: 'Random', config: { type: 'random' } },
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'mds', mds);
  register('layout', 'radial', radial);
  register('layout', 'random', random);
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: { nodes: NODES, edges: EDGES },
    layout: LAYOUTS[0].config,
    node: { style: { size: 24, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' } },
    edge: { style: { stroke: '#94a3b8', endArrow: true } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 72 });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const labels = LAYOUTS.map(({ label }) => label);
  ui.addChoice('布局', labels, labels[0], async (label) => {
    const layout = LAYOUTS[labels.indexOf(label)];
    ui.setStatus(`running ${label}…`);
    graph.setLayout(layout.config);
    await graph.layout();
    graph.fitView({ padding: 72 });
    ui.setStatus(`${label} complete\nnodes=${graph.getNodeCount()} edges=${graph.getEdgeCount()}`);
  });

  ui.setStatus('Radial complete');
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [布局选择](/docs/guides/layout)
- [布局参考](/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# Worker 布局 (/docs/examples/layout-worker)





请求 Worker 计算力导向布局，并展示返回的节点坐标。

## 如何体验

等待力导向布局结束后再拖拽画布。

## 数据说明

80 个节点、79 条边，配置 worker: true 请求后台计算；是否真正使用 Worker 需在 Network/Performance 中确认，失败可能回退。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: run a force layout in a Web Worker.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

function createNetwork(count: number) {
  const nodes = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
    id: `n${index}`,
    data: { group: index % 4 },
  }));
  const edges = nodes.slice(1).map((node, index) => ({
    source: `n${index % 8}`,
    target: node.id,
  }));
  return { nodes, edges };
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  host.style.position = 'relative';
  const started = performance.now();
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: host,
    data: createNetwork(80),
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 10,
        fill: (node) => ['#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16', '#E86452'][Number(node.data?.group ?? 0)],
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { stroke: '#D0D7E2', lineWidth: 1 } },
    layout: { type: 'force', worker: true, linkDistance: 48, maxIteration: 80 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();

  const ui = createDemoPanel(host);
  ui.setStatus(`force · worker requested · ${Math.round(performance.now() - started)} ms\nWorker success requires a Network/Performance check; failure may fall back.`);

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [Worker 指南](/docs/guides/layout-worker)
- [布局方法](/docs/api/graph#graph-layout)

# 常用布局切换 (/docs/examples/layouts)





在同一份数据上切换 circular、force、grid 和 dagre。

## 如何体验

点击预览区布局按钮，比较四种布局结果。

## 数据说明

10 个节点和 11 条边组成的层级关系数据。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: 布局 — 同一数据切换 circular / force / grid / dagre
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: '0' }, { id: '1' }, { id: '2' }, { id: '3' }, { id: '4' },
    { id: '5' }, { id: '6' }, { id: '7' }, { id: '8' }, { id: '9' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: '0', target: '1' }, { source: '0', target: '2' }, { source: '1', target: '3' },
    { source: '2', target: '4' }, { source: '3', target: '5' }, { source: '4', target: '5' },
    { source: '5', target: '6' }, { source: '6', target: '7' }, { source: '6', target: '8' },
    { source: '7', target: '9' }, { source: '8', target: '9' },
  ],
};

const LAYOUTS = [
  { type: 'circular', radius: 180 },
  { type: 'force', linkDistance: 80 },
  { type: 'grid', rows: 2, cols: 5 },
  { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'TB', nodesep: 30, ranksep: 40 },
] as const;

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  let currentGraph: Graph | null = null;
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string'
    ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)!
    : container;
  wrapper.replaceChildren();
  wrapper.style.cssText = 'position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;';

  const canvasParent = document.createElement('div');
  canvasParent.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;';
  wrapper.appendChild(canvasParent);

  async function renderLayout(index: number) {
    currentGraph?.destroy();
    const layout = LAYOUTS[index];
    currentGraph = new Graph({
      autoFit: true,
      container: canvasParent,
      data,
      node: { type: 'circle', style: { size: 10 } },
      edge: { type: 'line', style: { endArrow: true } },
      layout: { ...layout },
      behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node'],
      theme: 'light',
    });
    await currentGraph.render();
  }

  await renderLayout(0);

  const ui = createDemoPanel(wrapper);
  const labels = ['Circular', 'Force', 'Grid', 'Dagre'];
  ui.addChoice('布局', labels, labels[0], (value) => {
    void renderLayout(labels.indexOf(value));
  });

  return {
    getData: () => currentGraph?.getData(),
    fitView: () => currentGraph?.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      currentGraph?.destroy();
      currentGraph = null;
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [布局选择](/docs/guides/layout)
- [布局参考](/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# 思维导图 (/docs/examples/mindmap)





围绕中心主题展开双向分支，用颜色和文字表达知识层级。

## 如何体验

缩放或拖拽画布阅读各级主题；使用“适应画布”查看完整脑图。

## 数据说明

台风形成因素示意：12 个主题节点与 11 条分支连线。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository provide example label overlays.
/**
 * Demo: 思维导图 (Mind Map) — 台风形成因素
 */
import { Graph, register, type GraphEdge, type GraphNode } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import mindmap from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/mindmap';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const BRANCH_COLORS = ['#E8684A', '#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16'];

// 节点层级定义
const NODE_LEVELS = {
  ROOT: 'root',
  LEVEL1: 'level1',
  CHILD: 'child',
};

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'root', name: '台风形成的因素', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ROOT } },
    // 左侧 - 地理环境
    { id: 'left1', name: '地理环境', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.LEVEL1, branch: 0 } },
    { id: 'left1-1', name: '海温', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 0 } },
    { id: 'left1-2', name: '海洋面积', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 0 } },
    { id: 'left1-3', name: '赤道气流影响', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 0 } },
    { id: 'left1-4', name: '海水蒸发量', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 0 } },
    { id: 'left1-5', name: '热带海域海表温度分布特征', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 0 } },
    // 右侧 - 气象条件
    { id: 'right1', name: '气象条件', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.LEVEL1, branch: 1 } },
    { id: 'right1-1', name: '气压', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 1 } },
    { id: 'right1-2', name: '风速切变', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 1 } },
    { id: 'right1-3', name: '湿度条件', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 1 } },
    { id: 'right1-4', name: '大气环流模式', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 1 } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'root', target: 'left1' },
    { source: 'left1', target: 'left1-1' },
    { source: 'left1', target: 'left1-2' },
    { source: 'left1', target: 'left1-3' },
    { source: 'left1', target: 'left1-4' },
    { source: 'left1', target: 'left1-5' },
    { source: 'root', target: 'right1' },
    { source: 'right1', target: 'right1-1' },
    { source: 'right1', target: 'right1-2' },
    { source: 'right1', target: 'right1-3' },
    { source: 'right1', target: 'right1-4' },
  ],
};

// 获取节点尺寸 - 根据文字长度动态计算
function getNodeSize(node: { name?: string; data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  const name = node.name || '';
  const charWidth = 14; // 每个字符的宽度
  const padding = 20; // 左右内边距
  const minWidth = 60;
  const calculatedWidth = Math.max(minWidth, name.length * charWidth + padding);

  if (level === NODE_LEVELS.ROOT) {
    return { width: 140, height: 44 };
  } else if (level === NODE_LEVELS.LEVEL1) {
    return { width: Math.max(100, name.length * charWidth + padding), height: 36 };
  }
  return { width: calculatedWidth, height: 30 };
}

// 获取节点样式 - 匹配设计稿
function getNodeStyle(node: { data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  const branch = node.data?.branch as number | undefined;
  const branchColor = branch !== undefined ? BRANCH_COLORS[branch % BRANCH_COLORS.length] : '#5B8FF9';
  const size = getNodeSize(node);

  if (level === NODE_LEVELS.ROOT) {
    // 根节点：深蓝填充，白色文字，无边框
    return {
      fill: '#294172',
      width: size.width,
      height: size.height,
      borderRadius: 12,
      stroke: 'transparent',
      strokeWidth: 0,
    };
  } else if (level === NODE_LEVELS.LEVEL1) {
    // 一级节点：分支色填充，白色文字
    return {
      fill: branchColor,
      width: size.width,
      height: size.height,
      borderRadius: 10,
      stroke: 'transparent',
      strokeWidth: 0,
    };
  } else {
    // 子节点：白色填充，灰色边框，黑色文字
    return {
      fill: '#fff',
      width: size.width,
      height: size.height,
      borderRadius: 8,
      stroke: '#d9d9d9',
      strokeWidth: 1,
    };
  }
}

// 获取节点文字颜色
function getNodeLabelColor(node: { data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  // 根节点和一级节点用白色文字，子节点用黑色文字
  return level === NODE_LEVELS.CHILD ? '#333' : '#fff';
}

// 获取边颜色
function getEdgeColor(_source: GraphNode, _target: GraphNode, edge: GraphEdge) {
  const sourceNode = data.nodes.find(n => n.id === edge.source);
  const branch = sourceNode?.data?.branch as number | undefined;
  return branch !== undefined ? BRANCH_COLORS[branch % BRANCH_COLORS.length] : '#5B8FF9';
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'mindmap', mindmap);
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: wrapper,
    data,
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: (n) => getNodeStyle(n),
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'cubic',
      style: {
        stroke: getEdgeColor,
        lineWidth: 1,
        curveOffset: 60,
      },
    },
    layout: {
      type: 'mindmap',
      direction: 'H',
      levelGap: 120,  // 缩短左右间距
      nodeGap: 12,
      branchColors: BRANCH_COLORS,
      getWidth: (n: GraphNode) => getNodeSize(n).width,
      getHeight: (n: GraphNode) => getNodeSize(n).height,
      getSide: (n: GraphNode, index: number) => {
        // 一级子节点交替分配到左右
        const branch = n.data?.branch as number | undefined;
        if (branch !== undefined) {
          return branch % 2 === 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
        }
        return index % 2 === 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 64 });

  const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
  const cleanupLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    nodeLabel: (n) => n.name ?? n.id,
    position: 'inside',
    nodeSize: (n) => {
      const size = getNodeSize(n);
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      return { width: size.width / dpr, height: size.height / dpr };
    },
    fontSize: (n) => {
      const level = n.data?.level as string;
      const size = level === NODE_LEVELS.ROOT ? 20 : level === NODE_LEVELS.LEVEL1 ? 16 : 14;
      // Camera zoom is measured in physical pixels; the overlay expects CSS pixels.
      return size * graph.getCamera().zoom / Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
    },
    color: (n) => getNodeLabelColor(n),
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => { cleanupLabels(); graph.destroy(); },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [布局选择](/docs/guides/layout)
- [布局参考](/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# 一度邻居高亮 (/docs/examples/neighbor-highlight)





悬停节点高亮邻居和连边，悬停边高亮两端节点。

## 如何体验

悬停节点或边。

## 数据说明

hub 与两级分支共 7 个节点、7 条边，用于观察一度邻接高亮。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: hover a node to highlight its neighbors, or an edge to highlight its endpoints.
 */
import { Graph, register } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import radial from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/radial';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'radial', radial);
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: ['hub', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f'].map((id) => ({ id, data: { label: id.toUpperCase() } })),
      edges: [
        { source: 'hub', target: 'a' },
        { source: 'hub', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'hub', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'a', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'e' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'f' },
        { source: 'd', target: 'e' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: {
        size: (node) => (node.id === 'hub' ? 36 : 24),
        fill: (node) => (node.id === 'hub' ? '#E86452' : '#5B8FF9'),
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { stroke: '#C5CEDB', lineWidth: 2 } },
    layout: { type: 'radial', unitRadius: 120, linkDistance: 100 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node', 'highlight-edge'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```

# 节点边框与圆角 (/docs/examples/node-border)





调整描边、线宽和矩形圆角。

## 如何体验

查看不同描边宽度和圆角。

## 数据说明

上图圆节点对比描边宽度与颜色；下图矩形对比 0、4、8、14 的圆角，数据按两个视图导出。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Node border + rounded rect
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const root = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  const graphs: Graph[] = [];

  // Circle nodes with stroke
  const div1 = document.createElement('div');
  div1.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  div1.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;';
  root.appendChild(div1);

  const g1 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: div1,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'c1', name: 'No stroke', x: 100, y: 80 },
        { id: 'c2', name: 'Thin stroke', x: 250, y: 80 },
        { id: 'c3', name: 'Thick stroke', x: 400, y: 80 },
        { id: 'c4', name: 'Colored', x: 550, y: 80 },
      ],
      edges: [],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        size: 36,
        stroke: (d) => d.id === 'c4' ? '#F08F56' : '#fff',
        strokeWidth: (d) => d.id === 'c1' ? 0 : d.id === 'c2' ? 2 : d.id === 'c3' ? 4 : 3,
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await g1.render();
  graphs.push(g1);

  // Rect nodes with border radius
  const div2 = document.createElement('div');
  div2.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  div2.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;margin-top:16px;';
  root.appendChild(div2);

  const g2 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: div2,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'r1', name: 'Sharp rect', x: 100, y: 80 },
        { id: 'r2', name: 'Rounded 4px', x: 280, y: 80 },
        { id: 'r3', name: 'Rounded 8px', x: 460, y: 80 },
        { id: 'r4', name: 'Pill', x: 640, y: 80 },
      ],
      edges: [],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 60,
        height: 28,
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
        borderRadius: (d) => d.id === 'r1' ? 0 : d.id === 'r2' ? 4 : d.id === 'r3' ? 8 : 14,
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await g2.render();
  graphs.push(g2);

  return {
    getData: () => ({ views: graphs.map((graph) => graph.getData()) }),
    fitView: () => graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.fitView()),
    destroy: () => {
      graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.destroy());
      div1.remove(); div2.remove();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [节点配置](/docs/guides/node)
- [节点参考](/docs/api/options#options-node)

# 节点数据映射样式 (/docs/examples/node-style)





按业务字段动态设置节点颜色、尺寸和高亮交互。

## 如何体验

悬停节点或边，观察关联高亮。

## 数据说明

cluster=a 映射蓝色、cluster=b 映射绿色；id=0 的节点尺寸为 16，其他节点为 12。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: 节点样式 — 按 data 用函数设置 fill、size
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: '0', name: 'A', data: { cluster: 'a' } },
        { id: '1', name: 'B', data: { cluster: 'b' } },
        { id: '2', name: 'C', data: { cluster: 'a' } },
        { id: '3', name: 'D', data: { cluster: 'b' } },
        { id: '4', name: 'E', data: { cluster: 'a' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: '0', target: '1' },
        { source: '0', target: '2' },
        { source: '1', target: '3' },
        { source: '2', target: '4' },
        { source: '3', target: '4' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: (d) => (d.data?.cluster === 'a' ? '#5B8FF9' : '#61DDAA'),
        size: (d) => (d.id === '0' ? 16 : 12),
      },
    },
    edge: { type: 'line', style: { lineWidth: 2 } },
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 150 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node', 'highlight-edge'],
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```

# 组织架构图 (/docs/examples/org-chart)





使用层级布局、矩形节点和树形连线，展示组织与团队的上下级关系。

## 如何体验

缩放或拖拽画布查看组织层级，使用“适应画布”还原完整结构。

## 数据说明

虚构科技公司的组织示意：6 个岗位 / 团队节点与 5 条层级连线。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository provide example label overlays.
/**
 * Demo: 组织架构图 — 科技公司 (dagre TB + 大矩形节点 + 多行文字自动换行 + 曲线树边)
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const LEVEL_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  ceo: '#4A7DC0',
  vp: '#E8944A',
  team: '#D45B5B',
};

const NODE_W = 180;
const NODE_H = 70;

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'ceo', name: 'CEO', data: { title: '首席执行官', level: 'ceo' } },
    { id: 'cto', name: 'CTO', data: { title: '首席技术官', level: 'vp' } },
    { id: 'cfo', name: 'CFO', data: { title: '首席财务官', level: 'vp' } },
    { id: 'coo', name: 'COO', data: { title: '首席运营官', level: 'vp' } },
    { id: 'fe', name: '前端团队', data: { title: '负责人：张工', level: 'team' } },
    { id: 'be', name: '后端团队', data: { title: '负责人：李工', level: 'team' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'ceo', target: 'cto' },
    { source: 'ceo', target: 'cfo' },
    { source: 'ceo', target: 'coo' },
    { source: 'cto', target: 'fe' },
    { source: 'cto', target: 'be' },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: wrapper,
    data,
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: (n) => LEVEL_COLORS[n.data?.level as string] ?? '#5B8FF9',
        width: NODE_W,
        height: NODE_H,
        borderRadius: 8,
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'polyline',
      style: {
        stroke: '#c0c0c0',
        lineWidth: 1.5,
        router: 'tree',
        endArrow: false,
        startArrow: false,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'TB', nodesep: 50, ranksep: 80, nodeSize: [NODE_W, NODE_H] },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 64 });

  const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
  const cleanupLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    nodeLabel: (n) => `${n.name}\n${n.data?.title ?? ''}`,
    position: 'inside',
    nodeSize: () => {
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      return { width: NODE_W / dpr, height: NODE_H / dpr };
    },
    // Camera zoom is measured in physical pixels; the overlay expects CSS pixels.
    fontSize: () => 13 * graph.getCamera().zoom / Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1),
    color: '#fff',
    secondaryColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)',
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => { cleanupLabels(); graph.destroy(); },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [布局选择](/docs/guides/layout)
- [布局参考](/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# 平行边与反向边 (/docs/examples/parallel-edges)





自动错开同源同目标的多条边、反向边和单边。

## 如何体验

拖拽节点、悬停和点选边，观察曲线与标签变化。

## 数据说明

4 个节点和 7 条边，包含 6 条平行或反向边。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: process-parallel-edges
 */
import { Graph, type TooltipContext } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    // Padding keeps arc-apex edge labels and bottom node labels inside view.
    autoFit: { padding: 56 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'source', name: 'Source', x: 180, y: 220 },
        { id: 'target', name: 'Target', x: 520, y: 220 },
        { id: 'singleA', name: 'Single A', x: 180, y: 420 },
        { id: 'singleB', name: 'Single B', x: 520, y: 420 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'e1', source: 'source', target: 'target', data: { label: 'approve' } },
        { id: 'e2', source: 'source', target: 'target', data: { label: 'reject' } },
        { id: 'e3', source: 'source', target: 'target', data: { label: 'review' } },
        { id: 'e4', source: 'source', target: 'target', data: { label: 'archive' } },
        { id: 'r1', source: 'target', target: 'source', data: { label: 'rollback' } },
        { id: 'r2', source: 'target', target: 'source', data: { label: 'notify' } },
        { id: 'single', source: 'singleA', target: 'singleB', data: { label: 'single edge' } },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        size: 34,
        fill: (node) => (node.id.startsWith('single') ? '#36B37E' : '#5B8FF9'),
        stroke: '#ffffff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
        label: (node) => node.name ?? node.id,
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      parallelEdges: {
        enabled: true,
        offset: 26,
        includeReverse: true,
      },
      style: {
        stroke: (_s, _t, edge) => (edge.source === 'target' ? '#F08F56' : '#6B8FF8'),
        endArrow: true,
        arrowSize: 12,
        label: (_s, _t, edge) => String(edge.data?.label ?? ''),
        labelFontSize: 11,
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)',
        labelBackgroundPadding: 4,
        labelAutoRotate: true,
      },
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { stroke: '#F4664A', lineWidth: 2 },
        active: { stroke: '#00A3A3' },
      },
    },
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      'drag-node',
      'hover-highlight',
      'click-select',
      {
        type: 'tooltip',
        trigger: 'hover',
        getContent: (ctx: TooltipContext) => {
          if (ctx.itemType === 'edge') {
            const label = (ctx.data as { label?: string } | undefined)?.label ?? ctx.edgeId;
            return `${ctx.source} -> ${ctx.target}<br/><span style="color:#8c8c8c">${label}</span>`;
          }
          return String(ctx.nodeId);
        },
      },
    ],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [平行边与自环](/docs/guides/edge#parallel-edges)
- [边参考](/docs/api/options#options-edge)

# 折线与正交路由 (/docs/examples/polyline-routing)





用圆角正交折线连接从左到右的流程节点。

## 如何体验

缩放和平移，观察正交圆角折线连接端点边界；该路由不是全图避障算法，刷新恢复初始视野。

## 数据说明

5 个矩形节点用正交圆角折线连接。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: orthogonal polyline edges with rounded corners.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'request', data: { label: '请求' } },
        { id: 'auth', data: { label: '鉴权' } },
        { id: 'cache', data: { label: '缓存' } },
        { id: 'service', data: { label: '服务' } },
        { id: 'db', data: { label: '数据库' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'request', target: 'auth' },
        { source: 'auth', target: 'cache' },
        { source: 'auth', target: 'service' },
        { source: 'service', target: 'db' },
        { source: 'cache', target: 'db' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 88,
        height: 36,
        borderRadius: 8,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'polyline',
      style: {
        stroke: '#8C8C8C',
        lineWidth: 1.5,
        endArrow: true,
        radius: 12,
        router: 'orth',
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', nodesep: 28, ranksep: 72, nodeSize: [88, 36] },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```
