# 查询、批量状态与可见性 (/docs/examples/queries-and-states)





验证元素、邻接、状态查询，以及批量状态和可见性控制。

## 如何体验

查询 root 应得到 n1、n2 两个邻居和两条关联边。再对比批量增减、按指定 ID 替换状态、Combo 高亮与隐藏；未指定的 ID 保留原状态，全部清理恢复空状态。

## 数据说明

使用带邻接关系的数据验证 Graph 查询模型。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph, type GraphData } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const DATA: GraphData = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'root', x: 180, y: 160, comboId: 'left', data: { label: 'Root' } },
    { id: 'n1', x: 340, y: 90, comboId: 'right', data: { label: 'N1' } },
    { id: 'n2', x: 340, y: 230, comboId: 'right', data: { label: 'N2' } },
    { id: 'n3', x: 500, y: 160, data: { label: 'N3' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e-root-n1', source: 'root', target: 'n1' },
    { id: 'e-root-n2', source: 'root', target: 'n2' },
    { id: 'e-n1-n3', source: 'n1', target: 'n3' },
    { id: 'e-n2-n3', source: 'n2', target: 'n3' },
  ],
  combos: [
    { id: 'left', data: { label: '查询起点' } },
    { id: 'right', data: { label: '状态分组' } },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: DATA,
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 32,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { fill: '#873BF4', stroke: '#5B21B6', strokeWidth: 3 },
        active: { fill: '#13C2C2', stroke: '#08979C', strokeWidth: 3 },
        highlight: { fill: '#FA8C16', stroke: '#D46B08', strokeWidth: 3 },
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { stroke: '#94a3b8', endArrow: true } },
    combo: { style: { padding: 24, label: (combo) => String(combo.data?.label ?? combo.id) } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 80 });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  const showStateSummary = (prefix: string) => {
    ui.setStatus(
      `${prefix}\nselected nodes=${graph.findNodesByState('selected').join(', ') || '-'}\n` +
        `active edges=${graph.findEdgesByState('active').join(', ') || '-'}\n` +
        `highlight combos=${graph.findCombosByState('highlight').join(', ') || '-'}`,
    );
  };

  ui.addAction('查询 root', () => {
    const element = graph.getElementData('root');
    const position = graph.getElementPosition('root');
    ui.setStatus(
      `hasNode=${graph.hasNode('root')} hasEdge=${graph.hasEdge('e-root-n1')} hasElement=${graph.hasElement('right')}\n` +
        `element=${element?.id} position=${position?.x},${position?.y}\n` +
        `neighbors=${graph.getNeighborNodes('root').join(', ')}\n` +
        `adjacent=${graph.getAdjacentEdges('root').map((edge) => edge.id).join(', ')}`,
    );
  });
  ui.addAction('批量设状态', () => {
    graph.batchSetState([
      { id: 'root', state: 'selected', value: true },
      { id: 'n3', state: 'selected', value: true },
      { id: 'e-root-n1', state: 'active', value: true },
    ]);
    showStateSummary('batchSetState');
  });
  ui.addAction('替换状态', () => {
    graph.setElementStates({ root: ['highlight'], n1: ['selected'], 'e-root-n2': ['active'] });
    showStateSummary('setElementStates');
  });
  ui.addAction('Combo 状态', () => {
    graph.setItemState('right', 'highlight', true);
    const children = graph.getComboChildren('right');
    ui.setStatus(`combo=${graph.getComboData('right')?.id}\nchildren=${children.nodes.join(', ')}\nstates=${graph.getItemStates('right').join(', ')}`);
  });
  ui.addAction('隐藏 n2', () => {
    const hidden = graph.getItemStates('n2').includes('hidden');
    if (hidden) graph.showItem('n2');
    else graph.hideItem('n2');
    ui.setStatus(`n2 states=${graph.getItemStates('n2').join(', ') || '-'}`);
  });
  ui.addAction('全部清理', () => {
    for (const node of graph.getNodes()) graph.clearItemStates(node.id);
    for (const edge of graph.getEdges()) graph.clearItemStates(edge.id);
    for (const comboId of ['left', 'right']) graph.clearItemStates(comboId);
    showStateSummary('clearItemStates');
  });

  showStateSummary('ready');
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [读取与邻接查询](/docs/api/graph#graph-data)
- [状态与显隐](/docs/api/graph#graph-states)
- [Combo 操作](/docs/api/graph#graph-combo)

# 辐射树 (/docs/examples/radial-tree)





用辐射布局把一棵主题树铺在中心节点周围。

## 如何体验

缩放查看中心主题和周围分支。

## 数据说明

一棵 10 个节点的主题树围绕根节点排列。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: a topic tree laid out with the radial algorithm.
 */
import { Graph, register } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import radial from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/radial';

const TREE: Array<[string, string, string?]> = [
  ['root', '产品'],
  ['research', '研究', 'root'],
  ['design', '设计', 'root'],
  ['build', '研发', 'root'],
  ['interview', '访谈', 'research'],
  ['metrics', '指标', 'research'],
  ['flow', '流程', 'design'],
  ['visual', '视觉', 'design'],
  ['api', '接口', 'build'],
  ['test', '测试', 'build'],
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'radial', radial);
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: 32 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: TREE.map(([id, label]) => ({ id, data: { label, root: id === 'root' } })),
      edges: TREE.filter((item) => item[2]).map(([id, , parent]) => ({ source: parent!, target: id })),
    },
    node: {
      style: {
        size: (node) => (node.data?.root ? 46 : 28),
        fill: (node) => (node.data?.root ? '#E86452' : '#5B8FF9'),
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { stroke: '#C5CEDB', lineWidth: 1.5 } },
    layout: { type: 'radial', unitRadius: 110, linkDistance: 90, nodeSize: 28 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [布局选择](/docs/guides/layout)
- [布局参考](/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# AI Papers 大规模关系图 (/docs/examples/real-dataset)





使用真实论文引用网络验证大图渲染和交互链路。

## 如何体验

缩放、拖拽画布并悬停节点，观察大规模关系图的交互表现。

## 数据说明

AI Papers 数据包含 8,798 个节点和 71,077 条边，复用预计算 ForceAtlas2 坐标。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: 真实数据集 — sigma.js 官网首页同款数据
 *
 * 两个数据集来自 sigma.js 官方仓库(MIT),由 scripts/fetch-sigma-datasets.mjs 转换:
 *  - wikipedia.json   2085 节点 / 5409 边   (v3 官网首页:数据可视化维基百科网络)
 *  - ai-papers.json   8798 节点 / 71077 边  (v4 官网首页:高被引 AI 论文引用网络)
 *
 * 节点自带 sigma 预跑好的 ForceAtlas2 坐标,这里直接复用预置布局(不重跑 layout),
 * 用于横向对比 G6Lite 与 sigma.js 在相同真实数据上的渲染表现。
 */
import { Graph, type GraphData } from '@antv/g6-lite';

// 切换这里即可换数据集
const DATASET = new URL('./datasets/ai-papers.json', import.meta.url).href;

// 聚类调色板(cluster -> color),覆盖两个数据集的常见 class 数量
const PALETTE = [
  '#5B8FF9', '#61DDAA', '#F6BD16', '#7262FD', '#78D3F8',
  '#9661BC', '#F6903D', '#008685', '#F08BB4', '#E8684A',
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const data: GraphData = await fetch(DATASET).then((r) => r.json());
  // Uniformly rescale the precomputed layout to keep node bodies visible at fit.
  // Relative positions and the original network topology remain unchanged.
  data.nodes = data.nodes.map((node) => ({ ...node, x: (node.x ?? 0) * 0.02, y: (node.y ?? 0) * 0.02 }));
  const fitOptions = { padding: 32 };

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: fitOptions,
    container,
    data,
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        // 优先用数据自带 color(wikipedia),否则按 cluster 取色板(ai-papers)
        fill: (d) => {
          const c = d.data?.color as string | undefined;
          if (c) return c;
          const idx = parseInt((d.data?.cluster as string) ?? '0', 10) || 0;
          return PALETTE[idx % PALETTE.length];
        },
        size: 4,
      },
    },
    edge: { type: 'line', style: { lineWidth: 0.4, stroke: '#ccc' } },
    // 复用预置坐标:不配置 layout
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(fitOptions),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [性能测量](/docs/metrics/performance)
- [性能优化](/docs/metrics/performance#performance-tuning)

# 人物关系网络 (/docs/examples/relationship)





通过人物节点和关系标签，展示力导布局下的关联网络。

## 如何体验

缩放或拖拽画布，悬停人物查看关联高亮；点击“适应画布”恢复全图。

## 数据说明

哈利·波特角色关系示意：8 个人物节点与 10 条带标签的关系边。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository provide example label overlays.
/**
 * Demo: 人物关系网络图 — 哈利波特角色关系 (force 布局 + 边标签)
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, attachEdgeLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  gryffindor: '#5B8FF9',
  friend: '#F6BD16',
  enemy: '#30BF78',
  mentor: '#E86452',
};

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'harry', name: '哈利·波特', data: { house: 'gryffindor' } },
    { id: 'ron', name: '罗恩·韦斯莱', data: { house: 'friend' } },
    { id: 'hermione', name: '赫敏·格兰杰', data: { house: 'mentor' } },
    { id: 'voldemort', name: '伏地魔', data: { house: 'enemy' } },
    { id: 'dumbledore', name: '邓布利多', data: { house: 'mentor' } },
    { id: 'snape', name: '斯内普', data: { house: 'friend' } },
    { id: 'draco', name: '德拉科', data: { house: 'enemy' } },
    { id: 'sirius', name: '小天狼星', data: { house: 'friend' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'ron', target: 'harry', data: { label: '朋友' } },
    { source: 'hermione', target: 'harry', data: { label: '朋友' } },
    { source: 'harry', target: 'voldemort', data: { label: '试图杀死' } },
    { source: 'dumbledore', target: 'harry', data: { label: '导师' } },
    { source: 'snape', target: 'harry', data: { label: '保护' } },
    { source: 'draco', target: 'harry', data: { label: '敌对' } },
    { source: 'sirius', target: 'harry', data: { label: '教父' } },
    { source: 'ron', target: 'hermione', data: { label: '朋友' } },
    { source: 'snape', target: 'voldemort', data: { label: '暗中效忠' } },
    { source: 'dumbledore', target: 'snape', data: { label: '信任' } },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  // Use the same fit for initial render, resize, and the toolbar action.
  // A low maxZoom leaves this small network tiny on large or high-DPI canvases.
  const fitOptions = { padding: 64 };
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: fitOptions,
    container: wrapper,
    data,
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: (n) => COLORS[n.data?.house as string] ?? '#5B8FF9',
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#bbb',
        lineWidth: 1.5,
        endArrow: true,
      },
    },
    layout: {
      type: 'd3-force',
      linkDistance: 180,
      nodeStrength: -600,
      collideRadius: 60,
      forceSimulation: null,
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();

  const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
  const cleanupNodeLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    nodeLabel: (n) => n.name ?? n.id,
    position: 'below',
    fontSize: 11,
    color: '#333',
  });
  const cleanupEdgeLabels = attachEdgeLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    fontSize: 9,
    color: '#555',
    rotated: true,
    showBg: false,
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(fitOptions),
    destroy: () => { cleanupNodeLabels(); cleanupEdgeLabels(); graph.destroy(); },
  };
}
```

- [节点映射](/docs/guides/node)

# 搜索并聚焦 (/docs/examples/search-focus)





按名称搜索节点，高亮匹配项并把视口移过去。

## 如何体验

输入名称片段，匹配节点会高亮并移入视口。

## 数据说明

12 个带名称的节点，按名称片段匹配。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: search nodes by name, highlight matches, and focus the viewport.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const PEOPLE = [
  'Alice',
  'Bob',
  'Carol',
  'David',
  'Emma',
  'Frank',
  'Grace',
  'Helen',
  'Ivan',
  'Julia',
  'Kevin',
  'Laura',
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  host.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: host,
    data: {
      nodes: PEOPLE.map((name, index) => ({
        id: name.toLowerCase(),
        data: { label: name, group: index % 3 },
      })),
      edges: PEOPLE.slice(1).map((name, index) => ({
        source: PEOPLE[index % 4].toLowerCase(),
        target: name.toLowerCase(),
      })),
    },
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 32,
        fill: (node) => ['#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16'][Number(node.data?.group ?? 0)],
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 180 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();

  const hint = '输入名称片段，例如 al';
  const ui = createDemoPanel(host, hint);
  let highlighted: string[] = [];
  ui.gui.add({ query: '' }, 'query').name('搜索节点').onChange((value: string) => {
    for (const id of highlighted) graph.clearItemStates(id);
    const query = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    highlighted = query
      ? graph
          .getNodes()
          .filter((node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id).toLowerCase().includes(query))
          .map((node) => node.id)
      : [];
    for (const id of highlighted) graph.setItemState(id, 'highlight', true);
    if (highlighted.length > 0) graph.focusItem(highlighted, 48);
    ui.setStatus(query ? `${highlighted.length} 个匹配` : hint);
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [视口指南](/docs/guides/viewport)
- [视口方法](/docs/api/graph#graph-viewport)

# 点选、框选与拉索选择 (/docs/examples/selection-behaviors)





在同一示例中比较 click、brush 和 lasso 选择行为。

## 如何体验

三种方式同时生效：Shift+点击多选，Shift+拖拽框选，Ctrl/⌘+拖拽拉索。

## 数据说明

规则分布的节点用于观察不同选择范围。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const nodes = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({
    id: String(index),
    x: 120 + (index % 4) * 120,
    y: 100 + Math.floor(index / 4) * 110,
  }));
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: { nodes, edges: [] },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#873BF4', stroke: '#5B21B6', strokeWidth: 3 } },
    },
    behaviors: [
      { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
      'zoom-canvas',
      { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
      { type: 'brush-select', key: 'shift' },
      { type: 'lasso-select', key: 'ctrl' },
    ],
  });
  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 80 });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container, 'Shift+点击多选，Shift+拖拽框选，Ctrl/⌘+自由拖拽套索选择。');

  // Keep the modifier keys visible at all times; the event line updates as
  // the user interacts, the hint line stays.
  const HINT = 'Shift+点击多选 · Shift+拖拽框选 · Ctrl/⌘+拖拽拉索';
  const render = (eventName: string) => {
    const selected = graph.findNodesByState('selected').join(', ') || '-';
    ui.setStatus(`${HINT}\n${eventName}\nselected=${selected}`);
  };
  graph.on('node:selectchange', () => render('node:selectchange'));
  graph.on('brush:end', () => render('brush:end'));
  graph.on('lasso:end', () => render('lasso:end'));
  render('ready');

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [状态使用](/docs/guides/states)
- [交互组合](/docs/guides/behaviors)

# 全量替换数据 (/docs/examples/set-data)





用 setData 替换整图数据，并在替换后切换布局。

## 如何体验

数据 A/B 分别显示 5/8 个节点。切换后再尝试布局、隐藏与聚焦；这是全量替换，不保留旧数据集的元素。

## 数据说明

工具条会替换整份节点和边，再重新布局。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: setData + layout() 端到端验证
 * 测试运行时整体数据替换和布局切换
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const DATA_A = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'a1' },
    { id: 'a2' },
    { id: 'a3' },
    { id: 'a4' },
    { id: 'a5' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'a1', target: 'a2' },
    { source: 'a1', target: 'a3' },
    { source: 'a2', target: 'a4' },
    { source: 'a3', target: 'a5' },
    { source: 'a4', target: 'a5' },
  ],
};

const DATA_B = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'b1' },
    { id: 'b2' },
    { id: 'b3' },
    { id: 'b4' },
    { id: 'b5' },
    { id: 'b6' },
    { id: 'b7' },
    { id: 'b8' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'b1', target: 'b2' },
    { source: 'b1', target: 'b3' },
    { source: 'b2', target: 'b4' },
    { source: 'b3', target: 'b5' },
    { source: 'b4', target: 'b6' },
    { source: 'b5', target: 'b7' },
    { source: 'b6', target: 'b8' },
    { source: 'b7', target: 'b8' },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const el = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;

  el.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: el,
    data: DATA_A,
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 120 },
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      'drag-node',
      { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
      'highlight-node',
      'highlight-edge',
    ],
    node: { style: { size: 20, fill: '#5B8FF9' } },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph.render();

  const log = (msg: string) => console.log(`[setData demo] ${msg}`);

  graph.on('datachange', (e: any) => log(`datachange: ${e.nodeCount} nodes, ${e.edgeCount} edges`));
  graph.on('layout:start', () => log('layout:start'));
  graph.on('layout:end', (e: any) => log(`layout:end: ${e.duration.toFixed(1)}ms`));

  const ui = createDemoPanel(el);
  ui.addChoice('数据', { 'A · 5 节点': 'a', 'B · 8 节点': 'b' }, 'a', async (value) => {
    const next = value === 'b' ? DATA_B : DATA_A;
    log(`setData → DATA_${value.toUpperCase()}`);
    await graph.setData(next);
    graph.fitView();
    log(`done. nodeCount=${graph.getNodeCount()}`);
  });

  ui.addChoice('布局', ['circular', 'grid', 'force'], 'circular', async (value) => {
    log(`setLayout(${value}) + layout()`);
    if (value === 'grid') graph.setLayout({ type: 'grid' });
    else if (value === 'force') graph.setLayout({ type: 'd3-force' });
    else graph.setLayout({ type: 'circular', radius: 150 });
    await graph.layout();
    graph.fitView();
    log(`${value} done`);
  });

  const updateVisibility = (action: 'hide' | 'show') => {
    const id = graph.hasNode('b1') ? 'b1' : 'a1';
    log(`${action}Item(${id})`);
    if (action === 'hide') graph.hideItem(id);
    else graph.showItem(id);
    log(`states after ${action}: ${JSON.stringify(graph.getItemStates(id))}`);
  };
  ui.addAction('hideItem', () => updateVisibility('hide'));
  ui.addAction('showItem', () => updateVisibility('show'));
  ui.addAction('focusItem', () => {
    const id = graph.hasNode('b8') ? 'b8' : 'a5';
    log(`focusItem(${id})`);
    graph.focusItem(id);
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```

- [setData 契约](/docs/api/graph#graph-data-mutations-setdata)
- [视野保留](/docs/guides/viewport)

# 图形类型 (/docs/examples/shapes)





并排查看圆形和矩形节点。

## 如何体验

对比上下两张图里的圆形和矩形节点。

## 数据说明

两张小图分别使用圆形和矩形节点。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: 混合图形 — 矩形节点 + 弧线边 + 粗线边
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  // --- Rect nodes with arc edges ---
  const rectContainer = document.createElement('div');
  rectContainer.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  rectContainer.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;';
  const arcLabel = document.createElement('div');
  arcLabel.textContent = 'Rect nodes + Arc edges';
  arcLabel.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:4px;left:8px;color:#888;font-size:12px;z-index:1;';
  rectContainer.appendChild(arcLabel);
  (typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! : container).appendChild(rectContainer);

  const graph1 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: rectContainer,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: '0', name: 'A' },
        { id: '1', name: 'B' },
        { id: '2', name: 'C' },
        { id: '3', name: 'D' },
        { id: '4', name: 'E' },
        { id: '5', name: 'F' },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: '0', target: '1' },
        { source: '0', target: '2' },
        { source: '1', target: '3' },
        { source: '2', target: '4' },
        { source: '3', target: '5' },
        { source: '4', target: '5' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: (d) => ['#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16', '#E86452', '#6DC8EC', '#945FB9'][parseInt(d.id) % 6],
        width: 32,
        height: 20,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'arc',
      style: {
        stroke: '#aaa',
        curvature: 0.25,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 48 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node', 'highlight-edge'],
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph1.render();

  // --- Circle nodes with thick edges ---
  const thickContainer = document.createElement('div');
  thickContainer.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  thickContainer.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;margin-top:10px;';
  const thickLabel = document.createElement('div');
  thickLabel.textContent = 'Circle nodes + Thick edges (lineWidth: 3)';
  thickLabel.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:4px;left:8px;color:#888;font-size:12px;z-index:1;';
  thickContainer.appendChild(thickLabel);
  (typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! : container).appendChild(thickContainer);

  const graph2 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: thickContainer,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a' }, { id: 'b' }, { id: 'c' }, { id: 'd' }, { id: 'e' },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'd', target: 'e' },
        { source: 'e', target: 'a' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: { fill: '#E86452', size: 24 },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#6DC8EC',
        lineWidth: 3,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 48 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node', 'highlight-edge'],
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph2.render();

  return {
    getData: () => ({ views: [graph1.getData(), graph2.getData()] }),
    fitView() {
      graph1.fitView();
      graph2.fitView();
    },
    destroy() {
      graph1.destroy();
      graph2.destroy();
      rectContainer.remove();
      thickContainer.remove();
    },
  };
}
```

# Tooltip 浮层 (/docs/examples/tooltip)





悬停节点或边时展示自定义业务信息。

## 如何体验

悬停节点查看角色，悬停边查看协作关系。

## 数据说明

5 名协作成员和 5 条业务关系。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Tooltip 浮层提示
 *
 * - 节点 hover:显示 label + 角色
 * - 边 hover:显示「源 → 目标(关系)」
 * - tooltip 开箱即用,命中事件由交互调度层统一分发,不依赖其它 behavior
 */
import { Graph, type TooltipContext } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'alice', data: { label: 'Alice', role: '产品经理' } },
        { id: 'bob', data: { label: 'Bob', role: '前端工程师' } },
        { id: 'carol', data: { label: 'Carol', role: '后端工程师' } },
        { id: 'dave', data: { label: 'Dave', role: '设计师' } },
        { id: 'erin', data: { label: 'Erin', role: '测试' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'alice', target: 'bob', data: { rel: '协作' } },
        { source: 'alice', target: 'carol', data: { rel: '协作' } },
        { source: 'bob', target: 'carol', data: { rel: '联调' } },
        { source: 'alice', target: 'dave', data: { rel: '评审' } },
        { source: 'bob', target: 'erin', data: { rel: '提测' } },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: { fill: '#5B8FF9', size: 18, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id) },
    },
    edge: { type: 'line', style: { stroke: '#C0C0C0', lineWidth: 2 } },
    layout: { type: 'force', maxIteration: 300 },
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      'highlight-node',
      'highlight-edge',
      {
        type: 'tooltip',
        trigger: 'hover',
        getContent: (ctx: TooltipContext) => {
          if (ctx.itemType === 'node') {
            const { label, role } = (ctx.data ?? {}) as { label?: string; role?: string };
            return `<div style="font-weight:600">${label ?? ctx.nodeId}</div>
                    <div style="color:#8c8c8c;font-size:12px">${role ?? ''}</div>`;
          }
          const rel = (ctx.data as { rel?: string })?.rel ?? '关联';
          return `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}<br/><span style="color:#8c8c8c">${rel}</span>`;
        },
      },
    ],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```

# 视口与坐标转换 (/docs/examples/viewport-controls)





验证 camera、fit、zoom、focus、resize 和屏幕/图坐标互转。

## 如何体验

通过工具条执行视口操作，并观察坐标与尺寸结果。

## 数据说明

固定坐标节点用于验证视口和坐标 API。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 60, y: 80, data: { label: 'A' } },
        { id: 'b', x: 420, y: 80, data: { label: 'B' } },
        { id: 'c', x: 240, y: 300, data: { label: 'C' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'ab', source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { id: 'bc', source: 'b', target: 'c' },
        { id: 'ca', source: 'c', target: 'a' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 36, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' } },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 80 });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  const showCamera = (prefix: string) => {
    const camera = graph.getCamera();
    ui.setStatus(`${prefix}\nzoom=${camera.zoom.toFixed(3)} x=${camera.x.toFixed(1)} y=${camera.y.toFixed(1)}\nnodes=${graph.getNodes().length} edges=${graph.getEdges().length}`);
  };

  const addCameraAction = (label: string, action: string, run: () => void) => {
    ui.addAction(label, () => {
      run();
      showCamera(action);
    });
  };
  addCameraAction('zoomBy +', 'zoom-in', () => graph.zoomBy(1.25));
  addCameraAction('zoomBy −', 'zoom-out', () => graph.zoomBy(0.8));
  addCameraAction('fitView', 'fit', () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }));
  addCameraAction('fitCenter', 'center', () => graph.fitCenter());
  addCameraAction('focus C', 'focus', () => graph.focusItem('c'));
  addCameraAction('setCamera', 'camera', () => graph.setCamera({ zoom: 1.1, x: 80, y: 40 }));
  addCameraAction('resetCamera', 'reset', () => graph.resetCamera());
  addCameraAction('setSize', 'resize', () => graph.setSize(720, 460));
  ui.addAction('坐标互转', () => {
    const position = graph.getNodePosition('a')!;
    const screen = graph.graphToScreen(position.x, position.y);
    const restored = graph.screenToGraph(screen.x, screen.y);
    ui.setStatus(`graph=(${position.x.toFixed(1)}, ${position.y.toFixed(1)})\nscreen=(${screen.x.toFixed(1)}, ${screen.y.toFixed(1)})\nrestored=(${restored.x.toFixed(1)}, ${restored.y.toFixed(1)})`);
  });

  showCamera('ready');
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```

- [视口方法](/docs/api/graph#graph-viewport)

# 缩放范围与灵敏度 (/docs/examples/zoom-options)





把滚轮缩放限制在指定灵敏度和最小、最大比例之间。

## 如何体验

滚动缩放，或把视口设到最小、1 倍和最大比例。

## 数据说明

滚轮缩放被限制在 0.4 到 2 之间。

## 完整运行代码

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: constrain wheel zoom with sensitivity, minZoom, and maxZoom.
 */
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  // #region navigation
  const behaviors = [
    { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 1.4, minZoom: 0.4, maxZoom: 2 },
    { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
  ] satisfies [BuiltInBehaviorConfig, BuiltInBehaviorConfig];
  // #endregion navigation
  const [{ minZoom, maxZoom }] = behaviors;
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 180, y: 180 },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 120 },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 250 },
        { id: 'd', x: 500, y: 180 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'a', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 28, fill: '#5B8FF9' } },
    behaviors,
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const report = () => {
    ui.setStatus(`Zoom ${graph.getZoom().toFixed(2)}× · ${minZoom}–${maxZoom}×`);
  };
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  let reportFrame: number | undefined;
  const onWheel = () => {
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    reportFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { reportFrame = undefined; report(); });
  };
  host.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: true });

  const fitView = graph.fitView.bind(graph);
  graph.fitView = (options) => { fitView(options); report(); };
  const zoomTo = graph.zoomTo.bind(graph);
  graph.zoomTo = (zoom, options) => { zoomTo(zoom, options); report(); };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    host.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    ui.addAction(`${minZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(minZoom));
    ui.addAction('1×', () => graph.zoomTo(1));
    ui.addAction(`${maxZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(maxZoom));
    report();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```


## 继续阅读

- [视口指南](/docs/guides/viewport)
- [视口方法](/docs/api/graph#graph-viewport)

# 性能对比 (/docs/metrics/performance)



本页比较 G6Lite、G6、Sigma.js 和 ECharts 的 Graph 系列。首绘使用同一份预置坐标数据，包体积使用同一种构建方式。测试于 2026-11-13 完成，G6Lite 使用本地打包的 `0.1.0`。

<span id="常用图库选型对比" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="当前公开口径" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

## 首绘耗时 [#render-time]

表中是从创建图到渲染 API 完成后再经过两帧的中位耗时，单位为毫秒。本轮使用无头 Chromium，WebGL 由 SwiftShader 软件渲染。

| npm 包                               | 渲染器       | 1,000 节点 / 3,000 边（ms） | 5,000 节点 / 15,000 边（ms） |
| ----------------------------------- | --------- | ---------------------: | ----------------------: |
| `@antv/g6-lite@0.1.0`               | WebGL     |                  134.1 |                   146.1 |
| `@antv/g6@5.1.1`                    | Canvas 2D |                  297.4 |                 1,502.2 |
| `sigma@4.0.4` + `graphology@0.26.0` | WebGL 2   |                  466.1 |                   748.4 |
| `echarts@6.1.0`                     | Canvas 2D |                   56.6 |                   236.3 |

<span id="环境要求" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="如何进行数值对比" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

### 测试条件 [#benchmark-method]

* Apple M3 Pro，macOS（Darwin 25.2.0），无头 Chromium 151.0.7922.34。画布 900 × 600 CSS 像素，DPR 1。WebGL 渲染器为 `ANGLE (Google, Vulkan 1.3.0 (SwiftShader Device (LLVM 10.0.0) (0x0000C0DE)), SwiftShader driver)`。
* 数据使用相同节点、边和固定坐标，绘制圆形节点与直线边，关闭标签和动画，不运行布局。每个规模下，每个库预热 3 次后交错测量 20 次，测完销毁实例。
* 库在计时前已加载。计时包含图实例和内部模型的创建、首次渲染与两次帧回调。Sigma.js 包含 Graphology 建图。该指标反映本场景的首绘等待，GPU 执行时间、布局和交互需分别测量。 [下载原始样本](/benchmarks/graph-performance.json)

本轮结果只适用于上述测试环境，不代表最低浏览器版本认证。各浏览器的能力版本参考与尚未覆盖的验收范围见[最低浏览器版本](/docs/compatibility/browser#最低浏览器版本)。

## 浏览器包体积 [#bundle-size]

使用 esbuild 0.21.5 将各库的 npm 入口和依赖打包为单个浏览器脚本，并进行代码压缩。G6Lite 测量默认入口，可选布局按需引入。ECharts 只引入 GraphChart 和 CanvasRenderer，Sigma.js 包含 Graphology。体积以 KiB 计，不含 source map。

| npm 包                               | 代码压缩后（KiB） | gzip -9（KiB） |
| ----------------------------------- | ---------: | -----------: |
| `@antv/g6-lite@0.1.0`               |      511.3 |        159.5 |
| `@antv/g6@5.1.1`                    |    1,435.3 |        413.4 |
| `sigma@4.0.4` + `graphology@0.26.0` |      438.4 |        110.7 |
| `echarts@6.1.0`                     |      386.3 |        130.2 |

### G6Lite CDN 文件体积 [#umd-size]

CDN 文件使用 `gzip -9` 分别测量，1 kB = 1,000 字节。首页展示默认脚本的体积。

| 发布文件                     | 内容                | gzip -9（kB） |
| ------------------------ | ----------------- | ----------: |
| `g6-lite.min.js`         | 默认脚本，包含渲染、交互和内置布局 |       150.2 |
| `g6-lite-layouts.min.js` | 六种可选布局，使用时额外加载    |        29.1 |

需要使用可选布局时，加载附加脚本后注册对应的布局。 [可选布局用法](/docs/guides/layout-overview#optional-layouts)

## 业务图怎么测 [#performance-tuning]

用真实数据和目标设备分别记录布局、首绘和交互。首屏慢先拆开布局与绘制，再评估 Worker。更新卡顿时，复用图实例，通过增量 API 更新数据或状态。缩放掉帧时，逐项对比标签、装饰和视口尺寸。反复挂载后检查销毁与监听清理。 [Worker 布局](/docs/guides/layout-worker) · [数据写入](/docs/api/graph#graph-data-mutations) · [标签策略](/docs/api/options#options-label)

**相关可运行示例**

* [200 节点](/docs/examples/large)
* [5000 节点与标签](/docs/examples/large-labeled)
* [AI Papers 大规模关系图](/docs/examples/real-dataset)


# 框选 (/docs/guides/behavior-brush-select)





拖出矩形，选中中心落在矩形内的节点。

## 配置方式 [#配置方式]

启动框选的按键用 `key` 设置。示例中从空白处按住 Shift 拖动，直接拖动仍可平移画布。

## 示例 [#示例]



```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['drag-canvas', { type: 'brush-select', key: 'shift' }];
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, type BehaviorOption } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region behavior-config
  const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['drag-canvas', { type: 'brush-select', key: 'shift' }];
  // #endregion behavior-config

  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 },
        { id: 'B', x: 120, y: -65 },
        { id: 'C', x: 120, y: 65 },
        { id: 'D', x: 240, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' },
        { id: 'A-C', source: 'A', target: 'C' },
        { id: 'B-D', source: 'B', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'D-E', source: 'D', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2', haloWidth: 10 } },
    },
    edge: {
      style: { lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 14, endArrow: false },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#8050d2', lineWidth: 4 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[参数与默认值](/docs/api/options#选择)


# 点击选中 (/docs/guides/behavior-click-select)





点击节点或边切换选中状态，点击画布空白处清空选择。

## 配置方式 [#配置方式]

```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = [{ type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' }];
```

```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = [{ type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true }];
```

```ts
        { id: 'B-D', source: 'B', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' },
```

# 拖动边端点 (/docs/guides/behavior-drag-edge)





拖动已有边的端点，松开时通过事件获取重连目标。

## 配置方式 [#配置方式]

从靠近端点的位置开始拖动。松开后，`edge:dragend` 返回重连建议，确认后调用 `updateEdgeData()` 写回。

## 示例 [#示例]



```ts
graph.on('edge:dragend', ({ edgeId, source, target, reconnected }) => {
  if (reconnected && edgeId) {
    graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: edgeId, source, target }]);
  }
  ui.setStatus(`dragend reconnected=${reconnected}\n${edgeId ?? '-'}: ${source} → ${target}`);
});
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 120, y: 160, data: { label: 'A' } },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 80, data: { label: 'B' } },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 240, data: { label: 'C' } },
        { id: 'd', x: 560, y: 160, data: { label: 'D' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'editable-edge', source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { id: 'reference-edge', source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 38, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' } },
    edge: { style: { lineWidth: 4, hitAreaWidth: 16, endArrow: true } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-edge'],
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  graph.on('edge:dragstart', (payload: { edgeId?: string; dragEnd: string }) => {
    ui.setStatus(`dragstart ${payload.edgeId ?? '-'} (${payload.dragEnd})`);
  });
  // #region reconnect
  graph.on('edge:dragend', ({ edgeId, source, target, reconnected }) => {
    if (reconnected && edgeId) {
      graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: edgeId, source, target }]);
    }
    ui.setStatus(`dragend reconnected=${reconnected}\n${edgeId ?? '-'}: ${source} → ${target}`);
  });
  // #endregion reconnect

  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



[参数与默认值](/docs/api/options#导航与拖拽)


# 拖动节点与分组 (/docs/guides/behavior-drag-node)





拖动节点，或从分组空白处拖动整个分组。

## 配置方式 [#配置方式]

拖动已选节点时，其他已选节点会一起移动。分组归属可通过分组 API 单独更新。

## 示例 [#示例]



```ts
behaviors: [
  'zoom-canvas',
  'drag-canvas',
  { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
  'drag-node',
],
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
/**
 * Demo: drag individual nodes, and drag a combo by its background.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'web', data: { label: 'Web' }, x: 160, y: 150, comboId: 'clients' },
        { id: 'app', data: { label: 'App' }, x: 160, y: 250, comboId: 'clients' },
        { id: 'api', data: { label: 'API' }, x: 380, y: 200 },
        { id: 'db', data: { label: 'DB' }, x: 560, y: 140 },
        { id: 'cache', data: { label: 'Cache' }, x: 560, y: 270 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'web', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'app', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'api', target: 'db' },
        { source: 'api', target: 'cache' },
      ],
      combos: [{ id: 'clients', data: { label: '客户端' } }],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 72,
        height: 32,
        borderRadius: 8,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2' } },
    },
    combo: {
      style: {
        label: (combo) => String(combo.data?.label ?? combo.id),
        labelPlacement: 'top',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true, stroke: '#99ADD1' } },
    // #region drag-options
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
      'drag-node',
    ],
    // #endregion drag-options
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    graph.fitView({ padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 });
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[参数与默认值](/docs/api/options#导航与拖拽) · [动态调整分组归属](/docs/guides/combo#动态调整归属)


# 拖动节点、分组与边 (/docs/guides/behavior-dragging)





[拖动节点与分组](/docs/guides/behavior-drag-node) · [拖动边端点](/docs/guides/behavior-drag-edge)

## 拖动节点和分组 [#拖动节点和分组]

节点拖动用 `drag-node` 开启。拖动已选节点时，其他已选节点也会移动。拖动分组里的空白处，可以移动整个分组。



```ts
behaviors: [
  'zoom-canvas',
  'drag-canvas',
  { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
  'drag-node',
],
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
/**
 * Demo: drag individual nodes, and drag a combo by its background.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'web', data: { label: 'Web' }, x: 160, y: 150, comboId: 'clients' },
        { id: 'app', data: { label: 'App' }, x: 160, y: 250, comboId: 'clients' },
        { id: 'api', data: { label: 'API' }, x: 380, y: 200 },
        { id: 'db', data: { label: 'DB' }, x: 560, y: 140 },
        { id: 'cache', data: { label: 'Cache' }, x: 560, y: 270 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'web', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'app', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'api', target: 'db' },
        { source: 'api', target: 'cache' },
      ],
      combos: [{ id: 'clients', data: { label: '客户端' } }],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 72,
        height: 32,
        borderRadius: 8,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2' } },
    },
    combo: {
      style: {
        label: (combo) => String(combo.data?.label ?? combo.id),
        labelPlacement: 'top',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true, stroke: '#99ADD1' } },
    // #region drag-options
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
      'drag-node',
    ],
    // #endregion drag-options
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    graph.fitView({ padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 });
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



节点的分组归属通过分组 API 更新。 [分组方法](/docs/guides/combo#动态调整归属)

## 拖动边的端点 [#拖动边的端点]

边端点拖动用 `drag-edge` 开启。松开后，`edge:dragend` 会报告新的起点和终点。业务确认可以重连后，用 `updateEdgeData()` 保存。



```ts
graph.on('edge:dragend', ({ edgeId, source, target, reconnected }) => {
  if (reconnected && edgeId) {
    graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: edgeId, source, target }]);
  }
  ui.setStatus(`dragend reconnected=${reconnected}\n${edgeId ?? '-'}: ${source} → ${target}`);
});
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 120, y: 160, data: { label: 'A' } },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 80, data: { label: 'B' } },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 240, data: { label: 'C' } },
        { id: 'd', x: 560, y: 160, data: { label: 'D' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'editable-edge', source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { id: 'reference-edge', source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 38, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' } },
    edge: { style: { lineWidth: 4, hitAreaWidth: 16, endArrow: true } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-edge'],
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  graph.on('edge:dragstart', (payload: { edgeId?: string; dragEnd: string }) => {
    ui.setStatus(`dragstart ${payload.edgeId ?? '-'} (${payload.dragEnd})`);
  });
  // #region reconnect
  graph.on('edge:dragend', ({ edgeId, source, target, reconnected }) => {
    if (reconnected && edgeId) {
      graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: edgeId, source, target }]);
    }
    ui.setStatus(`dragend reconnected=${reconnected}\n${edgeId ?? '-'}: ${source} → ${target}`);
  });
  // #endregion reconnect

  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```




# 悬停高亮边 (/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-edge)





悬停边时，突出这条边及其两端节点。

## 配置方式 [#配置方式]

鼠标移开后恢复原样。需要同时处理节点和边悬停时，可用邻域高亮。

## 示例 [#示例]



```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['highlight-edge'];
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, type BehaviorOption } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region behavior-config
  const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['highlight-edge'];
  // #endregion behavior-config

  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 },
        { id: 'B', x: 120, y: -65 },
        { id: 'C', x: 120, y: 65 },
        { id: 'D', x: 240, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' },
        { id: 'A-C', source: 'A', target: 'C' },
        { id: 'B-D', source: 'B', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'D-E', source: 'D', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2', haloWidth: 10 } },
    },
    edge: {
      style: { lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 14, endArrow: false },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#8050d2', lineWidth: 4 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[试用同时处理节点和边的邻域高亮](/docs/guides/behavior-hover-highlight#示例) · [高亮规则](/docs/api/options#高亮)


# 悬停高亮节点 (/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-node)





悬停节点时，突出该节点及与它直接相连的节点和边。

## 配置方式 [#配置方式]

鼠标移开后恢复原样。需要通过状态样式设置高亮颜色时，可用邻域高亮。

## 示例 [#示例]



```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['highlight-node'];
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, type BehaviorOption } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region behavior-config
  const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['highlight-node'];
  // #endregion behavior-config

  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 },
        { id: 'B', x: 120, y: -65 },
        { id: 'C', x: 120, y: 65 },
        { id: 'D', x: 240, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' },
        { id: 'A-C', source: 'A', target: 'C' },
        { id: 'B-D', source: 'B', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'D-E', source: 'D', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2', haloWidth: 10 } },
    },
    edge: {
      style: { lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 14, endArrow: false },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#8050d2', lineWidth: 4 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[试用同时处理节点和边的邻域高亮](/docs/guides/behavior-hover-highlight#示例) · [高亮规则](/docs/api/options#高亮)


# 邻域高亮 (/docs/guides/behavior-hover-highlight)





悬停时高亮节点的邻域，或高亮边及其两端节点。

## 配置方式 [#配置方式]

邻域范围用 `degree` 设置，其余元素可通过 `inactiveState` 弱化。悬停 B 可看到它的一度邻域。

```ts
behaviors: [{ type: 'hover-highlight', degree: 1, inactiveState: 'inactive' }],
```

## 示例 [#示例]



```ts
behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', { type: 'hover-highlight', degree: 1, inactiveState: 'inactive' }],
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 }, { id: 'B', x: 120, y: 0 },
        { id: 'C', x: 240, y: 0 }, { id: 'D', x: 360, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 120, y: 100 }, { id: 'Isolated', x: 360, y: 100 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { source: 'B', target: 'C' },
        { source: 'C', target: 'D' }, { source: 'B', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { highlight: { fill: '#00A876', stroke: '#005C41', strokeWidth: 2 } },
    },
    edge: { style: { hitAreaWidth: 12 }, stateStyles: { highlight: { stroke: '#00A876', lineWidth: 2 } } },
    // #region highlight
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', { type: 'hover-highlight', degree: 1, inactiveState: 'inactive' }],
    // #endregion highlight
    autoFit: { padding: 60, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:20;background:white;color:#334155;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font:12px system-ui;';
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  const updateStatus = () => {
    status.textContent = `highlight: ${graph.findNodesByState('highlight').join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { status.remove(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    graph.on('node:pointerover', updateStatus);
    graph.on('node:pointerleave', updateStatus);
    graph.on('edge:pointerover', updateStatus);
    graph.on('edge:pointerleave', updateStatus);
    updateStatus();
    container.append(status);
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[运行示例与完整代码](/docs/examples/neighbor-highlight) · [参数与默认值](/docs/api/options#高亮)


# 套索选择 (/docs/guides/behavior-lasso-select)

## 配置方式 [#配置方式]

`key: 'ctrl'` 接受 Ctrl 或 ⌘。按住其中一个键，从空白处拖动圈出节点。

## 示例 [#示例]



```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['drag-canvas', { type: 'lasso-select', key: 'ctrl' }];
```

```ts

      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 },
        { id: 'B', x: 120, y: -65 },
        { id: 'C', x: 120, y: 65 },
        { id: 'D', x: 240, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' },
        { id: 'A-C', source: 'A', target: 'C' },
        { id: 'B-D', source: 'B', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'D-E', source: 'D', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2', haloWidth: 10 } },
    },
    edge: {
      style: { lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 14, endArrow: false },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#8050d2', lineWidth: 4 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```
