# 缩放与平移画布 (/docs/guides/behavior-navigation)





[拖动画布](/docs/guides/behavior-drag-canvas) · [缩放画布](/docs/guides/behavior-zoom-canvas)

## 配置方式 [#配置方式]

滚轮缩放用 `zoom-canvas` 开启，拖动画布空白处平移用 `drag-canvas` 开启。省略 `behaviors` 时，这两项默认开启。

缩放速度通过 `sensitivity` 设置，缩放范围用 `minZoom` 和 `maxZoom` 限定。要给框选或套索留出手势，将平移的 `ignoreModifierKeys` 设为 `true`。

## 示例 [#示例]

在下方画布滚动鼠标，左下角会显示当前缩放倍数。按住鼠标左键拖动空白处，可以平移整张图。



```ts
const behaviors = [
  { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 1.4, minZoom: 0.4, maxZoom: 2 },
  { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
] satisfies [BuiltInBehaviorConfig, BuiltInBehaviorConfig];
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
/**
 * Demo: constrain wheel zoom with sensitivity, minZoom, and maxZoom.
 */
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  // #region navigation
  const behaviors = [
    { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 1.4, minZoom: 0.4, maxZoom: 2 },
    { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
  ] satisfies [BuiltInBehaviorConfig, BuiltInBehaviorConfig];
  // #endregion navigation
  const [{ minZoom, maxZoom }] = behaviors;
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 180, y: 180 },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 120 },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 250 },
        { id: 'd', x: 500, y: 180 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'a', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 28, fill: '#5B8FF9' } },
    behaviors,
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const report = () => {
    ui.setStatus(`Zoom ${graph.getZoom().toFixed(2)}× · ${minZoom}–${maxZoom}×`);
  };
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  let reportFrame: number | undefined;
  const onWheel = () => {
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    reportFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { reportFrame = undefined; report(); });
  };
  host.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: true });

  const fitView = graph.fitView.bind(graph);
  graph.fitView = (options) => { fitView(options); report(); };
  const zoomTo = graph.zoomTo.bind(graph);
  graph.zoomTo = (zoom, options) => { zoomTo(zoom, options); report(); };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    host.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    ui.addAction(`${minZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(minZoom));
    ui.addAction('1×', () => graph.zoomTo(1));
    ui.addAction(`${maxZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(maxZoom));
    report();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



滚轮缩放限制在 0.4 到 2 倍。调用 `zoomTo()` 或 `fitView()` 时，缩放范围由各自的参数决定。 [导航与拖拽参数](/docs/api/options#导航与拖拽)


# 交互总览 (/docs/guides/behavior-overview)





## 什么是交互 [#什么是交互]

交互（Behavior）决定用户操作图时会发生什么。比如拖动空白处平移画布，滚动滚轮缩放，点击节点切换选中状态。

## 内置交互 [#内置交互]

内置交互可直接在 `behaviors` 中使用。点击交互名称可查看配置和示例。

| 分类   | 交互名称                                           | 类型                | 功能说明                      |
| ---- | ---------------------------------------------- | ----------------- | ------------------------- |
| 导航   | [拖动画布](/docs/guides/behavior-drag-canvas)      | `drag-canvas`     | 从画布空白处拖动，平移整张图。           |
| 导航   | [缩放画布](/docs/guides/behavior-zoom-canvas)      | `zoom-canvas`     | 滚动鼠标滚轮，以画布中心为基准缩放。        |
| 选择   | [点击选中](/docs/guides/behavior-click-select)     | `click-select`    | 点击节点或边切换选中状态，点击画布空白处清空选择。 |
| 选择   | [框选](/docs/guides/behavior-brush-select)       | `brush-select`    | 拖出矩形，选中中心落在矩形内的节点。        |
| 选择   | [套索选择](/docs/guides/behavior-lasso-select)     | `lasso-select`    | 沿自由轮廓拖动，选中中心落在圈内的节点。      |
| 编辑   | [拖动节点与分组](/docs/guides/behavior-drag-node)     | `drag-node`       | 拖动节点，或从分组空白处拖动整个分组。       |
| 编辑   | [拖动边端点](/docs/guides/behavior-drag-edge)       | `drag-edge`       | 拖动已有边的端点，松开时通过事件获取重连目标。   |
| 数据探索 | [悬停高亮节点](/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-node) | `highlight-node`  | 悬停节点时，突出该节点及与它直接相连的节点和边。  |
| 数据探索 | [悬停高亮边](/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-edge)  | `highlight-edge`  | 悬停边时，突出这条边及其两端节点。         |
| 数据探索 | [邻域高亮](/docs/guides/behavior-hover-highlight)  | `hover-highlight` | 悬停时高亮节点的邻域，或高亮边及其两端节点。    |
| 数据探索 | [提示框 Tooltip](/docs/guides/behavior-tooltip)   | `tooltip`         | 悬停或点击节点和边时，显示它们的详细信息。     |

## 自定义交互 [#自定义交互]

需要复用一组业务操作时，可以把事件处理封装为自定义交互，注册后通过名称启用。 [查看自定义交互](/docs/guides/custom-behavior)

## 配置和使用 [#配置和使用]

### 基本配置 [#基本配置]

交互列表写在 `new Graph()` 的 `behaviors` 里。使用名称即可采用默认参数。省略 `behaviors` 时，默认开启滚轮缩放和画布平移。

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const graph = new Graph({
  container,
  data,
  behaviors: ['drag-canvas', 'zoom-canvas', 'click-select'],
});

await graph.render();
```

### 配置交互参数 [#配置交互参数]

交互名称通过 `type` 指定，其他参数和 `type` 写在同一层。下方示例可以点击选中、按住 Shift 追加选择，也可以从空白处拖动框选。



```ts
const behaviors = [
  { type: 'zoom-canvas', minZoom: 0.5, maxZoom: 2 },
  'drag-node',
  { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
  { type: 'brush-select', key: null },
] satisfies Array<BehaviorName | BuiltInBehaviorConfig>;
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, type BehaviorName, type BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region behavior-options
  const behaviors = [
    { type: 'zoom-canvas', minZoom: 0.5, maxZoom: 2 },
    'drag-node',
    { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
    { type: 'brush-select', key: null },
  ] satisfies Array<BehaviorName | BuiltInBehaviorConfig>;
  // #endregion behavior-options
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H'].map((id, i) => ({
        id, x: (i % 4) * 120, y: Math.floor(i / 4) * 100,
      })),
      edges: [{ id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { id: 'D-H', source: 'D', target: 'H' }],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#873BF4', stroke: '#5B21B6', strokeWidth: 2, haloWidth: 12 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 60, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:20;background:white;color:#334155;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font:12px system-ui;';
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  const updateStatus = () => {
    status.textContent = `selected nodes: ${graph.findNodesByState('selected').join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  };
  graph.on('node:selectchange', updateStatus);
  graph.on('selection:clear', updateStatus);
  graph.on('brush:end', updateStatus);
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { status.remove(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    updateStatus();
    container.append(status);
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



### 动态更新交互 [#动态更新交互]

运行中通过 `setBehaviors()` 替换整份交互列表。数组中写上要启用的所有交互。

```ts
graph.setBehaviors(['drag-canvas', { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 0.5 }]);
```

[试用动态切换示例](/docs/guides/behaviors#switch-behaviors)

### 卸载交互 [#卸载交互]

传入空数组可关闭全部交互。省略参数可恢复默认的平移和缩放。

```ts
graph.setBehaviors([]);
```

## 交互与事件 [#交互与事件]

需要在点击节点后更新业务界面时，可以用 `graph.on()` 监听 `node:click`。组件卸载时，用同一个处理函数取消监听。

```ts
const onNodeClick = ({ nodeId }: { nodeId: string }) => console.log(nodeId);
graph.on('node:click', onNodeClick);

// 组件卸载时
graph.off('node:click', onNodeClick);
```

[交互通用配置项](/docs/guides/behaviors) · [事件指南](/docs/guides/events)


# 点击、框选与套索 (/docs/guides/behavior-selection)



[点击选中](/docs/guides/behavior-click-select) · [框选](/docs/guides/behavior-brush-select) · [套索选择](/docs/guides/behavior-lasso-select)



## 选择方式 [#选择方式]

| 操作         | 配置                                                    |
| ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| 点击节点或边切换选中 | `click-select`。开启 `multiple` 后，按住 `trigger` 指定的键可追加选择 |
| 用矩形框选节点    | `brush-select`，用 `key` 设置启动手势                         |
| 沿自由轮廓圈选节点  | `lasso-select`，用 `key` 设置启动手势                         |

## 配置与示例 [#配置与示例]

下图支持点击选中、Shift + 点击追加选择，以及从空白处拖动框选。选中节点的颜色写在 `node.stateStyles.selected`。



```ts
const behaviors = [
  { type: 'zoom-canvas', minZoom: 0.5, maxZoom: 2 },
  'drag-node',
  { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
  { type: 'brush-select', key: null },
] satisfies Array<BehaviorName | BuiltInBehaviorConfig>;
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, type BehaviorName, type BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region behavior-options
  const behaviors = [
    { type: 'zoom-canvas', minZoom: 0.5, maxZoom: 2 },
    'drag-node',
    { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
    { type: 'brush-select', key: null },
  ] satisfies Array<BehaviorName | BuiltInBehaviorConfig>;
  // #endregion behavior-options
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H'].map((id, i) => ({
        id, x: (i % 4) * 120, y: Math.floor(i / 4) * 100,
      })),
      edges: [{ id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { id: 'D-H', source: 'D', target: 'H' }],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#873BF4', stroke: '#5B21B6', strokeWidth: 2, haloWidth: 12 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 60, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:20;background:white;color:#334155;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font:12px system-ui;';
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  const updateStatus = () => {
    status.textContent = `selected nodes: ${graph.findNodesByState('selected').join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  };
  graph.on('node:selectchange', updateStatus);
  graph.on('selection:clear', updateStatus);
  graph.on('brush:end', updateStatus);
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { status.remove(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    updateStatus();
    container.append(status);
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



平移、框选和套索同时开启时，为它们分配不同手势。可在[选择交互示例](/docs/examples/selection-behaviors)中试用。要在选择后更新业务面板，可监听[选择事件](/docs/guides/events/selection-drag)。


# 提示框 Tooltip (/docs/guides/behavior-tooltip)





悬停或点击节点和边时，显示它们的详细信息。

## 配置方式 [#配置方式]

触发方式通过 `trigger` 设置，内容通过 `getContent` 返回。点击触发时，再次点击同一元素或点击空白处可关闭提示框。

```ts
behaviors: [{ type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'hover', delay: 120 }],
```

## 示例 [#示例]



```ts
const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
  type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'hover', delay: 120, className: 'docs-hover-tooltip',
  enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
  getContent: (ctx) => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
    const title = document.createElement('strong');
    title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
    const detail = document.createElement('div');
    detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
      ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
      : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
    card.append(title, detail);
    return card;
  },
};
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region tooltip
  const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
    type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'hover', delay: 120, className: 'docs-hover-tooltip',
    enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
    getContent: (ctx) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
      const title = document.createElement('strong');
      title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
      const detail = document.createElement('div');
      detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
        ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
        : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
      card.append(title, detail);
      return card;
    },
  };
  // #endregion tooltip
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'API', x: 0, y: 0, data: { label: '<API Gateway>', requests: 1280 } },
        { id: 'DB', x: 180, y: 0, data: { label: 'Database', requests: 960 } },
        { id: 'Cache', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'request', source: 'API', target: 'DB', data: { label: 'Request' } },
        { id: 'warm', source: 'DB', target: 'Cache', data: { label: 'Warm cache' } },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 32, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 } },
    edge: { style: { hitAreaWidth: 12 } },
    behaviors: [tooltip],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[运行示例与完整代码](/docs/examples/tooltip) · [参数与默认值](/docs/api/options#tooltipoptions) · [查看点击触发与样式配置](/docs/guides/behaviors#tooltip)


# 缩放画布 (/docs/guides/behavior-zoom-canvas)





滚动鼠标滚轮，以画布中心为基准缩放。

## 配置方式 [#配置方式]

滚轮速度通过 `sensitivity` 设置，缩放范围通过 `minZoom` 和 `maxZoom` 设置。

## 示例 [#示例]



```ts
const behaviors = [
  { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 1.4, minZoom: 0.4, maxZoom: 2 },
  { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
] satisfies [BuiltInBehaviorConfig, BuiltInBehaviorConfig];
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
/**
 * Demo: constrain wheel zoom with sensitivity, minZoom, and maxZoom.
 */
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  // #region navigation
  const behaviors = [
    { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 1.4, minZoom: 0.4, maxZoom: 2 },
    { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
  ] satisfies [BuiltInBehaviorConfig, BuiltInBehaviorConfig];
  // #endregion navigation
  const [{ minZoom, maxZoom }] = behaviors;
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 180, y: 180 },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 120 },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 250 },
        { id: 'd', x: 500, y: 180 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'a', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 28, fill: '#5B8FF9' } },
    behaviors,
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const report = () => {
    ui.setStatus(`Zoom ${graph.getZoom().toFixed(2)}× · ${minZoom}–${maxZoom}×`);
  };
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  let reportFrame: number | undefined;
  const onWheel = () => {
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    reportFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { reportFrame = undefined; report(); });
  };
  host.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: true });

  const fitView = graph.fitView.bind(graph);
  graph.fitView = (options) => { fitView(options); report(); };
  const zoomTo = graph.zoomTo.bind(graph);
  graph.zoomTo = (zoom, options) => { zoomTo(zoom, options); report(); };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    host.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    ui.addAction(`${minZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(minZoom));
    ui.addAction('1×', () => graph.zoomTo(1));
    ui.addAction(`${maxZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(maxZoom));
    report();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



[参数与默认值](/docs/api/options#导航与拖拽)


# 交互通用配置项 (/docs/guides/behaviors)





交互列表写在 `new Graph()` 的 `behaviors` 里。各项用途见[交互总览](/docs/guides/behavior-overview)。

## BehaviorOption [#内置-behaviors]

默认参数可直接用交互名称，例如 `'drag-canvas'`。需要调整参数时，写成对象，交互名称放在 `type`，参数放在同一层。

查看 [11 个内置行为的逐项效果](/docs/api/options#内置行为索引)。

## 配置平移、框选和套索 [#常用组合]

空白处拖动用于平移。按住 Shift 拖动用于框选，按住 Ctrl 或 Meta 拖动用于套索。

```ts
import type { BehaviorName, BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const behaviors = [
  'zoom-canvas',
  { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
  'drag-node',
  { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
  { type: 'brush-select', key: 'shift' },
  { type: 'lasso-select', key: 'ctrl' },
] satisfies Array<BehaviorName | BuiltInBehaviorConfig>;
```

可在[选择交互示例](/docs/examples/selection-behaviors)中试用这三种操作。点击多选的 `ctrl` 和 `meta` 可分别设置，区域选择设为 `ctrl` 时接受两者。完整规则见[选择参考](/docs/api/options#选择)。

## 运行中切换交互 [#switch-behaviors]

选择 Browse 拖动空白处平移。选择 Select 在空白处拖动框选，也可单击节点选中。切回 Browse 或选 Off 后，已选节点和当前视野保留。



```ts
if (mode === 'select') {
  graph.updateOptions({ behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'click-select', 'brush-select'] });
} else if (mode === 'browse') {
  graph.setBehaviors(['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas']);
} else {
  graph.setBehaviors([]);
}
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 },
        { id: 'B', x: 150, y: -65 },
        { id: 'C', x: 150, y: 65 },
      ],
      edges: [{ source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { source: 'A', target: 'C' }],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 28, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2', haloWidth: 10 } },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: 55, maxZoom: 1 },
  });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const switchMode = (mode: string) => {
    // #region switch
    if (mode === 'select') {
      graph.updateOptions({ behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'click-select', 'brush-select'] });
    } else if (mode === 'browse') {
      graph.setBehaviors(['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas']);
    } else {
      graph.setBehaviors([]);
    }
    // #endregion switch
  };
  const showSelection = () => {
    ui.setStatus(`Selected: ${graph.findNodesByState('selected').join(', ') || 'none'}`);
  };
  graph.on('node:selectchange', showSelection);
  graph.on('selection:clear', showSelection);
  graph.on('brush:end', showSelection);

  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    showSelection();
    ui.addChoice('Mode', { Browse: 'browse', Select: 'select', Off: 'off' }, 'browse', switchMode);
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



提交完整列表。`setBehaviors([])` 关闭全部行为，`setBehaviors()` 恢复默认缩放和平移。完整规则见 [`setBehaviors()`](/docs/api/graph#setbehaviors)。

## 设置滚轮缩放 [#缩放手感与范围]

滚轮缩放速度用 `sensitivity` 设置，最小和最大缩放倍数通过 `minZoom` 和 `maxZoom` 限定。完整默认值见[导航参考](/docs/api/options#导航与拖拽)。

```ts
behaviors: ['drag-canvas', { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 0.5, minZoom: 0.5, maxZoom: 3 }],
```

## 邻域高亮 [#邻域高亮]

高亮范围用 `degree` 设置。示例设为 `1`，鼠标移到 B 上时，B 和与它直接相连的节点、边会高亮。高亮颜色通过 `stateStyles.highlight` 设置。



```ts
behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', { type: 'hover-highlight', degree: 1, inactiveState: 'inactive' }],
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 }, { id: 'B', x: 120, y: 0 },
        { id: 'C', x: 240, y: 0 }, { id: 'D', x: 360, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 120, y: 100 }, { id: 'Isolated', x: 360, y: 100 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { source: 'B', target: 'C' },
        { source: 'C', target: 'D' }, { source: 'B', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { highlight: { fill: '#00A876', stroke: '#005C41', strokeWidth: 2 } },
    },
    edge: { style: { hitAreaWidth: 12 }, stateStyles: { highlight: { stroke: '#00A876', lineWidth: 2 } } },
    // #region highlight
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', { type: 'hover-highlight', degree: 1, inactiveState: 'inactive' }],
    // #endregion highlight
    autoFit: { padding: 60, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:20;background:white;color:#334155;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font:12px system-ui;';
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  const updateStatus = () => {
    status.textContent = `highlight: ${graph.findNodesByState('highlight').join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { status.remove(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    graph.on('node:pointerover', updateStatus);
    graph.on('node:pointerleave', updateStatus);
    graph.on('edge:pointerover', updateStatus);
    graph.on('edge:pointerleave', updateStatus);
    updateStatus();
    container.append(status);
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



## Tooltip [#tooltip]

在 `behaviors` 中启用 `tooltip`，为节点和边显示信息。根据场景选择悬停预览或点击查看详情。

### 自定义内容 [#自定义内容]

悬停延迟通过 `delay` 设置，显示范围通过 `enable` 控制。示例悬停 120 毫秒后显示 API、DB 或边的信息，Cache 不显示提示框。



```ts
const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
  type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'hover', delay: 120, className: 'docs-hover-tooltip',
  enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
  getContent: (ctx) => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
    const title = document.createElement('strong');
    title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
    const detail = document.createElement('div');
    detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
      ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
      : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
    card.append(title, detail);
    return card;
  },
};
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region tooltip
  const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
    type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'hover', delay: 120, className: 'docs-hover-tooltip',
    enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
    getContent: (ctx) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
      const title = document.createElement('strong');
      title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
      const detail = document.createElement('div');
      detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
        ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
        : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
      card.append(title, detail);
      return card;
    },
  };
  // #endregion tooltip
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'API', x: 0, y: 0, data: { label: '<API Gateway>', requests: 1280 } },
        { id: 'DB', x: 180, y: 0, data: { label: 'Database', requests: 960 } },
        { id: 'Cache', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'request', source: 'API', target: 'DB', data: { label: 'Request' } },
        { id: 'warm', source: 'DB', target: 'Cache', data: { label: 'Warm cache' } },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 32, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 } },
    edge: { style: { hitAreaWidth: 12 } },
    behaviors: [tooltip],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



### 点击显示 [#点击显示]

触发方式设为 `trigger: 'click'` 后，点击元素显示提示框。再次点击同一个元素或点击空白处即可关闭。



```ts
const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
  type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'click', className: 'docs-click-tooltip',
  enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
  getContent: (ctx) => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
    const title = document.createElement('strong');
    title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
    const detail = document.createElement('div');
    detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
      ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
      : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
    card.append(title, detail);
    return card;
  },
};
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region tooltip
  const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
    type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'click', className: 'docs-click-tooltip',
    enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
    getContent: (ctx) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
      const title = document.createElement('strong');
      title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
      const detail = document.createElement('div');
      detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
        ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
        : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
      card.append(title, detail);
      return card;
    },
  };
  // #endregion tooltip
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'API', x: 0, y: 0, data: { label: '<API Gateway>', requests: 1280 } },
        { id: 'DB', x: 180, y: 0, data: { label: 'Database', requests: 960 } },
        { id: 'Cache', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'request', source: 'API', target: 'DB', data: { label: 'Request' } },
        { id: 'warm', source: 'DB', target: 'Cache', data: { label: 'Warm cache' } },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 32, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 } },
    edge: { style: { hitAreaWidth: 12 } },
    behaviors: [tooltip],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



### 配置项 [#配置项]

完整默认值、函数签名、container 和 TooltipContext 字段统一查 [TooltipOptions](/docs/api/options#tooltipoptions) 与 [TooltipContext](/docs/api/options#tooltipcontext)。ctx.event 是原始鼠标事件；它与普通 Graph 事件的 nativeEvent 命名不同。

默认内容取节点的 `data.label` 或 ID，边取 `data.label` 或两端名称。内容通过 `getContent` 自定义。业务值可通过元素的 `textContent` 填入，返回 HTML 字符串时需要转义其中的动态内容。

### 样式 [#样式]

库只负责定位与显隐，不附带视觉皮肤。两个示例直接在返回元素上设置样式；也可给浮层 className 配置样式，例如默认类名：

```css
.g6lite-tooltip {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #163b65;
  color: white;
  font-size: 12px;
}
```

默认挂载 document.body，按视口定位并在边缘翻转。自定义 container 同时改变挂载与碰撞边界，需检查定位祖先、滚动和裁剪；不要假定祖先的 transform 不影响 fixed 定位。

### Tooltip 常见问题 [#tooltip-常见问题]

#### 为什么卡片没有背景，或者点击不了？ [#为什么卡片没有背景或者点击不了]

库没有内置视觉皮肤，需要业务 CSS。浮层默认 pointer-events: none；需要按钮、表单或可交互卡片时，用应用自己的浮层承接。

#### 为什么 Combo 上没有 Tooltip？ [#为什么-combo-上没有-tooltip]

内置 tooltip 只处理 node/edge。Combo 说明可用公开事件结合业务浮层实现，不使用内部拾取接口。

#### 更新数据后，已打开的内容会立即更新吗？ [#更新数据后已打开的内容会立即更新吗]

不会因 setData 自动重建 Tooltip；在后续指针事件中重新读取内容。用 setBehaviors 替换列表可切换 Tooltip 配置，旧 Tooltip 的监听、计时器和浮层会被清理。

## 监听交互事件 [#事件分发模型]

节点点击通过 `node:click` 监听。需要让点击同时切换选中状态时，再启用 `click-select`。

```ts
const onNodeClick = ({ nodeId }: { nodeId: string }) => console.log(nodeId);
graph.on('node:click', onNodeClick);
// 组件卸载时：
graph.off('node:click', onNodeClick);
```

选中联动同时关注 node:selectchange、edge:selectchange、brush:end、lasso:end；需要最终集合时主动查询状态，不能假定所有选择来源都逐个发出 node:selectchange。接入与清理代码见[事件指南](/docs/guides/events#选择与拖拽事件)，完整入参查[事件参考](/docs/api/graph/events#选择事件)。

**连线编辑与底层分发**

drag-edge 发出重连建议，不自动修改 source/target，也没有跟随鼠标的临时连线。业务接收 edge:dragend，验证 reconnected 后更新自己的边数据，再通过 setData 等公开入口写回。若配置了 layout，setData 仍会重新计算布局；fitView: false 只保留相机。

命中优先级依次是节点、边、分组和画布。

## 常见问题 [#常见问题]

### 加上 tooltip 后为什么不能缩放了？ [#加上-tooltip-后为什么不能缩放了]

显式 behaviors 替换默认列表，把 zoom-canvas 和 drag-canvas 一并写入。

### 框选时为什么画布也在动？ [#框选时为什么画布也在动]

将框选绑定 Shift，保留 drag-canvas 的 ignoreModifierKeys: true；不要让框选和套索使用相同手势。

### 可以用 updateOptions 动态切换 Behavior 吗？ [#可以用-updateoptions-动态切换-behavior-吗]

可以。仅切换交互时用 `setBehaviors()`。同时更新样式时，可在 `updateOptions()` 里传入 `behaviors`。

## 相关 [#相关]

* [自定义交互](/docs/guides/custom-behavior) · [独立 Tooltip 示例](/docs/examples/tooltip)。
* [事件指南](/docs/guides/events) · [选择行为示例](/docs/examples/selection-behaviors)。
* [邻居高亮示例](/docs/examples/neighbor-highlight)：悬停后观察一度邻接范围。

**相关可运行示例**

* [一度邻居高亮](/docs/examples/neighbor-highlight)
* [拖拽节点与 Combo](/docs/examples/drag-node)
* [拖拽边端点](/docs/examples/drag-edge)


# 分组通用配置项 (/docs/guides/combo)





分组的外观通过 `combo.style` 设置。成员归属写在数据里，完整示例见[分组总览](/docs/elements/combo)。

<span id="声明-combo" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="combodata" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

## ComboConfig [#comboconfig]

`ComboConfig` 对应 `new Graph()` 的 `combo` 选项。`style` 设置所有分组的默认样式，单个分组可以在 `data.combos[].style` 中覆盖同名字段。

<span id="基础外观与局部覆盖" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="combo-style" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="样式" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

## 分组样式 [#分组样式]

### 边框和留白 [#基础样式字段]

边框颜色和宽度分别用 `stroke` 和 `strokeWidth` 设置，底色用 `fill` 设置。边框与成员之间的留白通过 `padding` 调整。传入数组时，四周都取数组中的最大值。

### 标签样式 [#留白包围框与标签]

标签名用 `label` 设置，位置通过 `labelPlacement` 配置。`top` 和 `bottom` 分别放在边框上方和下方，`inside` 放在框内左上角，`center` 放在框内正中。`labelFontSize` 设置字号，`labelColor` 设置文字颜色。

### 按数据设置样式 [#字段回调与覆盖顺序]

样式函数接收当前分组。比如用 `combo.data` 读取业务名称，或用 `combo.childNodeIds.size` 生成直接成员数。单组样式优先于全局样式，状态样式可以进一步覆盖当前外观。

<span id="options-combo-代码与对应效果" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

下图左侧使用默认样式，中间的分组单独设置了橙色边框，右侧用样式函数显示成员数。展开「完整代码」可查看单组配置。



```ts
combo: { style: {
  fill: 'rgba(23,131,255,0.08)', stroke: '#1783FF', strokeWidth: 2,
  opacity: 1, borderRadius: 12, padding: 40,
  label: (combo) => String(combo.data?.name ?? combo.id),
  labelFontSize: 12, labelColor: '#1e3a8a', labelPlacement: 'top',
} },
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const groups = [{ id: 'global', x: 100 }, { id: 'local', x: 320 }, { id: 'callback', x: 540 }];
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: groups.flatMap(({ id, x }) => [
        { id: id + '-a', x, y: 100, comboId: id },
        { id: id + '-b', x, y: 160, comboId: id },
      ]),
      edges: [],
      combos: [
        { id: 'global', data: { name: 'Global' } },
        { id: 'local', data: { name: 'Local' }, style: {
          fill: 'rgba(246,144,61,0.15)', stroke: '#f6903d', strokeWidth: 3,
          opacity: 0.75, borderRadius: 0, padding: 32,
          labelFontSize: 14, labelColor: '#7c2d12', labelPlacement: 'inside',
        } },
        { id: 'callback', style: {
          fill: (combo) => combo.childNodeIds.size >= 2 ? 'rgba(135,59,244,0.12)' : 'transparent',
          stroke: '#873bf4', borderRadius: 20, padding: [8, 40, 12, 24],
          label: (combo) => 'Members: ' + combo.childNodeIds.size, labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        } },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 22 } },
    // #region combo-options
    combo: { style: {
      fill: 'rgba(23,131,255,0.08)', stroke: '#1783FF', strokeWidth: 2,
      opacity: 1, borderRadius: 12, padding: 40,
      label: (combo) => String(combo.data?.name ?? combo.id),
      labelFontSize: 12, labelColor: '#1e3a8a', labelPlacement: 'top',
    } },
    // #endregion combo-options
    behaviors: [],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



全部字段、单位和默认值见[分组样式参考](/docs/api/options#config-combo-style)。

### 状态样式 [#options-combo-状态样式]

选中后的边框、底色等样式写在 `combo.style.stateStyles.selected`。单个分组也可以在自己的 `style.stateStyles` 中设置。点击示例中的分组，切换选中样式。



```ts
combo: { style: {
  padding: 28, label: (combo) => combo.id,
  stateStyles: {
    selected: { fill: 'rgba(135,59,244,0.12)', stroke: '#873bf4', strokeWidth: 3 },
    inactive: { opacity: 0.3 },
  },
} },
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const groups = [
    { id: 'Base', x: 100 }, { id: 'Selected', x: 270 },
    { id: 'Local', x: 440 }, { id: 'Inactive', x: 610 },
  ];
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: groups.flatMap(({ id, x }) => [
        { id: id + '-a', x, y: 100, comboId: id },
        { id: id + '-b', x, y: 160, comboId: id },
      ]),
      edges: [],
      combos: [
        { id: 'Base' },
        { id: 'Selected', states: ['selected'] },
        { id: 'Local', states: ['selected'], style: {
          stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#f6903d', labelColor: '#9a3412' } },
        } },
        { id: 'Inactive', states: ['selected', 'inactive'] },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 22 } },
    // #region state-styles
    combo: { style: {
      padding: 28, label: (combo) => combo.id,
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { fill: 'rgba(135,59,244,0.12)', stroke: '#873bf4', strokeWidth: 3 },
        inactive: { opacity: 0.3 },
      },
    } },
    // #endregion state-styles
    behaviors: [],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  graph.on('combo:click', ({ comboId }) => {
    const selected = graph.getComboData(comboId)?.states.has('selected') ?? false;
    graph.setItemState(comboId, 'selected', !selected);
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



多个状态按 `active → highlight → selected → disabled → inactive` 的顺序应用。同一字段取后应用的值。可覆盖的字段见[状态样式参考](/docs/api/options#config-combo-state-style)。

## 折叠与展开 [#折叠与展开]

初始折叠通过分组数据里的 `collapsed: true` 设置。渲染后，`collapseCombo()` 收起分组，`expandCombo()` 展开分组，`toggleCombo()` 在两者之间切换。下面的示例用点击切换。

```ts
graph.on('combo:click', ({ comboId }) => graph.toggleCombo(comboId));
```

### 折叠后的形状和文字 [#折叠形态]

折叠后的形状用 `collapsedType` 设置，尺寸用 `collapsedSize` 设置。折叠文字优先显示 `label`。省略 `label` 时，默认显示后代节点数，也可以用 `count` 指定文字。

| 形状                                         | 配置                                                              |
| ------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| <span id="combo-collapsed-circle" />圆形（默认） | `collapsedType: 'circle'`，`collapsedSize: 64` 表示直径 64           |
| <span id="combo-collapsed-rect" />矩形       | `collapsedType: 'rect'`，`collapsedSize: [120, 48]` 表示宽 120、高 48 |

下图从左到右分别显示节点数、自定义计数文字和分组名称。点击任一分组可查看展开后的边框。



```ts
combos: [
  { id: 'circle', collapsed: true },
  { id: 'rect', collapsed: true, style: {
    collapsedType: 'rect', collapsedSize: [120, 48],
    count: (combo) => 'Items: ' + combo.childNodeIds.size,
  } },
  { id: 'label', collapsed: true, style: {
    collapsedType: 'rect', collapsedSize: [120, 48], label: 'Archive',
  } },
],
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const groups = [{ id: 'circle', x: 100 }, { id: 'rect', x: 300 }, { id: 'label', x: 500 }];
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: groups.flatMap(({ id, x }) => [
        { id: id + '-a', x: x - 24, y: 100, comboId: id },
        { id: id + '-b', x: x + 24, y: 160, comboId: id },
      ]),
      edges: [],
      // #region collapsed-shapes
      combos: [
        { id: 'circle', collapsed: true },
        { id: 'rect', collapsed: true, style: {
          collapsedType: 'rect', collapsedSize: [120, 48],
          count: (combo) => 'Items: ' + combo.childNodeIds.size,
        } },
        { id: 'label', collapsed: true, style: {
          collapsedType: 'rect', collapsedSize: [120, 48], label: 'Archive',
        } },
      ],
      // #endregion collapsed-shapes
    },
    node: { style: { size: 22 } },
    combo: { style: {
      stroke: '#1783ff', strokeWidth: 2, padding: 24,
      collapsedType: 'circle', collapsedSize: 64, count: true,
    } },
    behaviors: [],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  graph.on('combo:click', ({ comboId }) => graph.toggleCombo(comboId));
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



### 嵌套分组的可见性 [#嵌套分组的可见性]

折叠父组会隐藏后代节点和关联边，子分组的边框仍可见。展开时，节点或边原有的隐藏状态会保留。

## 动态调整归属 [#动态调整归属]

节点要换组时，调用 `addToCombo(nodeId, comboId)`。分组边框会重新计算。示例点击 Mobile 后，还调用 `updateNodePosition()` 把节点移到新组旁边。



```ts
graph.on('node:click', ({ nodeId }) => {
  if (nodeId !== 'mobile') return;
  const target = graph.getNodeCombo(nodeId) === 'client' ? 'service' : 'client';
  graph.addToCombo(nodeId, target);
  // Membership changes do not move nodes; position this example explicitly.
  graph.updateNodePosition(nodeId, target === 'client' ? 200 : 380, 180);
});
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'web', x: 120, y: 100, comboId: 'client' },
        { id: 'mobile', x: 200, y: 180, comboId: 'client' },
        { id: 'api', x: 460, y: 100, comboId: 'service' },
      ],
      edges: [{ id: 'request', source: 'mobile', target: 'api' }],
      combos: [
        { id: 'client', style: { label: 'Client' } },
        { id: 'service', style: { label: 'Service', stroke: '#f6903d' } },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: {
      size: 24, label: (node) => node.id,
      fill: (node) => node.id === 'mobile' ? '#f6903d' : '#1783ff',
    } },
    combo: { style: { padding: 40, strokeWidth: 2 } },
    behaviors: ['drag-node', 'drag-canvas', 'zoom-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  // #region change-membership
  graph.on('node:click', ({ nodeId }) => {
    if (nodeId !== 'mobile') return;
    const target = graph.getNodeCombo(nodeId) === 'client' ? 'service' : 'client';
    graph.addToCombo(nodeId, target);
    // Membership changes do not move nodes; position this example explicitly.
    graph.updateNodePosition(nodeId, target === 'client' ? 200 : 380, 180);
  });
  // #endregion change-membership
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



`removeFromCombo()` 解除节点的分组归属。`createCombo()` 可以用已有节点创建分组，`removeCombo()` 移除分组并保留成员节点。完整签名见[分组方法](/docs/api/graph#graph-combo)。

## 整体拖拽 [#整体拖拽]

分组整体拖动通过 `drag-node` 启用。拖动上方示例的分组空白处，组内节点会一起移动。节点换组时仍通过 `addToCombo()` 或 `removeFromCombo()` 调整归属。

```ts
behaviors: ['drag-node', 'drag-canvas'],
```

## 动态修改分组样式 [#运行时修改边界]

单个分组的样式可以在数据快照中修改，再用 `setData()` 应用。图会重新运行已配置的布局，`fitView: false` 保留当前视图。全局分组样式在创建图时设置。

```ts
const data = graph.getData();
const combo = data.combos?.find(({ id }) => id === 'local');
if (combo) {
  combo.style = { ...combo.style, stroke: '#16a085' };
  await graph.setData(data, { fitView: false });
}
```

## 查询 [#查询]

`getNodeCombo()` 查询节点属于哪个分组。`getComboChildren()` 返回直接成员。`getComboData()` 返回只读的分组模型。

```ts
const groupId = graph.getNodeCombo('mobile');
const members = graph.getComboChildren('client');
const collapsed = graph.getComboData('client')?.collapsed;
```

### ComboModel 字段 [#只读查询模型]

| 字段                             | 含义                  |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------- |
| `id`、`parentId`                | 分组 ID 和上级分组 ID      |
| `childNodeIds`、`childComboIds` | 直接成员节点和直接子分组的 ID 集合 |
| `collapsed`、`states`           | 折叠状态和当前元素状态         |
| `x`、`y`、`width`、`height`       | 展开边框的中心坐标和尺寸        |
| `style`、`data`                 | 单组样式和业务数据           |

### 边框更新与数据导出 [#包围框更新与数据导出]

边框尺寸在渲染时重算。`getData()` 可导出当前成员归属和折叠状态。保存为 JSON 时，样式函数需要单独保存或重建。

## 常见问题 [#常见问题]

### 为什么分组没有边框或标题？ [#为什么分组没有边框或标题]

成员节点要有有效的 `comboId` 和位置。空组不会绘制边框，标题通过 `label` 设置。

### 为什么隐藏或折叠父组后仍有内容？ [#为什么隐藏或折叠父组后仍有内容]

`hidden` 隐藏分组自身。折叠后的成员和子分组可见性见[嵌套分组的可见性](#嵌套分组的可见性)。

### 为什么展开后仍有节点看不到？ [#为什么展开后仍有节点看不到]

检查节点和边的 `hidden` 状态，以及上级分组是否仍处于折叠状态。

### 为什么拖动没有改变归属或选中状态？ [#为什么拖动没有改变归属或选中状态]

拖动负责移动位置。归属通过[分组方法](/docs/api/graph#graph-combo)设置，选中通过[状态方法](/docs/api/graph#graph-states)设置。

### 为什么 updateOptions 不能改 Combo 外观？ [#为什么-updateoptions-不能改-combo-外观]

局部样式通过数据更新。见[动态修改分组样式](#运行时修改边界)。

<span id="options-combo-相关入口" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

## 相关 [#相关]

* [分组配置参考](/docs/api/options#options-combo)
* [完整分组示例](/docs/examples/combo)


# 自定义交互 (/docs/guides/custom-behavior)





自定义交互可以把业务操作封装起来。例如，点击节点时只激活当前节点，点击空白时清除激活状态。示例中的 A 原有的选中状态会保留。

## 公共类型范式 [#公共类型范式]

为名称声明字面量 type，为业务选项声明独立类型；在激活处用 satisfies 检查。完整泛型、事件映射和生命周期签名统一见 [Behavior 契约](/docs/api/options#自定义交互契约)。

## 推荐文件与导出 [#推荐文件与导出]

可复用模块导出行为名称、options 类型和显式注册函数；应用在创建 Graph 前注册。使用包或业务前缀，避免覆盖全局注册表中的其他名称。不要依赖导入副作用决定注册顺序。

## 完整实现 [#完整实现]

事件处理函数写在 `getEvents()` 的返回值里。示例监听节点和画布的点击，通过 `context.state` 更新激活状态。



```ts
import {
  Graph, register,
  type BehaviorExtension, type BehaviorOptions, type ElementState, type ExtensionContext,
} from '@antv/g6-lite';

export const BUSINESS_SELECT = 'docs-business-select' as const;
export interface BusinessSelectOptions extends BehaviorOptions<typeof BUSINESS_SELECT> {
  state?: ElementState;
}

export function createBusinessSelect(): BehaviorExtension<BusinessSelectOptions> {
  let context: ExtensionContext | undefined;
  let state: ElementState = 'active';
  const select = (nodeId?: string) => {
    if (!context || context.isDestroyed()) return;
    const next: Record<string, ElementState[]> = {};
    for (const id of context.data.getNodeIds()) {
      const retained = context.state.get(id).filter((value) => value !== state);
      next[id] = id === nodeId ? [...retained, state] : retained;
    }
    context.state.setAll(next);
  };
  return {
    init(nextContext, options) { context = nextContext; state = options.state ?? 'active'; },
    getEvents() {
      return {
        'node:click': ({ nodeId, nativeEvent }) => {
          if (nativeEvent.button === 0) select(nodeId);
        },
        'canvas:click': () => select(),
      };
    },
    destroy() { context = undefined; },
  };
}

// #region registration
export function registerBusinessSelect() {
  register('behavior', BUSINESS_SELECT, () => createBusinessSelect());
}
// #endregion registration

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  registerBusinessSelect();
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0, states: ['selected'] },
        { id: 'B', x: 160, y: 0 }, { id: 'C', x: 320, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [{ source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { source: 'B', target: 'C' }],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 32, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { active: { fill: '#F08F56', stroke: '#914C1D', strokeWidth: 2 } },
    },
    behaviors: [{ type: BUSINESS_SELECT, state: 'active' } satisfies BusinessSelectOptions],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:20;background:white;color:#334155;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font:12px system-ui;';
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  const updateStatus = () => {
    status.textContent = `active: ${graph.findNodesByState('active').join(', ') || 'none'} | selected: ${graph.findNodesByState('selected').join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { status.remove(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    graph.on('node:click', updateStatus);
    graph.on('canvas:click', updateStatus);
    updateStatus();
    container.append(status);
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



## 注册并激活 [#注册并激活]

示例 run 中先调用 registerBusinessSelect，再创建 Graph，配置对象用 satisfies BusinessSelectOptions。字符串名称也可激活，init 收到的 options 会包含 type，缺省 state 使用 active。

多个 Graph 可以复用同一注册工厂；每个已挂载 Behavior 持有自己的 context 和 state。后注册同名定义不会替换已经挂载的实例，更换配置的边界见[挂载与更新](/docs/api/options#挂载与更新)。

## 事件类型 [#事件类型]

getEvents 的事件名从 GraphEventMap 推导参数元组。例如 node:click 的 nodeId、nativeEvent 都有类型；destroy 是零参数事件。需要扩展消费端事件类型时，可交叉组合：

```ts
import type { BehaviorExtension, BehaviorOptions, GraphEventMap } from '@antv/g6-lite';

interface BusinessEventMap {
  'business:reset': [payload: { source: 'toolbar' | 'shortcut' }];
}
type BusinessBehavior = BehaviorExtension<
  BehaviorOptions<'business-select'>,
  GraphEventMap & BusinessEventMap
>;
```

应用可用 `graph.emit('business:reset', { source: 'toolbar' })` 触发这个处理函数。需要在调用处校验载荷时，用模块扩充把业务事件加入 `GraphEventMap`。见[自定义事件示例](/docs/guides/events/custom)。

## 生命周期与清理 [#生命周期与清理]

引擎执行 create → init → getEvents，卸载时解绑事件并调用 destroy。[`setBehaviors()`](/docs/api/graph#setbehaviors) 和 `updateOptions({ behaviors })` 会销毁旧行为，再按新列表创建。即使名称相同，新配置也交给新实例的 init。Readonly options 是类型约束，运行时不保证冻结。

getEvents 返回的监听由引擎清理。自己创建的 window 监听、timer、Observer 和 DOM 要在 destroy 中清理。切换行为时 Graph 仍存活，异步任务需用行为自己的 AbortController 或卸载标记停止，并处理 Promise 拒绝。

## 在项目中使用 [#边界与覆盖规则]

自定义交互通过 `context.state` 修改元素状态，通过 `context.data.updateNode()` 或 `updateEdge()` 修改业务数据。注册时给交互取一个独立的名称，例如 `docs-business-select`，避免覆盖内置交互。 [扩展上下文 API](/docs/api/extensions#extensioncontext) · [注册规则](/docs/api/extensions#注册规则)

在上方示例中点击 B，再点击空白处。B 的 `active` 状态会先添加再清除，A 的 `selected` 状态始终保留。完整代码中的 `select()` 展示了如何只修改当前交互管理的状态。 [试用示例](#完整实现)

继续阅读：[交互总览](/docs/guides/behavior-overview) · [交互通用配置项](/docs/guides/behaviors) · [扩展体系](/docs/guides/extensions)。

**相关可运行示例**

* [注册自定义交互](/docs/examples/custom-behavior)


# 自定义节点装饰 (/docs/guides/custom-decoration)





已有计数、图标或文本徽章先用 builtin-badge；需要自己的内容时注册 DecorationRenderer。它只画内容，引擎负责相对节点定位、堆叠和溢出。

## 测量、绘制与注册 [#测量绘制与注册]

measure 返回完整的有限正数宽高；本例用 DPR 换算固定 CSS 字号并缓存到 layout.data。draw 的原点已在装饰中心，显式设置字体、颜色和对齐。



```ts
const pill: DecorationRenderer = {
  measure({ ctx, data, dpr }) {
    const text = String(data ?? '');
    ctx.font = 12 * dpr + 'px sans-serif';
    return { width: ctx.measureText(text).width + 12 * dpr, height: 22 * dpr, data: { text, unit: dpr } };
  },
  draw({ ctx, layout }) {
    const value = layout.data as { text: string; unit: number } | undefined;
    if (!value) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e6f4ff';
    ctx.fillRect(-layout.width / 2, -layout.height / 2, layout.width, layout.height);
    ctx.font = 12 * value.unit + 'px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0958d9';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(value.text, 0, 0);
  },
};
register('decoration', 'docs-pill', pill);
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, register, type DecorationRenderer } from '@antv/g6-lite';

// #region renderer
const pill: DecorationRenderer = {
  measure({ ctx, data, dpr }) {
    const text = String(data ?? '');
    ctx.font = 12 * dpr + 'px sans-serif';
    return { width: ctx.measureText(text).width + 12 * dpr, height: 22 * dpr, data: { text, unit: dpr } };
  },
  draw({ ctx, layout }) {
    const value = layout.data as { text: string; unit: number } | undefined;
    if (!value) return;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e6f4ff';
    ctx.fillRect(-layout.width / 2, -layout.height / 2, layout.width, layout.height);
    ctx.font = 12 * value.unit + 'px sans-serif';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0958d9';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText(value.text, 0, 0);
  },
};
register('decoration', 'docs-pill', pill);
// #endregion renderer

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [{ id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 }, { id: 'B', x: 260, y: 0 }],
      edges: [{ source: 'A', target: 'B' }],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 40, label: (node) => node.id, labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' },
      // #region placement
      decorations: [{
        renderer: 'docs-pill', placement: 'right', attachment: 'outside',
        layout: 'stack', sort: 'width-desc', itemGap: 4, maxVisible: 3,
        overflow: 'hover-expand', overflowData: (count: number) => '+' + count,
        items: (node) => node.id === 'A' ? ['CPU 42%', 'API', 'DB', 'Cache', 'Queue'] : ['Ready'],
        hideOnCollision: false,
      }],
      // #endregion placement
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: 96, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try { await graph.render(); return graph; }
  catch (error) { graph.destroy(); throw error; }
}
```



A 有五项，B 只有 Ready；A 默认显示两项及 +3 溢出项。悬停 A 的装饰区域展开全部，移开恢复。展开完整代码查看 items 与 placement 配置。

## 定位与堆叠 [#定位与堆叠]

1. renderer 名称与注册一致；单项传 data，stack 传 items。
2. placement 决定节点一侧，attachment 决定边界或外部附着。
3. layout: 'stack' 开启纵向排列；sort、maxVisible 与 overflow 控制可见项。maxVisible 包含溢出项，本例设为 3，显示两项加 +3。
4. overflowData 也交给同一个 renderer，确保它能处理溢出项输入。

不要在 renderer 中实现自己的节点位置、排序或溢出逻辑。偏移、跨轴比例、锚点和所有默认值查[装饰配置](/docs/api/options#config-node-decoration)。

## 碰撞与更新 [#碰撞与更新]

本例为方便比较显式关闭装饰碰撞隐藏；实际业务按密度选择。hideOnCollision: false 可能重叠，也不占用装饰碰撞网格。minZoom 控制装饰自己的阈值，不等同标签策略。

内容来自 items 回调时，通过公开数据方法更新业务字段；不要修改全局 renderer 的共享状态。装饰节点尺寸已经是屏幕尺寸，不再次缩放；本例内容选择固定 CSS 字号，所以只按 dpr 换算。完整单位查[DecorationRenderer](/docs/api/extensions#decorationrenderer)。

## 常见问题 [#常见问题]

### 为什么装饰消失而没有默认文字？ [#为什么装饰消失而没有默认文字]

未知 renderer、非法测量或异常会跳过装饰，不走 Label 的文字回退；检查诊断、minZoom、hidden 和碰撞。

### 为什么测量后没有 draw？ [#为什么测量后没有-draw]

碰撞、裁剪或溢出筛选可能跳过绘制。measure 应是纯计算，不能把调用次数当业务状态。

### 可以直接使用内置 Badge 吗？ [#可以直接使用内置-badge-吗]

可以，见[节点徽章案例](/docs/examples/decoration-badges)。不要为已有外观重复实现底层内容。

**相关可运行示例**

* [节点徽章](/docs/examples/decoration-badges)


# 自定义边 (/docs/guides/custom-edge)





用 `EdgeExtension` 为一类业务关系封装可复用的边类型。边的路径由 `base` 决定，方向由箭头表示，文字由 `edge.style.label` 提供。只需在一张图里按数据改变线宽或颜色时，可以直接用[样式函数](/docs/guides/edge#样式函数)。

## 注册与启用 [#注册与启用]

选择 `arc` 作为路径基型，用 `getStyle()` 按权重决定颜色和线宽，再用 `register('edge', ...)` 注册类型。



```ts
const weightedEdge: EdgeExtension = {
  base: 'arc',
  style: { curvature: 0.2, endArrow: true, hitAreaWidth: 14 },
  getStyle(_source, _target, edge) {
    const weight = Number(edge.data?.weight ?? 1);
    return { stroke: weight > 2 ? '#cf1322' : '#5366ad', lineWidth: weight + 1 };
  },
  stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#873bf4', lineWidth: 4 } },
};
register('edge', 'docs-weighted-edge', weightedEdge);
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, register, type EdgeExtension } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

// #region descriptor
const weightedEdge: EdgeExtension = {
  base: 'arc',
  style: { curvature: 0.2, endArrow: true, hitAreaWidth: 14 },
  getStyle(_source, _target, edge) {
    const weight = Number(edge.data?.weight ?? 1);
    return { stroke: weight > 2 ? '#cf1322' : '#5366ad', lineWidth: weight + 1 };
  },
  stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#873bf4', lineWidth: 4 } },
};
register('edge', 'docs-weighted-edge', weightedEdge);
// #endregion descriptor

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [{ id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 }, { id: 'B', x: 190, y: 80 }, { id: 'C', x: 380, y: 0 }],
      edges: [
        { id: 'light', source: 'A', target: 'B', data: { weight: 1 } },
        { id: 'heavy', source: 'B', target: 'C', data: { weight: 4 } },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 28, label: (node) => node.id } },
    // #region edge-activation
    edge: { type: 'docs-weighted-edge', style: { label: (_s, _t, edge) => edge.id ?? '' } },
    // #endregion edge-activation
    behaviors: ['click-select', 'zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: 64, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { ui.destroy(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    // #region edge-weight-update
    ui.addAction('Toggle heavy weight', () => {
      const weight = graph.getEdgeData('heavy')?.data?.weight === 4 ? 1 : 4;
      graph.updateEdgeData('heavy', { weight });
    });
    // #endregion edge-weight-update
    return graph;
  }
  catch (error) { graph.destroy(); throw error; }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



在 `new Graph()` 中把 `edge.type` 设为注册名。下例中 `light` 的初始权重为 `1`，`heavy` 为 `4`。



```ts
edge: { type: 'docs-weighted-edge', style: { label: (_s, _t, edge) => edge.id ?? '' } },
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts

// #region descriptor
const weightedEdge: EdgeExtension = {
  base: 'arc',
  style: { curvature: 0.2, endArrow: true, hitAreaWidth: 14 },
  getStyle(_source, _target, edge) {
    const weight = Number(edge.data?.weight ?? 1);
    return { stroke: weight > 2 ? '#cf1322' : '#5366ad', lineWidth: weight + 1 };
  },
  stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#873bf4', lineWidth: 4 } },
};

// #endregion descriptor

  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [{ id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 }, { id: 'B', x: 190, y: 80 }, { id: 'C', x: 380, y: 0 }],
      edges: [
        { id: 'light', source: 'A', target: 'B', data: { weight: 1 } },
        { id: 'heavy', source: 'B', target: 'C', data: { weight: 4 } },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 28, label: (node) => node.id } },
    // #region edge-activation
    edge: { type: 'docs-weighted-edge', style: { label: (_s, _t, edge) => edge.id ?? '' } },
    // #endregion edge-activation
    behaviors: ['click-select', 'zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: 64, maxZoom: 1 },
  });

  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { ui.destroy(); destroy(); };

    await graph.render();
```
