```ts
    ui.addAction('Toggle heavy weight', () => {
      const weight = graph.getEdgeData('heavy')?.data?.weight === 4 ? 1 : 4;
      graph.updateEdgeData('heavy', { weight });
    });
    // #endregion edge-weight-update
    return graph;
  }
  catch (error) { graph.destroy(); throw error; }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



## 覆盖与更新 [#覆盖与更新]

在上方示例点击 **Toggle heavy weight**，`updateEdgeData()` 会更新 `heavy` 的权重，`getStyle()` 随之调整颜色和线宽。点击边可查看紫色选中样式，点击空白处可恢复基础样式。



```ts
ui.addAction('Toggle heavy weight', () => {
  const weight = graph.getEdgeData('heavy')?.data?.weight === 4 ? 1 : 4;
  graph.updateEdgeData('heavy', { weight });
});
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, register, type EdgeExtension } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

// #region descriptor
const weightedEdge: EdgeExtension = {
  base: 'arc',
  style: { curvature: 0.2, endArrow: true, hitAreaWidth: 14 },
  getStyle(_source, _target, edge) {
    const weight = Number(edge.data?.weight ?? 1);
    return { stroke: weight > 2 ? '#cf1322' : '#5366ad', lineWidth: weight + 1 };
  },
  stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#873bf4', lineWidth: 4 } },
};
register('edge', 'docs-weighted-edge', weightedEdge);
// #endregion descriptor

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [{ id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 }, { id: 'B', x: 190, y: 80 }, { id: 'C', x: 380, y: 0 }],
      edges: [
        { id: 'light', source: 'A', target: 'B', data: { weight: 1 } },
        { id: 'heavy', source: 'B', target: 'C', data: { weight: 4 } },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 28, label: (node) => node.id } },
    // #region edge-activation
    edge: { type: 'docs-weighted-edge', style: { label: (_s, _t, edge) => edge.id ?? '' } },
    // #endregion edge-activation
    behaviors: ['click-select', 'zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: 64, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { ui.destroy(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    // #region edge-weight-update
    ui.addAction('Toggle heavy weight', () => {
      const weight = graph.getEdgeData('heavy')?.data?.weight === 4 ? 1 : 4;
      graph.updateEdgeData('heavy', { weight });
    });
    // #endregion edge-weight-update
    return graph;
  }
  catch (error) { graph.destroy(); throw error; }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



样式优先级和扩展字段见 [EdgeExtension](/docs/api/extensions#edgeextension)。

## 常见问题 [#常见问题]

### 能实现任意自定义 draw 或 WebGL shader 吗？ [#能实现任意自定义-draw-或-webgl-shader-吗]

当前 EdgeExtension 只有基型、默认样式、getStyle 与状态样式，没有任意 draw / shader 钩子。完整签名查[EdgeExtension](/docs/api/extensions#edgeextension)。

### 为什么标签没有显示？ [#为什么标签没有显示]

扩展默认边样式不替代标签启用配置。本例在 edge.style 显式提供 label；只把文字放入 data 或扩展描述不保证激活标签遍历。

### 为什么边难以选中？ [#为什么边难以选中]

配置 `hitAreaWidth` 并启用交互。本例热区为 14，线宽保持原样。完整规则见[交互热区](/docs/guides/edge#交互热区)。

注册、缓存和错误边界查[公共契约](/docs/api/graph#extension-registration)。


# 自定义 Label Renderer (/docs/guides/custom-label-renderer)





需要多行、富内容或自定义截断时使用 LabelRenderer；普通文字先用[label 配置](/docs/guides/label)。下面同一个 renderer 绘制节点名称与城市，以及边的协议与类型。

## 注册与使用 [#注册与使用]

1. measure 设置字体，计算包含背景内边距的完整宽高，把分行结果放入 layout.data。
2. draw 显式设置字体和颜色，在原点附近绘制，不依赖 measure 留下的 Canvas 状态。
3. 注册 label 名称，分别配置 node.labelRenderer / edge.labelRenderer，并显式提供非空 label。



```ts
const multilineRenderer: LabelRenderer<MultilineLayoutData> = {
  measure({ ctx, text, style }) {
    ctx.font = `${style.labelFontWeight} ${style.labelFontSize}px ${style.labelFontFamily}`;
    const lines = text.split('\n');
    const lineHeight = style.labelFontSize * 1.2;
    const contentWidth = Math.max(...lines.map((line) => ctx.measureText(line).width));
    const padding = style.labelBackgroundPadding;
    return {
      width: contentWidth + padding * 2,
      height: lines.length * lineHeight + padding * 2,
      data: { lines, lineHeight, contentWidth },
    };
  },
  draw({ ctx, style, layout }) {
    const data = layout.data;
    if (!data) return;
    if (style.labelBackground) {
      ctx.fillStyle = style.labelBackground;
      ctx.fillRect(-layout.width / 2, -layout.height / 2, layout.width, layout.height);
    }
    ctx.font = `${style.labelFontWeight} ${style.labelFontSize}px ${style.labelFontFamily}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = style.labelColor;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    data.lines.forEach((line, index) => {
      const y = (index - (data.lines.length - 1) / 2) * data.lineHeight;
      ctx.fillText(line, 0, y);
    });
  },
};

register('label', 'demo-multiline', multilineRenderer);
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
/**
 * Demo: unified custom node/edge LabelRenderer lifecycle.
 * The multiline behavior lives entirely in this demo, not in G6Lite core.
 */
import { Graph, register, type LabelRenderer } from '@antv/g6-lite';

interface MultilineLayoutData {
  lines: string[];
  lineHeight: number;
  contentWidth: number;
}

// #region renderer
const multilineRenderer: LabelRenderer<MultilineLayoutData> = {
  measure({ ctx, text, style }) {
    ctx.font = `${style.labelFontWeight} ${style.labelFontSize}px ${style.labelFontFamily}`;
    const lines = text.split('\n');
    const lineHeight = style.labelFontSize * 1.2;
    const contentWidth = Math.max(...lines.map((line) => ctx.measureText(line).width));
    const padding = style.labelBackgroundPadding;
    return {
      width: contentWidth + padding * 2,
      height: lines.length * lineHeight + padding * 2,
      data: { lines, lineHeight, contentWidth },
    };
  },
  draw({ ctx, style, layout }) {
    const data = layout.data;
    if (!data) return;
    if (style.labelBackground) {
      ctx.fillStyle = style.labelBackground;
      ctx.fillRect(-layout.width / 2, -layout.height / 2, layout.width, layout.height);
    }
    ctx.font = `${style.labelFontWeight} ${style.labelFontSize}px ${style.labelFontFamily}`;
    ctx.fillStyle = style.labelColor;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    data.lines.forEach((line, index) => {
      const y = (index - (data.lines.length - 1) / 2) * data.lineHeight;
      ctx.fillText(line, 0, y);
    });
  },
};

register('label', 'demo-multiline', multilineRenderer);
// #endregion renderer

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    // Labels are two lines and hang below nodes (labelPlacement: 'bottom');
    // the bottom padding reserves their height so they stay inside the view.
    autoFit: { padding: [24, 48, 64, 48] },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'source', data: { label: 'Source Service\nShanghai' } },
        { id: 'gateway', data: { label: 'API Gateway\nPrimary' } },
        { id: 'target', data: { label: 'Target Store\nHangzhou' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'source', target: 'gateway', data: { label: 'HTTPS\nrequest' } },
        { source: 'gateway', target: 'target', data: { label: 'RPC\nresponse' } },
      ],
    },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', nodeSize: 32, ranksep: 180 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node'],
    // #region node-label
    node: {
      labelRenderer: 'demo-multiline',
      style: {
        size: 32,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)',
        labelBackgroundPadding: 4,
      },
    },
    // #endregion node-label
    // #region edge-label
    edge: {
      type: 'arc',
      labelRenderer: 'demo-multiline',
      style: {
        label: (_source, _target, edge) => String(edge.data?.label ?? ''),
        labelFontSize: 10,
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)',
        labelBackgroundPadding: 3,
        labelAutoRotate: true,
      },
    },
    // #endregion edge-label
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```



拖动节点或缩放，观察两行内容与背景。展开完整代码可看到两种激活配置。业务只负责内容，位置、旋转、缩放策略和碰撞由引擎处理。

## 协议约定 [#协议约定]

传入 text、已解析的 style、ctx、dpr、zoom。type='node' 时可读 node；type='edge' 时可读 edge / source / target。先按 type 分支再访问专用字段，完整联合类型查[LabelRenderer](/docs/api/extensions#labelrenderer)。

style 的字号、偏移和内边距已经是 backing-store 像素，不再乘 DPR 或 zoom。draw 原点位于标签中心，边旋转已应用，不要重复平移到节点或再次旋转。

measure 返回有限正数宽高，覆盖全部自绘内容；layout.data 仅缓存本次计算。碰撞或裁剪可能导致测量后不绘制，不在 measure 中修改业务状态。自绘背景和截断由 renderer 实现，labelMaxWidth 不会自动裁切自绘文字。

## 常见问题 [#常见问题]

### 为什么文字被跳过？ [#为什么文字被跳过]

先查非空 label、hidden、低缩放阈值与碰撞策略；这不一定是 renderer 异常。临时关闭策略排查，之后再恢复适合业务的密度。

### 宽高错误或绘制抛错会怎样？ [#宽高错误或绘制抛错会怎样]

当前标签回退默认单行渲染并诊断；不要返回 0、NaN 或无限尺寸。Decoration 的失败行为不同，见[绘制契约](/docs/api/extensions#extension-drawing)。

### 边标签一定沿真实路径放置吗？ [#边标签一定沿真实路径放置吗]

当前 polyline / cubic 使用端点连线位置与旋转，不能保证贴合折线或曲线。见[边标签限制](/docs/guides/edge#边标签)。

完整案例：[自定义 Label Renderer](/docs/examples/custom-label-renderer)。注册与共享缓存见[公共契约](/docs/api/graph#extension-registration)。

**相关可运行示例**

* [自定义标签渲染](/docs/examples/custom-label-renderer)


# 自定义布局 (/docs/guides/custom-layout)





需要按业务规则安排节点时，可以注册 `LayoutExtension`。它接收图数据，返回节点坐标。本例把节点等距排成一行。内置算法见[布局总览](/docs/guides/layout-overview)。

## 实现与执行 [#实现与执行]

`execute()` 接收本次图数据和运行参数。节点的 ID 和业务数据原样返回，位置用计算出的 `x`、`y`。示例从 `options.gap` 读取间距。



```ts
export function createColumnLayout(): LayoutExtension<ColumnOptions> {
  let context: ExtensionContext | undefined;
  return {
    init(next) { context = next; },
    async execute(data, { width, height, signal, options }) {
      const gap = Number(options.gap ?? 100);
      const nodes = [];
      for (const [index, node] of data.nodes.entries()) {
        await pause(signal, Number(options.delay ?? 0));
        if (signal?.aborted || context?.isDestroyed()) throw new DOMException('Canceled', 'AbortError');
        nodes.push({ ...node, x: width / 2 + (index - (data.nodes.length - 1) / 2) * gap, y: height / 2 });
      }
      return { nodes };
    },
    destroy() { context = undefined; },
  };
}
register('layout', 'docs-column', () => createColumnLayout());
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, register, type ExtensionContext, type LayoutExtension } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

interface ColumnOptions extends Record<string, unknown> { gap?: number; delay?: number }
function pause(signal: AbortSignal | undefined, delay: number) {
  return new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    if (signal?.aborted) { reject(new DOMException('Canceled', 'AbortError')); return; }
    const abort = () => { clearTimeout(timer); reject(new DOMException('Canceled', 'AbortError')); };
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { signal?.removeEventListener('abort', abort); resolve(); }, delay);
    signal?.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
  });
}
// #region layout
export function createColumnLayout(): LayoutExtension<ColumnOptions> {
  let context: ExtensionContext | undefined;
  return {
    init(next) { context = next; },
    async execute(data, { width, height, signal, options }) {
      const gap = Number(options.gap ?? 100);
      const nodes = [];
      for (const [index, node] of data.nodes.entries()) {
        await pause(signal, Number(options.delay ?? 0));
        if (signal?.aborted || context?.isDestroyed()) throw new DOMException('Canceled', 'AbortError');
        nodes.push({ ...node, x: width / 2 + (index - (data.nodes.length - 1) / 2) * gap, y: height / 2 });
      }
      return { nodes };
    },
    destroy() { context = undefined; },
  };
}
register('layout', 'docs-column', () => createColumnLayout());
// #endregion layout

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: { nodes: ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F'].map((id) => ({ id })), edges: [] },
    layout: { type: 'docs-column', gap: 100 },
    node: { style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  let revision = 0;
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  status.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:12px;font:12px system-ui;color:#334155;background:white;padding:4px;';
  const apply = async (mode: string) => {
    const request = ++revision;
    status.textContent = mode === 'slow' ? 'Running slow layout…' : 'Running…';
    if (mode === 'grid') graph.cancelLayout();
    graph.setLayout(mode === 'grid' ? { type: 'grid' } : { type: 'docs-column', gap: 100, delay: mode === 'slow' ? 180 : 0 });
    await graph.layout();
    if (graph.destroyed || request !== revision) return;
    graph.fitView({ padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 });
    status.textContent = mode === 'grid' ? 'Canceled old run; grid' : 'Column layout complete';
  };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { revision++; ui.destroy(); status.remove(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    status.textContent = 'Column layout complete';
    for (const [mode, label] of [['column', 'Layout again'], ['slow', 'Slow layout'], ['grid', 'Cancel + grid']]) {
      ui.addAction(label, () => {
        void apply(mode).catch((error) => { if (!graph.destroyed) status.textContent = String(error); });
      });
    }
    container.append(status);
    return graph;
  }
  catch (error) { graph.destroy(); throw error; }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



初始的六个节点排成一行。点 **Layout again** 可以重新计算。点 **Slow layout** 后再点 **Cancel + grid**，可以取消计算并切换到网格。

## 取消与资源 [#取消与资源]

本例等待函数在取消时清理 timer，并在正常结束时移除 abort 监听；循环每步检查 signal / isDestroyed。真实耗时计算也要分块让出主线程，否则点击取消无法被处理。

Graph 在成功、失败或取消后调用 destroy。init 可能未完成，因此清理应支持部分初始化。错误可能被布局回退吸收，不能只凭 await 正常返回判定结果已应用；按钮用自己的代次检查保护状态提示与适配。

## Graph 与独立计算 [#graph-与独立计算]

Graph.render / layout / setData 路径执行 init → execute → destroy；独立 runLayout 不调用 init，仍执行 execute / destroy。本例配置只依赖 runtime.options，因此两条路径均可用。

```ts
import { runLayout, type GraphData } from '@antv/g6-lite';
export async function calculate(data: GraphData) {
  // 需先注册上述 docs-column；结果只是坐标，不会创建或更新 Graph。
  return runLayout(data, { type: 'docs-column', gap: 100 }, { width: 640, height: 320 });
}
```

独立计算的结果展示方式见[runLayout 示例](/docs/api/graph#graph-layout-runlayout)。Graph 中无需从 execute 调用 requestRender，结果由 Graph 写回；context.data 可能是旧图，不能作为本次布局输入。

## 常见问题 [#常见问题]

### worker: true 会把自定义布局移到 Worker 吗？ [#worker-true-会把自定义布局移到-worker-吗]

不会自动搬迁注册扩展代码；当前扩展路径优先在主线程。需要自己的 Worker 时管理消息、取消与释放，见[Worker 指南](/docs/guides/layout-worker)。

### 为什么取消后 Promise 仍正常结束？ [#为什么取消后-promise-仍正常结束]

取消表示旧结果失效，不承诺抛错。保留业务代次检查，避免旧任务完成后继续更新界面。

完整 runtime 字段、回退和返回类型查[LayoutExtension](/docs/api/extensions#layoutextension)；另一个布局案例见[自定义两行布局](/docs/examples/custom-layout)。

**相关可运行示例**

* [自定义布局](/docs/examples/custom-layout)


# 自定义节点 (/docs/guides/custom-node)





用 `NodeExtension` 封装可复用的节点外观。颜色和尺寸也可以直接在[节点配置](/docs/guides/node#options-node)中设置。

## 适用场景 [#适用场景]

1. 选 circle / rect 基型，保留内置绘制和拾取。
2. 定义默认 style、纯函数 getStyle，首次 render 前 register。
3. 配置 node.type 激活；运行中通过公开数据方法更新业务字段。

## 覆盖绘制与边界锚点 [#覆盖绘制与边界锚点]

`drawOverlay()` 在节点左侧画短条。`getBoundaryAnchor()` 将右侧徽章从节点中心向上移四分之一节点高度。点击 **Toggle B status**，可以看到 B 切换状态时短条和徽章仍跟随节点。



```ts
drawOverlay(ctx, { x, y, zoom }) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.fillStyle = '#5366ad';
  ctx.fillRect(x - 44 * zoom, y - 12 * zoom, 4 * zoom, 24 * zoom);
  ctx.restore();
},
getBoundaryAnchor({ placement, width, height, crossOffsetRatio }) {
  if (placement === 'right') return { x: width / 2, y: -height / 4 };
  if (placement === 'left') return { x: -width / 2, y: height * crossOffsetRatio };
  return { x: width * crossOffsetRatio, y: placement === 'top' ? -height / 2 : height / 2 };
},
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, register, type NodeExtension } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

// #region descriptor
const statusNode: NodeExtension = {
  base: 'rect',
  style: { size: 40, width: 100, height: 40, borderRadius: 6, strokeWidth: 2 },
  getStyle(node) {
    return node.data?.status === 'error'
      ? { fill: '#fff1f0', stroke: '#cf1322' }
      : { fill: '#e6f4ff', stroke: '#1677ff' };
  },
  // #region overlay-and-anchor
  drawOverlay(ctx, { x, y, zoom }) {
    ctx.save();
    ctx.fillStyle = '#5366ad';
    ctx.fillRect(x - 44 * zoom, y - 12 * zoom, 4 * zoom, 24 * zoom);
    ctx.restore();
  },
  getBoundaryAnchor({ placement, width, height, crossOffsetRatio }) {
    if (placement === 'right') return { x: width / 2, y: -height / 4 };
    if (placement === 'left') return { x: -width / 2, y: height * crossOffsetRatio };
    return { x: width * crossOffsetRatio, y: placement === 'top' ? -height / 2 : height / 2 };
  },
  // #endregion overlay-and-anchor
};
register('node', 'docs-status-node', statusNode);
// #endregion descriptor

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0, data: { status: 'ok' } },
        { id: 'B', x: 240, y: 0, data: { status: 'error' } },
      ],
      edges: [{ id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' }],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'docs-status-node',
      style: { label: (node) => node.id, labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#1f2937' },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#873bf4', strokeWidth: 4 } },
      decorations: [{ renderer: 'builtin-badge', placement: 'right', attachment: 'boundary', data: { kind: 'count', value: 3 } }],
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true } },
    behaviors: ['click-select', 'zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: 64, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { ui.destroy(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    ui.addAction('Toggle B status', () => {
      const status = graph.getNodeData('B')?.data?.status === 'error' ? 'ok' : 'error';
      graph.updateNodeData('B', { status });
    });
    return graph;
  }
  catch (error) { graph.destroy(); throw error; }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



## 内置扩展 [#内置扩展]

将 `node.type` 设为 `breathing-node`，节点在激活、选中或高亮时会出现呼吸动画。示例中可切换选中和高亮，与右侧普通节点对比。



```ts
node: {
  type: 'breathing-node',
  style: {
    size: 36,
    fill: '#1677ff',
    stroke: '#fff',
    strokeWidth: 2,
    label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
    labelPlacement: 'bottom',
    labelFontSize: 12,
  },
  stateStyles: {
    selected: { fill: '#1677ff', stroke: '#003eb3', strokeWidth: 3, haloWidth: 16 },
    highlight: { fill: '#2E8B57', stroke: '#1F6B43', strokeWidth: 3, haloWidth: 12 },
  },
},
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
/**
 * Breathing node demo.
 * Demonstrates the built-in breathing-node extension on selected/highlight states.
 */

import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'selected', x: 180, y: 180, data: { label: 'Selected' }, states: ['selected'] },
        { id: 'highlight', x: 360, y: 180, data: { label: 'Highlight' }, states: ['highlight'] },
        { id: 'normal', x: 540, y: 180, data: { label: 'Normal' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'edge-selected-highlight', source: 'selected', target: 'highlight' },
        { id: 'edge-highlight-normal', source: 'highlight', target: 'normal' },
      ],
    },
    // #region breathing-options
    node: {
      type: 'breathing-node',
      style: {
        size: 36,
        fill: '#1677ff',
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
      },
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { fill: '#1677ff', stroke: '#003eb3', strokeWidth: 3, haloWidth: 16 },
        highlight: { fill: '#2E8B57', stroke: '#1F6B43', strokeWidth: 3, haloWidth: 12 },
      },
    },
    // #endregion breathing-options
    edge: {
      style: {
        stroke: '#d1d5db',
        lineWidth: 2,
        endArrow: true,
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node', 'click-select'],
  });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container, '切换选中和高亮，观察节点呼吸动画。');
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };

  const toggleState = (state: 'selected' | 'highlight') => {
    const active = graph.getItemStates(state).includes(state);
    graph.setItemState(state, state, !active);
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    ui.addAction('切换选中', () => toggleState('selected'));
    ui.addAction('切换高亮', () => toggleState('highlight'));
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



## 常见问题 [#常见问题]

### 注册后为什么没有变化？ [#注册后为什么没有变化]

检查名称与 node.type、注册顺序，以及配置是否覆盖了需要观察的字段。描述按名称缓存，不持有单个 Graph 的可变状态。

### 为什么徽章移动了，边端点没动？ [#为什么徽章移动了边端点没动]

锚点钩子仅供装饰定位。任意自定义形状和拾取轮廓不在当前能力范围。

### 为什么动画持续重绘？ [#为什么动画持续重绘]

检查 drawOverlay 是否始终返回 true。静态内容返回 void / false，大图不要为所有节点持续绘制。

更多场景见[自定义节点与显式边 ID](/docs/examples/custom-node-extension)，注册作用域查[公共契约](/docs/api/graph#extension-registration)。

**相关可运行示例**

* [呼吸节点](/docs/examples/breathing-node)
* [自定义节点与显式边 ID](/docs/examples/custom-node-extension)


# 自定义插件 (/docs/guides/custom-plugin)





下面实现一个点击计数器。它在图容器里显示面板，点击节点或面板上的按钮时更新计数。

## 实现插件 [#实现注册与挂载]

用工厂函数创建插件。计数、面板和退订函数都保存在工厂函数内部，每个插件实例独立管理自己的状态。

| 方法                       | 在示例中的作用                          |
| ------------------------ | -------------------------------- |
| `init(context, options)` | 读取标题等插件参数。                       |
| `mount(container)`       | 在图容器里创建面板，订阅节点点击。                |
| `destroy()`              | 退订节点点击，移除面板。插件自己创建的定时器等资源也在这里清理。 |

## 注册与使用 [#注册与使用]

用 `register('plugin', 'docs-counter', createCounter)` 注册工厂，再在 `plugins` 中配置 `{ type: 'docs-counter', caption: 'Clicks' }`。完整的图配置见[插件总览](/docs/guides/plugins#配置插件)。

## 代码示例 [#代码示例]

点击节点或 **Plugin +1**，计数会加一。点击 **Render again** 后，计数归零；再次点击节点，计数仍然只加一。



```ts
export function createCounter(): PluginExtension<CounterOptions> {
  let ui: ReturnType<typeof createDemoPanel> | undefined;
  let unsubscribe: (() => void) | undefined;
  let settings: CounterOptions | undefined;
  let count = 0;
  const report = () => ui?.setStatus(`${settings?.caption ?? 'Clicks'}: ${count}`);
  const increment = () => { count++; report(); };
  return {
    init(_context, options) { settings = options; },
    mount(container) {
      ui = createDemoPanel(container);
      ui.addAction('Plugin +1', increment);
      if (settings?.onRenderAgain) ui.addAction('Render again', settings.onRenderAgain);
      report();
      unsubscribe = settings?.subscribe?.(increment);
    },
    destroy() {
      unsubscribe?.(); unsubscribe = undefined;
      ui?.destroy();
      ui = undefined;
      settings = undefined;
    },
  };
}
register('plugin', NAME, () => createCounter());
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, register, type PluginExtension, type PluginOptions } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

const NAME = 'docs-counter' as const;
interface CounterOptions extends PluginOptions<typeof NAME> {
  caption?: string;
  subscribe?: (listener: () => void) => () => void;
  onRenderAgain?: () => void;
}
// #region plugin
export function createCounter(): PluginExtension<CounterOptions> {
  let ui: ReturnType<typeof createDemoPanel> | undefined;
  let unsubscribe: (() => void) | undefined;
  let settings: CounterOptions | undefined;
  let count = 0;
  const report = () => ui?.setStatus(`${settings?.caption ?? 'Clicks'}: ${count}`);
  const increment = () => { count++; report(); };
  return {
    init(_context, options) { settings = options; },
    mount(container) {
      ui = createDemoPanel(container);
      ui.addAction('Plugin +1', increment);
      if (settings?.onRenderAgain) ui.addAction('Render again', settings.onRenderAgain);
      report();
      unsubscribe = settings?.subscribe?.(increment);
    },
    destroy() {
      unsubscribe?.(); unsubscribe = undefined;
      ui?.destroy();
      ui = undefined;
      settings = undefined;
    },
  };
}
register('plugin', NAME, () => createCounter());
// #endregion plugin

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: { nodes: [{ id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 }, { id: 'B', x: 200, y: 0 }], edges: [] },
    node: { style: { size: 32, label: (node) => node.id } },
    // #region activate
    plugins: [{
      type: NAME, caption: 'Clicks',
      subscribe(listener: () => void) {
        graph.on('node:click', listener);
        return () => graph.off('node:click', listener);
      },
      onRenderAgain() { void graph.render().catch(console.error); },
    } satisfies CounterOptions],
    // #endregion activate
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: 64, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try { await graph.render(); return graph; }
  catch (error) { graph.destroy(); throw error; }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



展开「完整代码」可查看节点点击的接入方式：应用通过 `subscribe` 传入订阅函数，在里面调用 `graph.on()`，并返回调用 `graph.off()` 的退订函数。如果重挂载后一次点击加了多次，检查 `destroy()` 是否执行了退订。

更多钩子见 [PluginExtension](/docs/api/extensions#pluginextension)。


# 数据 Data (/docs/guides/data)





## 概述 [#概述]

图数据由节点、边和可选的 Combo 分组组成。将业务对象映射为节点、对象之间的关系映射为边，再把数据传给 `Graph`。图已经渲染时，可以替换整份数据，也可以只修改变化的元素。

## 数据结构 [#数据结构]

### 图数据（GraphData） [#节点边与分组]

下图中，A、B、C 属于同一个 Combo，边用两端节点的 ID 建立连接。

<GraphDataModelDiagram locale="zh" />

| 字段       | 类型                          | 必填 | 默认值 | 说明                           |
| -------- | --------------------------- | -- | --- | ---------------------------- |
| `nodes`  | [`GraphNode[]`](#graphnode) | 是  | —   | 节点列表。创建空图时传 `[]`。            |
| `edges`  | [`GraphEdge[]`](#graphedge) | 是  | —   | 边列表。没有边时传 `[]`。              |
| `combos` | [`ComboData[]`](#combodata) | 否  | 无分组 | 分组列表。节点通过 `comboId` 引用其中的分组。 |

<span id="位置与状态" />

### 节点数据（GraphNode） [#graphnode]

| 字段        | 类型                                                      | 必填 | 默认值       | 说明                                                      |
| --------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | -- | --------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`      | `string`                                                | 是  | —         | 节点的唯一 ID。边通过它指定端点，也可以用它查询和更新节点。                         |
| `name`    | `string`                                                | 否  | —         | 节点名称，可在 `node.style.label` 回调中读取并显示。                    |
| `data`    | [`NodeData`](/docs/api/options#config-node-data-fields) | 否  | —         | 自定义业务数据，例如 `{ score: 80 }`。其中 `cluster` 如有设置，需为字符串。     |
| `x`       | `number`                                                | 否  | 无布局时为 `0` | 节点在图坐标系中的横坐标。配置布局后，最终位置由布局计算，可用 `fx` 固定横坐标。             |
| `y`       | `number`                                                | 否  | 无布局时为 `0` | 节点在图坐标系中的纵坐标。配置布局后，最终位置由布局计算，可用 `fy` 固定纵坐标。             |
| `fx`      | `number`                                                | 否  | 不固定横坐标    | 布局计算完成后，将节点的横坐标设为此值。                                    |
| `fy`      | `number`                                                | 否  | 不固定纵坐标    | 布局计算完成后，将节点的纵坐标设为此值。                                    |
| `comboId` | `string`                                                | 否  | 不属于分组     | 所属 Combo 的 ID，需引用 `combos` 中已声明的分组。                     |
| `states`  | `NodeState[]`                                           | 否  | `[]`      | 节点的初始状态，例如 `['selected']`。通过 `node.stateStyles` 配置对应外观。 |

### 边数据（GraphEdge） [#graphedge]

| 字段       | 类型            | 必填 | 默认值  | 说明                                                        |
| -------- | ------------- | -- | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`     | `string`      | 否  | 自动生成 | 边的唯一 ID。需要在整图替换前后识别同一条边时，显式传入稳定 ID。                       |
| `source` | `string`      | 是  | —    | 起点节点的 ID，需引用 `nodes` 中的节点。                                |
| `target` | `string`      | 是  | —    | 终点节点的 ID，需引用 `nodes` 中的节点。与 `source` 相同会形成自环。             |
| `data`   | `EdgeData`    | 否  | —    | 自定义业务数据，类型为 `Record<string, unknown>`，例如 `{ weight: 2 }`。 |
| `states` | `EdgeState[]` | 否  | `[]` | 边的初始状态，例如 `['selected']`。通过 `edge.stateStyles` 配置对应外观。    |

### 分组数据（ComboData） [#combodata]

| 字段          | 类型                          | 必填 | 默认值      | 说明                                                                                 |
| ----------- | --------------------------- | -- | -------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`        | `string`                    | 是  | —        | 分组的唯一 ID。节点通过 `comboId` 引用它，子分组通过 `parentId` 引用它。                                  |
| `parentId`  | `string`                    | 否  | 无父分组     | 父分组的 ID，需引用同一 `combos` 列表中的分组。父子关系不能成环。                                            |
| `collapsed` | `boolean`                   | 否  | `false`  | 设为 `true` 时初始折叠分组，隐藏后代节点及其关联边。                                                     |
| `style`     | `Partial<ComboStyleConfig>` | 否  | 使用图级分组样式 | 为当前分组覆盖指定的样式字段，例如 `{ fill: '#e6f4ff' }`。 [分组样式配置](/docs/api/options#options-combo) |
| `data`      | `Record<string, unknown>`   | 否  | —        | 自定义业务数据，例如 `{ department: 'engineering' }`。                                        |
| `states`    | `ElementState[]`            | 否  | `[]`     | 分组的初始状态，例如 `['selected']`。通过 `combo.stateStyles` 配置对应外观。                           |

## 数据操作 [#数据操作]

### 数据初始化 [#数据初始化]

将 `data` 传入 `new Graph()`，等待首次 `render()` 完成，再调用数据写入方法。示例中的 `#container` 需要已挂载并具有宽高。

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const graph = new Graph({
  container: '#container',
  data: {
    nodes: [{ id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 }, { id: 'B', x: 120, y: 0 }],
    edges: [{ id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' }],
  },
});

await graph.render();
```

### 选择更新方式 [#选择更新方式]

| 变化           | 方法                                | 保留或重算              |
| ------------ | --------------------------------- | ------------------ |
| 切换数据集 / 全量返回 | setData                           | 替换全图，有配置就布局；默认适配   |
| 少量业务字段变化     | updateNodeData / updateEdgeData   | 浅合并 data，不重布局      |
| 新增或删除元素      | addNode(s) / addEdge(s) / remove… | 新增节点提供坐标，删除节点连带删除边 |
| 位置变化         | updateNodePosition(s)             | 图坐标变化，不改变身份        |
| 选择、隐藏、归组     | 状态 / Combo 方法                     | 按所属主题修改，不必全量替换     |

### 替换整份数据 [#替换整份数据]

准备好完整的 `GraphData` 后调用 `setData()`。它会按当前配置重新布局，默认重新适配画布。传入 `fitView: false` 可以保留用户当前的缩放和平移。

```ts
await graph.setData(nextData, { fitView: false });
```

新数据决定初始选中状态。要保留选择，按仍存在的稳定 ID 恢复。 [保留选择](/docs/guides/states) · [视野保留示例](/docs/guides/viewport)

### 增量更新 [#增量更新]

下面接着使用初始化示例的图。先添加节点 C 和边 B-C，再更新它们的业务字段。

```ts
graph.addNode({ id: 'C', x: 240, y: 0 });
graph.addEdge({ id: 'B-C', source: 'B', target: 'C' });

graph.updateNodeData('C', { score: 80 });
graph.updateEdgeData('B-C', { weight: 2 });
```

删除边时会保留端点。删除节点时会一起移除关联边。

```ts
graph.removeEdge('B-C');
graph.removeNode('C');
```

在下面的示例中，可以查询 A、修改分数，或添加和删除节点 D。



```ts
const update = () => graph.updateNodeData('A', {
  score: Number(graph.getNodeData('A')?.data?.score ?? 0) + 1,
});
const add = () => {
  if (graph.hasNode('D')) return;
  graph.addNode({ id: 'D', x: 360, y: 70 });
  graph.addEdge({ id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' });
};
const remove = () => graph.removeNode('D'); // Also removes C-D.
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0, data: { score: 1 } },
        { id: 'B', x: 200, y: -50 }, { id: 'C', x: 200, y: 70 },
      ],
      edges: [{ id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { id: 'A-C', source: 'A', target: 'C' }],
    },
    node: { style: {
      size: (node) => node.id === 'A' ? 28 + Number(node.data?.score ?? 1) * 2 : 28,
      label: (node) => node.id === 'A' ? `A: ${node.data?.score}` : node.id, labelOffsetY: 10,
    } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: [76, 48, 120, 48], maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  // #region query
  const inspect = () => ({
    node: graph.getNodeData('A'),
    neighbors: graph.getNeighborNodes('A'),
    edges: graph.getAdjacentEdges('A'),
    snapshot: graph.getData(),
  });
  // #endregion query
  // #region mutation
  const update = () => graph.updateNodeData('A', {
    score: Number(graph.getNodeData('A')?.data?.score ?? 0) + 1,
  });
  const add = () => {
    if (graph.hasNode('D')) return;
    graph.addNode({ id: 'D', x: 360, y: 70 });
    graph.addEdge({ id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' });
  };
  const remove = () => graph.removeNode('D'); // Also removes C-D.
  // #endregion mutation
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  status.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;right:12px;padding:8px;background:white;color:#334155;font:12px/1.5 system-ui;white-space:pre-line;pointer-events:none;z-index:20;';
  let last = 'Ready';
  const report = () => {
    const result = inspect();
    status.textContent = [
      `${last} | nodes=${graph.getNodeCount()}, edges=${graph.getEdgeCount()}`,
      `A score=${result.node?.data?.score} | neighbors=${result.neighbors.join(', ')}`,
      `adjacent=${result.edges.map((edge) => edge.id).join(', ')}`,
    ].join('\n');
  };
  const copy = () => {
    const snapshot = graph.getData();
    snapshot.nodes[0].data = { ...snapshot.nodes[0].data, score: 999 };
    last = `snapshot score=999; graph score=${graph.getNodeData('A')?.data?.score}`;
  };
  const actions: Array<[string, () => void]> = [
    ['Inspect A', () => { last = 'Inspected'; }], ['Edit snapshot', copy],
    ['Update A', () => { update(); last = 'Updated A'; }],
    ['Add D', () => { add(); last = 'Added D'; }],
    ['Remove D', () => { remove(); last = 'Removed D'; }],
  ];
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    ui.destroy(); status.remove(); destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    if (graph.destroyed) return graph;
    for (const [label, action] of actions) {
      ui.addAction(label, () => { action(); report(); });
    }
    container.append(status); report(); return graph;
  } catch (error) { graph.destroy(); throw error; }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



增量方法会调度重绘。多个元素优先使用批量方法。业务字段按顶层键浅合并，嵌套对象整体替换。

### 查询数据 [#查询数据]

用 `getNodes()` 和 `getEdges()` 读取列表，用 `getNodeData(id)` 和 `getEdgeData(id)` 按 ID 查询单个元素。

```ts
const nodes = graph.getNodes();
const edges = graph.getEdges();
const node = graph.getNodeData('B');
const edge = graph.getEdgeData('A-B');
```

#### 输入、模型与快照 [#输入模型与快照]

| 形式           | 用途                 | 修改方式                   |
| ------------ | ------------------ | ---------------------- |
| GraphData 输入 | 声明节点、边和 Combo      | 交给 new Graph / setData |
| 查询 Model     | 读取当前工作图，states 是集合 | 通过 Graph 方法修改          |
| getData 快照   | 导出当前坐标、归属与状态       | 修改后显式 setData；嵌套对象可能共享 |

稳定 ID 表示业务身份，数组顺序和坐标都不表示身份。相同端点可以有多条不同 ID 的边；跨刷新保留边选择时显式提供稳定 ID。

Model 是 Graph 持有的实时视图。数据替换或删除后重新查询。首次渲染前，各查询方法返回相应的空值，`getData()` 则返回构造数据的快照。查询可能在销毁后仍有返回值，可用 [destroyed](/docs/api/graph#graph-lifecycle-destroyed) 检查实例。

`getData()` 在渲染后导出当前坐标、实际边 ID、归属和状态。快照省略折叠派生的 `hidden`，固定轴 `fx` / `fy` 和布局配置需另存。

##### 查询返回类型 [#模型字段]

| 返回类型                                    | 字段                                      |
| --------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------- |
| `NodeModel`                             | `id`、`name?`、`x`、`y`、`data?`、`states`   |
| `EdgeModel`                             | `id`、`source`、`target`、`data?`、`states` |
| [ComboModel](/docs/guides/combo#只读查询模型) | 分组坐标、尺寸、成员、折叠状态等                        |
| `ElementModel`                          | `NodeModel \| EdgeModel \| ComboModel`  |

字段均为只读，`?` 表示可选。节点的 `x`、`y` 是图坐标，`data` 的类型是 `Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>`，`states` 的类型是 `ReadonlySet<ElementState>`。

```ts
const element = graph.getElementData('A-B');
if (element && 'source' in element) {
  console.log(element.source, element.target);
}
const selected = graph.getNodeData('A')?.states.has('selected');
```

### 复杂数据结构 [#复杂数据结构]

**嵌套分组。** 初始数据通过 `parentId` 表示分组的父子关系，通过节点的 `comboId` 声明归属。运行中可以创建分组、移动已有节点和切换折叠状态。下面把已存在的 B 加入 Storage，再将 Storage 折叠。

```ts
graph.createCombo({ id: 'platform' });
graph.createCombo({ id: 'storage', parentId: 'platform' }, ['B']);
graph.collapseCombo('storage');
```

**树形数据。** 将树展平为 `nodes` 和 `edges`。每条边从父节点指向子节点，例如 `{ source: 'root', target: 'child' }`。将这份数据交给 `mindmap`、`indented` 等树布局。 [Combo 用法](/docs/guides/combo) · [树布局示例](/docs/api/options#config-tree-layout-fields)

<span id="接入业务数据" />

<span id="校验数据" />

## 使用远程数据 [#使用远程数据]

接口返回完整图数据时，可以先创建并渲染空图，再加载 JSON。下面假设接口已经返回符合 `GraphData` 的数据。如果接口返回的是业务对象，先转换并校验 ID、边端点和分组归属。

```ts
import { Graph, type GraphData } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const graph = new Graph({
  container: '#container',
  data: { nodes: [], edges: [] },
  layout: { type: 'grid' },
});
await graph.render();

const response = await fetch('/data/graph.json');
if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);

const data: GraphData = await response.json();
if (!graph.destroyed) await graph.setData(data);
```

### 取消旧请求并清理图实例 [#取消旧请求并清理图实例]

下面的辅助函数拥有此页面 Graph 的清理职责。load 接受 AbortSignal；调用 refresh 时处理失败提示，退出时调用 dispose。

```ts
import type { Graph, GraphData } from '@antv/g6-lite';
export function createLoader(graph: Graph, load: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<GraphData>) {
  let version = 0;
  let disposed = false;
  let controller: AbortController | undefined;
  return {
    async refresh() {
      const request = ++version;
      controller?.abort();
      const current = new AbortController();
      controller = current;
      try {
        const next = await load(current.signal);
        if (disposed || graph.destroyed || request !== version) return;
        await graph.setData(next, { fitView: false });
      } catch (error) {
        if (!current.signal.aborted && !disposed) throw error;
      }
    },
    dispose() {
      disposed = true;
      version++;
      controller?.abort();
      graph.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```

## 常见问题 [#常见问题]

### 修改导出数据为什么没生效？ [#修改导出数据为什么没生效]

getData 不自动写回；少量变化用增量方法，整图替换才显式 setData，并选择视野策略。

### 删除后为什么原来的下标指向其他元素？ [#删除后为什么原来的下标指向其他元素]

数组顺序可能变化。用 ID 查询，分别匹配节点和边，不保存数组下标作为身份。

<span id="数据与样式" />

### 更新后标签或颜色没变？ [#更新后标签或颜色没变]

确认字段写在 data，样式函数读取同名字段；修改导出副本或直接改 Model 不会按公开流程更新。

### 更新后为什么视野或选择丢了？ [#更新后为什么视野或选择丢了]

setData 默认适配，状态按新输入建立。保留相机用 fitView: false，保留选择则按稳定 ID 显式恢复。


# 边通用配置项 (/docs/guides/edge)





用 `GraphOptions.edge` 选择路径，设置线条、箭头和标签。端点、方向与数据结构见[边总览](/docs/elements/edge)。

<span id="基础配置" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

## EdgeConfig [#edgeconfig]

`EdgeConfig` 对应 `new Graph()` 的 `edge` 选项。下例绘制一条蓝色直线，终点带箭头，选中后改用紫色。

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const graph = new Graph({
  container: '#container',
  data: {
    nodes: [{ id: 'a', x: 80, y: 100 }, { id: 'b', x: 260, y: 100 }],
    edges: [{ id: 'a-b', source: 'a', target: 'b' }],
  },
  edge: {
    type: 'line',
    style: { stroke: '#1783FF', lineWidth: 2, endArrow: true },
    stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#7C3AED', lineWidth: 4 } },
  },
  behaviors: ['click-select'],
});

await graph.render();
```

| 属性                                      | 描述               | 类型                                                   | 默认值       | 必选 |
| --------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | --------- | -- |
| [`type`](#类型)                           | 内置边类型或已注册的自定义边名称 | `string`                                             | `'line'`  | 否  |
| [`style`](#样式字段)                        | 线条、路径参数、箭头和标签    | `EdgeConfig['style']`                                | 主题和内置样式   | 否  |
| [`stateStyles`](#状态样式)                  | 按状态覆盖外观          | `Partial<Record<EdgeState, EdgeStateStyleOverride>>` | 扩展或主题状态样式 | 否  |
| [`parallelEdges`](#平行边与自环)              | 分离同端点的多条边        | `boolean \| ParallelEdgesConfig`                     | 关闭        | 否  |
| [`labelRenderer`](#edge-label-renderer) | 已注册的标签渲染器        | `string`                                             | 内置标签渲染器   | 否  |

## 指定边类型 [#类型]

用 `edge.type` 指定边类型，默认是 `line`（直线边）。下面将整张图的边设为 `polyline`（折线边）。

```ts
const graph = new Graph({
  container,
  data,
  edge: { type: 'polyline' },
});
```

| 类型值        | 名称                      | 适用场景              |
| ---------- | ----------------------- | ----------------- |
| `line`     | [直线边](#edge-line)       | 直接连接两个端点          |
| `arc`      | [弧线边](#edge-arc)        | 调整弯曲方向，或分开同端点的多条边 |
| `cubic`    | [三次贝塞尔曲线边](#edge-cubic) | 平滑连接左右层级          |
| `polyline` | [折线边](#edge-polyline)   | 流程图、目录树或鱼骨图中的路由连接 |

自定义类型先[注册边扩展](/docs/guides/custom-edge)，再把 `edge.type` 设为注册名称。

### 直线边 Line [#edge-line]

`line` 直接连接两个端点。`endArrow: true` 在终点加箭头。

```ts
const edge = { type: 'line', style: { lineWidth: 2, endArrow: true } };
```

### 弧线与三次曲线 [#弧线与三次曲线]

#### 弧线边 Arc [#edge-arc]

`curvature` 控制弧线方向和弯曲程度。示例对比 `-0.35`、`0` 和 `0.35`。



```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const rows = [
    { id: 'curvature -0.35', y: 60, curvature: -0.35 },
    { id: 'curvature 0', y: 150, curvature: 0 },
    { id: 'curvature 0.35', y: 240, curvature: 0.35 },
  ];
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: rows.flatMap((row) => [
        { id: row.id + '-s', x: 100, y: row.y, data: { label: row.id } },
        { id: row.id + '-t', x: 440, y: row.y },
      ]),
      edges: rows.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, source: row.id + '-s', target: row.id + '-t', data: row })),
    },
    node: { style: { size: 20, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? '') } },
    edge: {
      type: 'arc',
      style: { curvature: (_s, _t, edge) => Number(edge.data?.curvature ?? 0), lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 12 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#873bf4' } },
    },
    behaviors: ['click-select'],
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



#### 三次曲线边 Cubic [#edge-cubic]

`curveOffset` 控制三次曲线两端的水平控制柄。示例对比 `30` 和 `120`。两端等高时，边可能仍呈直线。



```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const rows = [{ id: 'offset 30', y: 40, offset: 30 }, { id: 'offset 120', y: 180, offset: 120 }];
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: rows.flatMap((row) => [
        { id: row.id + '-s', x: 100, y: row.y, data: { label: row.id } },
        { id: row.id + '-t', x: 440, y: row.y + 80 },
      ]),
      edges: rows.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, source: row.id + '-s', target: row.id + '-t', data: row })),
    },
    node: { type: 'rect', style: { width: 70, height: 28, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? '') } },
    edge: {
      type: 'cubic',
      style: { curveOffset: (_s, _t, edge) => Number(edge.data?.offset ?? 60), lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 12 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#873bf4' } },
    },
    behaviors: ['click-select'],
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



<span id="基础样式" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="edge-style-fields" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

## Style 边样式 [#样式字段]

### 主图形样式 [#edge-path-styles]

线条样式控制边的颜色、粗细、透明度和方向。

| 字段             | 类型                         | 默认或回退                                                     | 说明                                    |
| -------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `stroke`       | `EdgeStyleValue<string>`   | `theme.edgeStroke`；light 为 `'#99ADD1'`，dark 为 `'#637088'` | 边和箭头颜色                                |
| `lineWidth`    | `EdgeStyleValue<number>`   | `theme.edgeLineWidth`，预设为 `1`                             | 视觉线宽，使用有限正数                           |
| `opacity`      | `EdgeStyleValue<number>`   | `1`                                                       | 不透明度，使用 `0` 到 `1`                     |
| `lineDash`     | `EdgeStyleValue<number[]>` | `[]`                                                      | 空数组为实线；当前按前两个值之和计算虚线周期，见[虚线规则](#虚线规则) |
| `startArrow`   | `EdgeStyleValue<boolean>`  | `false`                                                   | 起点箭头，指向 `source`                      |
| `endArrow`     | `EdgeStyleValue<boolean>`  | `theme.edgeArrow`，light、dark 均为 `true`                    | 终点箭头，指向 `target`                      |
| `arrowSize`    | `EdgeStyleValue<number>`   | 根据线宽自动计算                                                  | 箭头沿路径方向的长度；显式长度使用有限正数，非正值使用自动长度       |
| `hitAreaWidth` | `EdgeStyleValue<number>`   | 最终 `lineWidth`                                            | 总点击热区宽度，不改变视觉线宽，见[交互热区](#交互热区)        |

线宽、热区宽度、箭头长度和虚线周期使用屏幕渲染像素，随缩放保持大小。

<span id="样式回调" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

### 样式函数 [#样式函数]

样式函数接收 `(source, target, edge)`，可根据每条边的数据计算样式。示例按 `edge.data` 画出细实线、虚线和双向箭头。



```ts
edge: {
  type: 'line',
  style: {
    stroke: (_source, _target, edge) => String(edge.data?.color ?? '#99ADD1'),
    lineWidth: (_source, _target, edge) => Number(edge.data?.width ?? 1),
    lineDash: (_source, _target, edge) => (edge.data?.dash as number[]) ?? [],
    opacity: (_source, _target, edge) => Number(edge.data?.opacity ?? 1),
    startArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.start === true,
    endArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.end === true,
    arrowSize: 16,
    hitAreaWidth: 14,
  },
  stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#873bf4', lineWidth: 6 } },
},
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const rows = [
    { id: 'Plain', y: 60, width: 1.5, color: '#64748b', dash: [], start: false, end: false, opacity: 1 },
    { id: 'Dash', y: 150, width: 3, color: '#f6903d', dash: [8, 8], start: false, end: true, opacity: 0.7 },
    { id: 'Both', y: 240, width: 5, color: '#1783FF', dash: [], start: true, end: true, opacity: 1 },
  ];
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: rows.flatMap((row) => [
        { id: `${row.id}-source`, x: 100, y: row.y, data: { label: row.id } },
        { id: `${row.id}-target`, x: 440, y: row.y },
      ]),
      edges: rows.map((row) => ({
        id: row.id, source: `${row.id}-source`, target: `${row.id}-target`, data: row,
      })),
    },
    node: { style: { size: 20, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? '') } },
    // #region edge-options
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: (_source, _target, edge) => String(edge.data?.color ?? '#99ADD1'),
        lineWidth: (_source, _target, edge) => Number(edge.data?.width ?? 1),
        lineDash: (_source, _target, edge) => (edge.data?.dash as number[]) ?? [],
        opacity: (_source, _target, edge) => Number(edge.data?.opacity ?? 1),
        startArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.start === true,
        endArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.end === true,
        arrowSize: 16,
        hitAreaWidth: 14,
      },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#873bf4', lineWidth: 6 } },
    },
    // #endregion edge-options
    behaviors: ['click-select'],
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



### 虚线规则 [#虚线规则]

用 `lineDash` 绘制虚线，前两个数相加决定虚线周期。直线示例将 `lineWidth` 设为 `3`，对比实线和两种虚线间距。



```ts
const rows = [
  { id: 'Solid', y: 0, dash: [] },
  { id: 'Short dashes', y: 75, dash: [4, 4] },
  { id: 'Long dashes', y: 150, dash: [8, 8] },
];
const edge: EdgeConfig = {
  type: 'line',
  style: {
    lineWidth: 3,
    endArrow: false,
    lineDash: (_source, _target, edge) => (edge.data?.dash as number[] | undefined) ?? [],
  },
};
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph, type EdgeConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region dash-options
  const rows = [
    { id: 'Solid', y: 0, dash: [] },
    { id: 'Short dashes', y: 75, dash: [4, 4] },
    { id: 'Long dashes', y: 150, dash: [8, 8] },
  ];
  const edge: EdgeConfig = {
    type: 'line',
    style: {
      lineWidth: 3,
      endArrow: false,
      lineDash: (_source, _target, edge) => (edge.data?.dash as number[] | undefined) ?? [],
    },
  };
  // #endregion dash-options
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: rows.flatMap(({ id, y }) => [
        { id: id + '-source', x: 0, y },
        { id: id + '-target', x: 320, y },
      ]),
      edges: rows.map(({ id, dash }) => ({
        id,
        source: id + '-source',
        target: id + '-target',
        data: { dash },
      })),
    },
    node: { style: { size: 16 } },
    edge: {
      ...edge,
      style: { ...edge.style, label: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.id ?? '', labelFontSize: 12 },
    },
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
    behaviors: [],
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```





### 箭头 [#箭头]

用 `startArrow` 和 `endArrow` 控制两端箭头，用 `arrowSize` 设置长度。



```ts
edge: {
  type: 'line',
  style: {
    stroke: '#99ADD1',
    lineWidth: (_source, _target, edge) => Number(edge.data?.lw ?? 2),
    endArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.dir !== 'none',
    startArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.dir === 'both',
  },
},
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Arrow directions - none / forward / bidirectional
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function runGraph(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'n1', name: 'No arrow', x: 80, y: 120 },
        { id: 't1', name: '', x: 280, y: 120 },
        { id: 'n2', name: 'Forward', x: 400, y: 120 },
        { id: 't2', name: '', x: 600, y: 120 },
        { id: 'n3', name: 'Bidirectional', x: 80, y: 280 },
        { id: 't3', name: '', x: 280, y: 280 },
        { id: 'n4', name: 'Thick + arrow', x: 400, y: 280 },
        { id: 't4', name: '', x: 600, y: 280 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'n1', target: 't1', data: { dir: 'none' } },
        { source: 'n2', target: 't2', data: { dir: 'forward' } },
        { source: 'n3', target: 't3', data: { dir: 'both' } },
        { source: 'n4', target: 't4', data: { dir: 'forward', lw: 6 } },
      ],
    },
    node: { type: 'circle', style: { fill: '#5B8FF9', size: 24, label: (node) => node.name ?? '' } },
    // #region arrow-options
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#99ADD1',
        lineWidth: (_source, _target, edge) => Number(edge.data?.lw ?? 2),
        endArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.dir !== 'none',
        startArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.dir === 'both',
      },
    },
    // #endregion arrow-options
    theme: 'light',
  });

  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = await runGraph(container);
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```



[箭头尺寸与默认值](/docs/api/options#config-edge-style)

## 交互热区 [#交互热区]

用 `hitAreaWidth` 扩大边的命中范围，同时保持原线宽。示例用 `click-select` 启用点击选中。



```ts
edge: {
  type: 'line',
  style: {
    stroke: '#64748b',
    lineWidth: 1.5,
    endArrow: false,
    hitAreaWidth: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.id === 'wide' ? 24 : 2,
  },
  stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#873bf4' } },
},
behaviors: ['click-select'],
```

**完整运行代码**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'narrow-source', x: 100, y: 80, data: { label: 'Width 2' } },
        { id: 'narrow-target', x: 440, y: 80 },
        { id: 'wide-source', x: 100, y: 200, data: { label: 'Width 24' } },
        { id: 'wide-target', x: 440, y: 200 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'narrow', source: 'narrow-source', target: 'narrow-target' },
        { id: 'wide', source: 'wide-source', target: 'wide-target' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 20, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? '') } },
    // #region hit-area
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#64748b',
        lineWidth: 1.5,
        endArrow: false,
        hitAreaWidth: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.id === 'wide' ? 24 : 2,
      },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#873bf4' } },
    },
    behaviors: ['click-select'],
    // #endregion hit-area
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```

```ts
edge: {
  style: { stroke: '#64748B', lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 14 },

behaviors: ['click-select'],
```

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {

        { id: 'db', x: 200, y: -55 },
        { id: 'cache', x: 200, y: 55 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'api-db', source: 'api', target: 'db', states: ['selected'] },
        { id: 'api-cache', source: 'api', target: 'cache' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 20 } },
    // #region state-styles
    edge: {
      style: { stroke: '#64748B', lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 14 },
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { stroke: '#7C3AED', lineWidth: 5 },
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['click-select'],
    // #endregion state-styles

  });
```
